zh.tag: 去中心化蓝牙+ Nostr 双协议即时通讯
zh.what: Bitchat 是一款去中心化、点对点的即时通讯应用，支持蓝牙 Mesh 网络（离线）和 Nostr 协议（互联网）双传输架构。无需账户、手机号或中央服务器，注重隐私与抗审查。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 iOS/macOS 原生应用源码，支持蓝牙 Mesh 多跳中继、Nostr 全球中继、地理频道、IRC 风格命令、端到端加密（Noise 协议 + NIP-17）及紧急擦除等功能。
zh.stack: 使用 Swift 开发，依赖 Bluetooth LE（CoreBluetooth）和 Nostr 协议栈，集成 Noise Protocol 加密、LZ4 压缩、Geohash 地理编码。
zh.hot: 凭借去中心化、无服务器、离线可用等特性，在隐私和抗审查需求高涨的当下迅速走红，24 小时内获 1720 星，总星数达 28722。
uses: 隐私敏感用户 —— 无需手机号或账户，完全匿名通信
离线/灾难场景 —— 蓝牙 Mesh 在无网络环境下仍可通信
抗议或审查环境 —— 去中心化架构难以被封锁
技术爱好者 —— IRC 风格命令和开源代码便于探索

en.tag: Decentralized messaging with Bluetooth mesh & Nostr
en.what: Bitchat is a decentralized peer-to-peer messaging app with dual transport: Bluetooth mesh for offline and Nostr for internet. No accounts, phone numbers, or central servers; privacy-first and censorship-resistant.
en.content: Full source code for iOS/macOS native app with Bluetooth mesh multi-hop relay, Nostr global relays, location-based channels, IRC-style commands, end-to-end encryption (Noise + NIP-17), and emergency wipe.
en.stack: Built with Swift, leveraging Bluetooth LE (CoreBluetooth) and Nostr protocol stack, with Noise Protocol encryption, LZ4 compression, and Geohash geocoding.
en.hot: Its decentralized, serverless, offline-capable design resonates with privacy and censorship concerns, gaining 1720 stars in 24h and 28722 total.
uses: Privacy-conscious users — anonymous without phone or account
Offline/disaster scenarios — Bluetooth mesh works without internet
Protests or censorship — decentralized architecture resists blocking
Tech enthusiasts — IRC-style commands and open-source code

zh.tag: 自托管 VPN 客户端，一键部署专属服务器
zh.what: Amnezia VPN 是一个开源 VPN 客户端，核心功能是让用户在自己的服务器上快速部署 VPN 服务。它支持多种协议和流量混淆，并提供分隧道功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面端和移动端客户端代码，以及自动部署 VPN Docker 容器的脚本。提供图形界面，用户只需输入 IP、SSH 登录信息即可完成部署。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 OpenVPN、WireGuard、IKEv2、Cloak、Shadowsocks、AmneziaWG、XRay 等协议。
zh.hot: 自托管 VPN 需求旺盛，用户追求隐私和可控性；13k+ Stars 表明社区认可其易用性和功能丰富性。
uses: 希望自建 VPN 保护隐私的个人用户 —— 一键部署，无需专业知识
需要绕过网络限制的用户 —— 支持多种混淆协议
开发者和运维人员 —— 可定制和扩展 VPN 服务

en.tag: Self-hosted VPN client with one-click server deployment
en.what: Amnezia VPN is an open-source VPN client that enables users to deploy their own VPN server on their server with ease. It supports multiple protocols, traffic obfuscation, and split tunneling.
en.content: The repository contains desktop and mobile client code, along with scripts to automatically deploy VPN Docker containers. It provides a GUI where users input IP and SSH credentials to set up the server.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, leveraging protocols like OpenVPN, WireGuard, IKEv2, Cloak, Shadowsocks, AmneziaWG, and XRay.
en.hot: High demand for self-hosted VPNs due to privacy and control concerns; 13k+ Stars reflect community approval of its ease of use and rich features.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals wanting to self-host VPN — one-click deployment, no expertise needed
Users needing to bypass network restrictions — supports multiple obfuscation protocols
Developers and sysadmins — customizable and extensible VPN service

zh.tag: 自托管 AI 伴侣，复刻 Neuro-sama，支持实时语音与游戏
zh.what: AIRI 是一个自托管的 AI 伴侣项目，旨在复刻虚拟主播 Neuro-sama 的交互体验。它支持实时语音聊天、Minecraft 和 Factorio 等游戏互动，让用户拥有属于自己的 AI 虚拟角色。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端（Web/macOS/Windows）、服务端代码、文档和 Discord/Telegram 等社区链接。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 和现代 Web 技术栈，支持跨平台部署。
zh.hot: 4.4 万 Star 且日增 572，因其复刻热门虚拟主播 Neuro-sama 的独特概念，结合自托管与游戏互动功能，吸引了大量 AI 和二次元爱好者。
uses: AI 爱好者 —— 自托管专属 AI 伴侣，体验实时语音互动
二次元/虚拟主播粉丝 —— 复刻 Neuro-sama，打造个性化虚拟角色
游戏玩家 —— 在 Minecraft/Factorio 中与 AI 伴侣一起游玩
开发者 —— 学习或贡献 TypeScript 全栈 AI 应用

en.tag: Self-hosted AI companion, recreating Neuro-sama, with real-time voice and game support
en.what: AIRI is a self-hosted AI companion project that recreates the interactive experience of virtual streamer Neuro-sama. It supports real-time voice chat and game interactions like Minecraft and Factorio, giving users their own AI virtual character.
en.content: The repo includes full client (Web/macOS/Windows) and server code, documentation, and community links like Discord/Telegram.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, relies on Node.js and modern web tech stack, supports cross-platform deployment.
en.hot: 44k stars with 572 daily, driven by the unique concept of recreating popular virtual streamer Neuro-sama, combined with self-hosting and game interaction, attracting AI and anime fans.
uses: AI enthusiasts — self-host a personal AI companion with real-time voice
Anime/vTuber fans — recreate Neuro-sama and customize virtual characters
Gamers — play Minecraft/Factorio with an AI companion
Developers — learn or contribute to a full-stack TypeScript AI app

zh.tag: 轻量云原生GIS平台，跨端运行
zh.what: GeoLibre 是一个免费开源的轻量级云原生 GIS 平台，用于可视化、探索和分析地理空间数据。它可以在 Web 浏览器、桌面、移动设备和 Jupyter Notebook 中运行，同时保持数据本地化和隐私性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的跨平台 GIS 应用源码，基于 Tauri v2、React、TypeScript、MapLibre GL JS、DuckDB-WASM Spatial 和 deck.gl 构建。提供 Web 版、桌面安装包、Android 应用以及 Python 包，支持插件扩展。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 Tauri v2（桌面/移动端框架）、React + TypeScript（前端）、MapLibre GL JS（地图渲染）、DuckDB-WASM Spatial（本地空间数据库）和 deck.gl（大规模数据可视化）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 420 星，总星数 2681，位列 GitHub 日榜第 4。其“云原生+本地隐私”的独特定位，以及跨端一致体验，吸引了大量 GIS 和地理空间数据从业者。
uses: GIS 专业人士 —— 在浏览器或桌面端快速可视化和分析地理空间数据
数据科学家 —— 在 Jupyter Notebook 中集成空间分析工作流
开发者 —— 基于插件架构扩展 GIS 功能或嵌入自定义地图应用
教育工作者 —— 用于地理信息科学教学和演示

en.tag: Lightweight cloud-native GIS platform, runs everywhere
en.what: GeoLibre is a free, open-source, lightweight cloud-native GIS platform for visualizing, exploring, and analyzing geospatial data. It runs in web browsers, on desktops, on mobile devices, and inside Jupyter notebooks, all while keeping data local and private.
en.content: The repository contains the full cross-platform GIS application source code, built with Tauri v2, React, TypeScript, MapLibre GL JS, DuckDB-WASM Spatial, and deck.gl. It offers a web version, desktop installers, an Android app, and a Python package, with plugin support.
en.stack: Tech stack includes Tauri v2 (desktop/mobile framework), React + TypeScript (frontend), MapLibre GL JS (map rendering), DuckDB-WASM Spatial (local spatial database), and deck.gl (large-scale data visualization).
en.hot: Gained 420 stars today, total 2681, ranking 4th on GitHub Trending daily. Its unique 'cloud-native + local privacy' positioning and consistent cross-platform experience attract many GIS and geospatial data professionals.
uses: GIS professionals — quickly visualize and analyze geospatial data in browser or desktop
Data scientists — integrate spatial analysis workflows in Jupyter notebooks
Developers — extend GIS functionality via plugin architecture or embed custom map apps
Educators — use for teaching and demonstrating geographic information science

zh.tag: 高颜值现代化终端文件管理器
zh.what: superfile 是一款在终端中运行的文件管理器，采用现代化的 TUI 界面，让开发者无需离开命令行即可高效浏览、预览和操作文件。它支持多面板布局、主题定制与插件扩展，致力于在保持终端工作流的同时提供图形化般的交互体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 源码、安装脚本与构建指南，以及丰富的主题包、插件文档和快捷键配置示例。同时提供了面向 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 的跨平台发布与安装说明。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言构建，采用现代化终端 UI 技术实现跨平台渲染，支持多架构二进制分发与 Homebrew 等包管理器集成。
zh.hot: 凭借精致的多栏 TUI 设计与流畅的交互体验，superfile 在开发者中迅速走红，目前已积累 18.6k Stars，本月新增 1,295 颗，跻身 GitHub Go 语言月榜第 11 位，成为传统终端文件管理器的强力现代替代品。
uses: 终端重度用户与键盘党 —— 追求不离开命令行即可完成复杂文件操作
DevOps 与运维工程师 —— 需要在远程服务器上快速浏览、编辑和管理文件
追求美观的开发者 —— 希望终端工具拥有现代 UI 与丰富主题定制
跨平台工作者 —— 在 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 间寻求一致的文件管理体验

en.tag: A fancy, modern terminal file manager with rich TUI
en.what: superfile is a terminal-based file manager that delivers a modern, fancy TUI interface, allowing developers to browse, preview, and manipulate files without leaving the command line. It features multi-panel layouts, customizable themes, and plugin support, blending the efficiency of terminal workflows with a near-GUI interactive experience.
en.content: The repository ships full Go source code, installation scripts, build guides, and a rich collection of themes, plugin docs, and hotkey configuration samples. It also provides cross-platform release notes and installation instructions for macOS, Linux, and Windows.
en.stack: Built in Go with modern terminal UI libraries for cross-platform rendering, supporting multi-arch binaries and package managers like Homebrew.
en.hot: Thanks to its polished multi-pane TUI design and smooth interactions, superfile has gained strong traction among developers, amassing 18.6k stars with 1,295 added this month and ranking 11th on GitHub's Go monthly trending list as a compelling modern alternative to classic terminal file managers.
uses: Terminal power users and keyboard-driven developers who want to handle complex file operations without leaving the CLI
DevOps and system administrators who need to quickly browse, edit, and manage files on remote servers
Aesthetics-minded developers looking for modern UI, rich themes, and customization in terminal tools
Cross-platform workers seeking a consistent file management experience across macOS, Linux, and Windows

zh.tag: 多平台自媒体数据采集利器
zh.what: MediaCrawler 是一个强大的多平台自媒体数据采集工具，支持小红书、抖音、快手、B站、微博、贴吧、知乎等主流平台的公开信息抓取。它基于 Playwright 浏览器自动化框架，无需逆向复杂的加密算法即可获取数据。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的爬虫代码、配置文件和文档，支持关键词搜索、指定帖子ID爬取、二级评论、创作者主页抓取、登录态缓存、IP代理池和评论词云图生成等功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，核心依赖 Playwright 浏览器自动化框架，使用 JS 表达式获取签名参数，无需逆向加密算法。
zh.hot: 今日新增 362 星，总星数 58176，排名 GitHub Trending 日榜第 6。因其覆盖多个热门中文平台且技术门槛低，受到数据采集和自媒体分析领域的广泛关注。
uses: 数据分析师 —— 采集多平台公开数据进行舆情分析、市场研究
自媒体运营者 —— 监控竞品内容、热点话题和用户评论
学术研究者 —— 获取社交媒体数据用于社会网络分析或自然语言处理研究
爬虫学习者 —— 学习基于 Playwright 的现代爬虫技术实践

en.tag: Multi-platform social media data scraper
en.what: MediaCrawler is a powerful multi-platform social media data scraper supporting public data extraction from platforms like Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, Bilibili, Weibo, Tieba, and Zhihu. It leverages Playwright for browser automation, eliminating the need for complex JS reverse engineering.
en.content: The repository includes complete crawler code, configuration files, and documentation, supporting keyword search, post ID scraping, secondary comments, creator profile scraping, login state caching, IP proxy pool, and comment word cloud generation.
en.stack: Built with Python, core dependency on Playwright for browser automation, uses JS expressions to obtain signature parameters without reverse engineering encryption algorithms.
en.hot: Gained 362 stars today, total 58,176, ranked #6 on GitHub Trending daily. Its coverage of multiple popular Chinese platforms and low technical barrier have attracted widespread attention in data scraping and social media analytics.
uses: Data analysts — collect public data from multiple platforms for sentiment analysis and market research
Social media operators — monitor competitor content, trending topics, and user comments
Academic researchers — obtain social media data for social network analysis or NLP research
Scraping learners — learn modern scraping techniques based on Playwright

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理打造的设计语言与技能集，终结千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风
zh.what: Impeccable 是一套面向 AI 编码代理（如 Claude、Cursor 等）的设计指导语言与 CLI 工具。它通过 23 条标准化命令和 46 条确定性检测规则，帮助 AI 在生成前端界面时摆脱千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风格，产出更具品牌感与专业度的设计。开发者只需在项目中运行初始化命令，即可建立包含品牌语境、视觉规范与组件库的设计上下文。
zh.content: 仓库包含可安装在 AI 工具中的核心技能包、用于本地检测的 CLI 与浏览器扩展，以及一套由 PRODUCT.md 和 DESIGN.md 驱动的设计上下文系统。整体以命令式交互为主，支持实时浏览器迭代与无需 LLM 的离线规则检测。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 构建，通过 npm 分发并以 npx 方式安装，同时提供浏览器扩展用于实时迭代检测。设计规则以确定性逻辑实现，可独立于 LLM 运行。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上已获得 47.7K Star，本周新增 2,331 星并跻身 Trending 周榜第 14 名，反映出开发者对「AI 生成前端同质化」的强烈痛点共鸣。它精准击中了当前 AI 编码工具产出界面千篇一律的普遍问题，提供了可落地的设计工程化方案。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 希望让 AI 助手生成更专业、不千篇一律的界面代码
独立创始人/产品经理 —— 需要快速建立品牌感强、视觉一致的产品界面
设计工程师 —— 想将设计规范转化为 AI 可执行的确定性规则与检测流程

en.tag: A design language and skillset for AI coding agents to escape generic SaaS templates
en.what: Impeccable is a design guidance language and CLI tool for AI coding agents like Claude and Cursor. It provides 23 standardized commands and 46 deterministic detection rules to help AI-generated frontend designs break away from generic SaaS templates and achieve stronger brand identity. Developers can set up a comprehensive design context—including brand voice, visual guidelines, and component libraries—through a single initialization command.
en.content: The repository includes a core skill package for AI tools, a CLI and browser extension for local auditing, and a design context system driven by PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md. It focuses on command-based interactions, supporting live browser iteration and offline deterministic rule checks without requiring an LLM or API key.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, distributed via npm and installed through npx, with a browser extension for real-time iteration and auditing. The design rules are implemented as deterministic logic that can run independently of any LLM or API key.
en.hot: With 47.7K stars and 2,331 new stars this week landing it at #14 on GitHub Trending, the project resonates strongly with developers frustrated by homogenized AI-generated frontend designs. It directly addresses the pain point of repetitive SaaS templates by offering a practical, engineering-grade design system for AI agents.
uses: Frontend developers who want their AI assistants to generate professional, non-generic UI code
Indie founders and product managers looking to quickly build brand-conscious, visually consistent interfaces
Design engineers seeking to convert design specifications into deterministic, AI-executable rules and audit workflows

zh.tag: 金融市场的首个开源基础模型
zh.what: Kronos 是一个专为金融市场 K 线序列设计的解码器基础模型。它通过两阶段框架：先用量化器将 OHLCV 数据转为层次化离散 token，再用自回归 Transformer 预训练，统一处理多种量化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型代码、预训练权重、微调脚本、论文及在线演示。提供 Hugging Face 模型和实时 BTC/USD 预测演示。
zh.stack: 基于 PyTorch 和 Transformer 架构，依赖 Hugging Face Transformers 和自定义 tokenizer。
zh.hot: 作为首个开源金融基础模型，被 AAAI 2026 接收，上线即获 3.2 万星标，展示强大预测能力。
uses: 量化研究员 —— 用于金融时间序列预测和因子挖掘
交易员 —— 辅助技术分析和策略回测
AI 开发者 —— 研究金融领域的 tokenization 和预训练方法

en.tag: First open-source foundation model for financial markets
en.what: Kronos is a decoder-only foundation model tailored for financial K-line sequences. It uses a two-stage framework: a specialized tokenizer quantizes OHLCV data into hierarchical discrete tokens, then an autoregressive Transformer is pre-trained to handle diverse quantitative tasks.
en.content: Repository includes model code, pretrained weights, fine-tuning scripts, paper, and a live demo. Hugging Face model and real-time BTC/USD forecast demo are available.
en.stack: Built on PyTorch and Transformer architecture, with Hugging Face Transformers and custom tokenizer.
en.hot: As the first open-source financial foundation model, accepted at AAAI 2026, it gained 32K stars upon release, demonstrating strong forecasting capability.
uses: Quantitative researchers — for financial time series forecasting and factor mining
Traders — for technical analysis and strategy backtesting
AI developers — for studying tokenization and pretraining in finance

zh.tag: 阿里巴巴开源的企业级AI代码审查CLI工具
zh.what: OpenCodeReview 是一款基于 AI 的代码审查 CLI 工具，起源于阿里巴巴集团内部，经过两年大规模验证，为数万开发者服务并发现数百万代码缺陷。它读取 Git diff，通过具备工具调用能力的 Agent 将变更文件发送给可配置的 LLM，生成精确到行的结构化审查评论。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具源码、内置精细调优的规则集（NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL注入等）、支持 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兼容接口，以及多语言文档和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Git 和 LLM API（OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容），支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent。
zh.hot: 作为阿里巴巴内部大规模验证的代码审查工具开源，结合确定性流水线和 LLM Agent 的混合架构，精准行级评论和内置规则集吸引了大量开发者，今日新增 162 星，总星数 10964。
uses: 开发团队 —— 集成到 CI/CD 流水线，自动审查代码提交，提升代码质量
个人开发者 —— 在本地运行审查，快速发现潜在缺陷和安全漏洞
开源维护者 —— 用于管理 PR 审查，减少人工负担

en.tag: Alibaba's battle-tested AI code review CLI with deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent
en.what: OpenCodeReview is an AI-powered code review CLI tool originating from Alibaba Group's internal system, serving tens of thousands of developers and identifying millions of code defects over two years. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates line-level structured review comments.
en.content: The repo contains Go CLI source code, built-in fine-tuned rulesets (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), support for OpenAI & Anthropic compatible APIs, and multi-language documentation and installation scripts.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, depends on Git and LLM APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic compatible), supports agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor.
en.hot: Open-sourced from Alibaba's battle-tested internal tool, its hybrid architecture of deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, and built-in rulesets have attracted many developers, gaining 162 stars today and 10964 total.
uses: Development teams — integrate into CI/CD pipelines for automated code review on commits, improving code quality
Individual developers — run locally for quick detection of potential defects and security vulnerabilities
Open source maintainers — manage PR reviews with reduced manual effort

zh.tag: 领先的开源自动化服务器，CI/CD 核心工具
zh.what: Jenkins 是一个基于 Java 的开源自动化服务器，用于持续集成和持续交付（CI/CD）。它通过丰富的插件生态支持构建、测试、部署等开发流程的自动化。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Jenkins 核心源码、文档、Docker 镜像构建脚本以及贡献指南。提供 WAR 文件、Docker 镜像、原生包等多种分发形式，并维护 Weekly 和 LTS 两个发布线。
zh.stack: 基于 Java 开发，使用 Maven 构建，依赖 Servlet 容器（如 Jetty）运行。插件采用 Java 或 Groovy 编写，通过插件管理器动态加载。
zh.hot: 作为 CI/CD 领域的标杆项目，Jenkins 拥有 25.7k Stars，今日新增 18 Stars 进入日榜第 16 名。其稳定性和 2000+ 插件生态持续吸引新老用户。
uses: 开发团队 —— 用于自动化构建、测试和部署流程，提升交付效率
DevOps 工程师 —— 搭建 CI/CD 流水线，集成各种工具链
开源项目维护者 —— 利用 Jenkins 实现持续集成，确保代码质量

en.tag: Leading open-source automation server, core CI/CD tool
en.what: Jenkins is a Java-based open-source automation server for continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD). It supports automating build, test, and deployment workflows through a vast plugin ecosystem.
en.content: The repository contains Jenkins core source code, documentation, Docker image build scripts, and contribution guidelines. It provides distributions as WAR files, Docker images, native packages, and maintains both Weekly and LTS release lines.
en.stack: Built with Java, uses Maven for build, runs on a Servlet container (e.g., Jetty). Plugins are written in Java or Groovy and loaded dynamically via the plugin manager.
en.hot: As a benchmark in CI/CD, Jenkins has 25.7k Stars, gaining 18 Stars today and ranking 16th on the daily trending list. Its stability and 2000+ plugin ecosystem continue to attract users.
uses: Development teams — automate build, test, and deployment pipelines to improve delivery efficiency
DevOps engineers — set up CI/CD pipelines and integrate various toolchains
Open-source maintainers — use Jenkins for continuous integration to ensure code quality

zh.tag: 让Claude具备看视频能力的Agent插件，一键解析任意视频
zh.what: 它通过 /watch 命令为 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 AI 助手赋予“观看”视频的能力。用户粘贴任意视频链接或本地路径后，它会自动下载、提取关键帧、获取时间戳字幕，并将视觉和音频信息完整交给 Claude 理解。最终让 AI 真正“看到”画面并“听到”内容，而非仅靠标题猜测。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 Python 的 /watch 插件核心源码，以及面向 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini CLI 等 50 余种 Agent Skills 平台的安装配置与文档。整体以命令行插件形态交付，采用零配置设计，首次运行时自动引导安装 yt-dlp 与 ffmpeg。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，使用 yt-dlp 负责视频下载，ffmpeg 处理帧提取与音视频分离，优先调用免费字幕接口，无字幕时回退至 OpenAI Whisper API。通过标准化插件协议与 Claude Code 等 Agent 环境集成。
zh.hot: 在 8992 颗 Star 的基础上本周再增 1876，跻身 GitHub Python 周榜第 15 名。它精准解决了 AI Agent 无法感知视频这一痛点，以零配置、多平台兼容和“真正看懂视频”的体验迅速获得开发者青睐。
uses: 内容创作者与营销人员：快速拆解竞品视频结构、分析热门视频开场钩子与广告创意
开发者与测试工程师：通过录屏诊断 Bug，让 AI 直接定位问题帧并分析故障原因
学习者与研究者：将长视频或课程播放列表转为可搜索的带时间戳笔记，跳过无效信息
产品经理与分析师：过滤发布会和更新视频中的营销话术，直接提取实质功能更新

en.tag: Agent plugin that gives Claude eyes: downloads, frames & transcribes any video
en.what: It gives Claude and other AI agents the ability to "watch" videos via a simple /watch command. The tool downloads the video, extracts scene-aware frames, pulls timestamped transcripts (free captions first, Whisper as fallback), and feeds everything to the AI. This lets Claude actually see what's on screen and hear the audio instead of guessing from titles or partial transcripts.
en.content: The repo contains the Python core of the /watch plugin, plus installation configs and docs for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI and over 50 Agent Skills hosts. It ships as a CLI plugin with zero-config setup, automatically installing yt-dlp and ffmpeg on first run.
en.stack: Built in Python, it relies on yt-dlp for video fetching, ffmpeg for frame extraction and audio demuxing, and falls back to the OpenAI Whisper API when free captions are unavailable. It integrates with agent environments via plugin protocols.
en.hot: With 8,992 stars and 1,876 added this week alone, it hit #15 on GitHub's Python Trending list. It solves the critical gap of AI agents being unable to perceive video, winning developers over with zero-config setup, multi-platform support, and a true "see-and-hear" experience.
uses: Content creators & marketers: analyze competitor video structures, viral hooks, and ad creatives
Developers & QA engineers: diagnose bugs from screen recordings by having the AI pinpoint issue frames
Learners & researchers: turn long videos or course playlists into searchable, timestamped notes
Product managers & analysts: strip hype from launch videos and extract substantive feature updates

zh.tag: 反重力优先的智能体工程工具包
zh.what: AG Kit 是一个以 Google Antigravity 为首选运行时的智能体工程工具包，提供规则、技能、专业智能体、工作流、持久记忆、MCP 指导、编排和原生安全钩子。它帮助开发者构建和管理复杂的 AI 代理系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 .agents/ 工作空间合约，包括规则、技能、工作流、20个角色定义、持久记忆、编排命令、MCP 配置和工具安全门控。还提供 CLI 工具、验证器、生产检查清单和迁移指南。
zh.stack: 主要技术栈：TypeScript、Node.js 22+、Python 3.10+、Google Antigravity 运行时。依赖 Git 进行安全更新和回滚。
zh.hot: 获得 7960 星标，日增 14 星，位居 GitHub Trending 日榜第 12 名。其反重力优先的设计和全面的智能体工程能力吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者 —— 快速搭建基于 Antigravity 的智能体系统
DevOps 工程师 —— 利用安全钩子和生产检查清单部署代理工作流
AI 研究员 —— 实验多智能体编排和持久记忆机制

en.tag: Antigravity-first agent engineering kit with rules, skills, workflows, and safety hooks
en.what: AG Kit is an agent engineering toolkit with Google Antigravity as the primary runtime, offering rules, skills, specialist agents, workflows, persistent memory, MCP guidance, orchestration, and a native safety hook. It helps developers build and manage complex AI agent systems.
en.content: The repo contains a complete .agents/ workspace contract with rules, skills, workflows, 20 role definitions, persistent memory, orchestration commands, MCP configuration, and tool safety gates. It also includes CLI tools, validators, a production checklist, and migration guide.
en.stack: Tech stack: TypeScript, Node.js 22+, Python 3.10+, Google Antigravity runtime. Requires Git for safe update and rollback.
en.hot: With 7960 stars and 14 new stars today, ranking #12 on GitHub Trending daily. Its Antigravity-first design and comprehensive agent engineering capabilities attract many developers.
uses: AI agent developers — quickly build Antigravity-based agent systems
DevOps engineers — deploy agent workflows with safety hooks and production checklist
AI researchers — experiment with multi-agent orchestration and persistent memory

zh.tag: 开源分布式 NoSQL 数据库，线性扩展与高容错
zh.what: Apache Cassandra 是一个高度可扩展的分布式数据库，采用分区行存储模型，支持跨多台机器透明分布数据。它提供类 SQL 的 CQL 查询语言，兼具关系数据库的易用性和 NoSQL 的弹性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cassandra 数据库的完整源代码、构建脚本（基于 Ant）、测试套件以及文档。主要组件包括存储引擎、分区器、集群管理工具和 CQL 解析器。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Java，依赖 Java 运行时环境，并提供 Python 客户端 cqlsh。构建系统使用 Apache Ant。
zh.hot: 作为 Apache 顶级项目，Cassandra 凭借其久经考验的线性扩展能力和高容错性，在分布式数据库领域持续受到关注。今日新增 11 星，GitHub Trending 日榜第 13 名。
uses: 大规模数据存储场景，如物联网、时序数据、消息队列等
需要高可用性和跨数据中心复制的企业级应用
云原生架构中作为可弹性伸缩的持久化层

en.tag: Open-source distributed NoSQL database with linear scalability and fault tolerance
en.what: Apache Cassandra is a highly scalable distributed database using a partitioned row store model, transparently distributing data across multiple machines. It offers a SQL-like query language (CQL), combining relational database ease of use with NoSQL elasticity.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, build scripts (Ant-based), test suites, and documentation for Cassandra. Key components include the storage engine, partitioner, cluster management tools, and CQL parser.
en.stack: Primarily written in Java, requiring a Java runtime environment, with a Python client (cqlsh). The build system uses Apache Ant.
en.hot: As an Apache top-level project, Cassandra continues to gain attention for its proven linear scalability and fault tolerance in distributed databases. It gained 11 stars today, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Large-scale data storage scenarios like IoT, time-series data, and message queues
Enterprise applications requiring high availability and cross-datacenter replication
Elastic persistence layer in cloud-native architectures

zh.tag: AI 代理驱动的跨平台搜索引擎，聚合真实用户投票
zh.what: 一个 AI 代理技能，能同时搜索 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket 等平台，根据点赞、转发、投注等真实用户信号对结果评分，并生成综合摘要。它打破了各平台的数据孤岛，提供传统搜索引擎无法获取的深度洞察。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心技能定义（SKILL.md）、安装脚本和配置向导。支持通过 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 50+ 代理宿主安装，零配置即可使用，30 秒内可解锁更多平台。
zh.stack: Python 为主，依赖各平台 API（Reddit、X、YouTube 等）和浏览器会话。通过 npx 或插件市场分发，兼容主流 AI 代理框架。
zh.hot: 54k+ Stars 说明它精准抓住了用户对跨平台真实信息聚合的需求，解决了传统搜索和单一 AI 无法覆盖的痛点。
uses: 研究人员 —— 快速获取某个话题在多个社交平台上的真实讨论热度
投资者/交易员 —— 利用 Polymarket 赔率和社交媒体情绪辅助决策
内容创作者 —— 追踪热点趋势，发现 Reddit、X、YouTube 上的爆款内容
普通用户 —— 想了解某人或某事的近期动态，而非过时的百科信息

en.tag: AI agent-led search engine that aggregates real user votes across platforms
en.what: An AI agent skill that searches Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web in parallel, scores results by real user signals (upvotes, likes, bets), and synthesizes a grounded summary. It bridges walled gardens to deliver insights no single search engine can.
en.content: Contains the core skill spec (SKILL.md), installation scripts, and a setup wizard. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 50+ agent hosts; zero config for basic use, 30s to unlock more platforms.
en.stack: Python-based, integrates with platform APIs (Reddit, X, YouTube) and browser sessions. Distributed via npx or plugin marketplace, compatible with major AI agent frameworks.
en.hot: 54k+ stars show it hits a real need for cross-platform real-signal aggregation, solving a pain point that traditional search and single AI can't address.
uses: Researchers — quickly gauge real discussion heat on a topic across multiple social platforms
Investors/traders — leverage Polymarket odds and social sentiment for decision-making
Content creators — track trending topics and discover viral content on Reddit, X, YouTube
General users — get recent activity on a person or topic, not outdated encyclopedia entries

zh.tag: C++即时模式GUI库，轻量无依赖，专为工具与调试界面而生
zh.what: Dear ImGui 是一个无冗余、自包含的 C++ 即时模式图形用户界面库，专注于为开发者提供内容创作与调试工具的快速迭代能力。它输出优化后的顶点缓冲区，可无缝集成到现有 3D 渲染管线中，无需外部依赖。与传统保留模式 UI 不同，它更适合构建高性能的内部工具、可视化面板和调试窗口。
zh.content: 仓库以核心头文件与单文件源码（imgui.h / imgui.cpp）为主体，并附带大量官方渲染后端与平台绑定（DirectX、OpenGL、Vulkan、Metal、GLFW、SDL、Win32 等）。同时提供开箱即用的示例程序、综合 Demo 窗口、文档 Wiki，以及独立的 imgui_test_engine 测试引擎。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 编写，自包含且无任何外部依赖；通过可插拔后端接入 DirectX、OpenGL、Vulkan、Metal、WebGPU 等现代图形 API，并可绑定至 GLFW、SDL、Win32 等窗口系统。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 生态中事实标准的工具型 UI 方案，Dear ImGui 已积累 74.7K Stars，本月新增 338 星并位列 Trending 月榜第 13。它几乎被所有主流游戏引擎和 3D 工具链采用，填补了高性能即时调试界面的长期空白。
uses: 游戏/图形引擎开发者 —— 为自研引擎快速搭建关卡编辑器、材质调试与性能分析面板
实时可视化与监控工具 —— 构建机器人、量化交易、嵌入式系统的实时数据看板
桌面工具软件作者 —— 为 C++ 桌面程序创建轻量、可移植的 ImGui 原生界面
算法与科研调试 —— 在图形/仿真/AI 训练过程中快速可视化参数与中间状态

en.tag: Bloat-free immediate-mode GUI library for C++ with minimal dependencies
en.what: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free, self-contained immediate-mode GUI library for C++ that empowers developers to build content creation and debugging tools with rapid iteration. It outputs optimized vertex buffers that can be rendered directly into any 3D pipeline, requiring zero external dependencies. Unlike retained-mode UI libraries, it is purpose-built for high-performance internal tools, visualizers, and debug windows.
en.content: The repository centers on core single-file headers (imgui.h / imgui.cpp) and ships with official renderer backends and platform bindings (DirectX, OpenGL, Vulkan, Metal, GLFW, SDL, Win32, etc.). It also includes ready-to-run examples, a comprehensive demo window, extensive documentation, and a separate imgui_test_engine for automated testing.
en.stack: Written in pure C++ with zero external dependencies; integrates with modern graphics APIs via swappable backends for DirectX, OpenGL, Vulkan, Metal, and WebGPU, alongside platform bindings for GLFW, SDL, and Win32.
en.hot: With 74.7K Stars and 338 new stars this month (ranking 13th on the monthly GitHub Trending), Dear ImGui is the de-facto standard for tooling UIs in C++. It is adopted by virtually every major game engine and 3D toolchain, filling a long-standing gap for high-performance immediate-mode debugging interfaces.
uses: Game/graphics engine developers — rapidly build level editors, material debuggers, and profiling dashboards for custom engines
Real-time visualization & monitoring — create live data dashboards for robotics, quant trading, and embedded systems
Desktop tool builders — craft lightweight, portable native UIs for C++ applications without heavy framework overhead
Algorithm & research debugging — visualize parameters and intermediate states during graphics, simulation, or AI training runs

zh.tag: 多AI提供商统一接口库，驱动桌面AI助手
zh.what: aisuite 是一个轻量级 Python 库，为多个生成式 AI 提供商提供统一的聊天补全 API 和代理 API。它支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等主流模型，并内置工具和工具包系统，可用于构建 AI 代理。该项目还衍生出 OpenWorker，一个基于 aisuite 构建的桌面 AI 助手。
zh.content: 仓库包含 aisuite 核心库（统一 API 层、代理 API、工具包）以及 OpenWorker 的遗留代码。核心库提供简洁的接口，支持通过更改字符串切换提供商，并包含多轮代理循环、MCP 服务器集成等功能。
zh.stack: Python 库，依赖各提供商 SDK（如 openai、anthropic、google-generativeai）以及可选工具包。支持 Ollama 本地运行。
zh.hot: 由 AI 领域知名人物 Andrew Ng 创建，提供极简的多模型统一接口，降低了开发 AI 应用的门槛。15k+ 星标，今日新增 77，热度持续。
uses: AI 开发者：快速集成多种 LLM 提供商，统一 API 调用
代理构建者：利用工具包和 MCP 构建多步骤 AI 代理
桌面用户：通过 OpenWorker 获得本地 AI 助手，执行文件操作、邮件等任务

en.tag: Unified API for multiple LLM providers, powering a desktop AI coworker
en.what: aisuite is a lightweight Python library that provides a unified Chat Completions API and Agents API across multiple generative AI providers. It supports major providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and includes a tool/toolkit system for building AI agents. The project also powers OpenWorker, a desktop AI coworker built on aisuite.
en.content: The repo contains the aisuite core library (unified API layer, Agents API, toolkits) and legacy code for OpenWorker. The core library offers a simple interface to switch providers by changing a string, and includes multi-turn agent loops, MCP server integration, and more.
en.stack: Python library, depends on provider SDKs (e.g., openai, anthropic, google-generativeai) and optional toolkits. Supports local execution via Ollama.
en.hot: Created by renowned AI figure Andrew Ng, it offers a minimal unified interface for multiple models, lowering the barrier to building AI apps. 15k+ stars with 77 new today, maintaining strong momentum.
uses: AI developers: quickly integrate multiple LLM providers with a unified API
Agent builders: leverage toolkits and MCP to build multi-step AI agents
Desktop users: get a local AI coworker via OpenWorker for file operations, email, etc.

zh.tag: 开源AI自动化渗透测试工具，自主发现并修复应用漏洞
zh.what: Strix 是一个开源的 AI 渗透测试平台，通过自主 AI 代理动态运行代码，像真实黑客一样侦察、利用并验证应用漏洞。它通过生成实际的可利用 Proof-of-Concept 来确认漏洞，而非仅依赖静态分析的误报，并支持多代理协作规模化执行安全测试。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的渗透测试工具包，支持侦察、漏洞利用与验证开箱即用；同时提供 GitHub Actions 集成与 CI/CD 流水线插件，可自动扫描 Pull Request 并在代码合并前阻断不安全提交。
zh.stack: 项目以 Python 为主要语言构建，支持通过 PyPI 分发安装（strix-agent），并依赖现代 AI 代理编排框架实现多智能体协作；可与现有 DevOps 工具链深度集成。
zh.hot: 该项目月增 16,488 Star 跃至 GitHub 月榜第 5 名，总星数突破 42,318；其“AI + 动态 PoC 验证”模式精准击中了传统静态扫描误报率高、人工渗透测试成本高的痛点，成为安全左移趋势下的热门方案。
uses: 开发团队 —— 在 CI/CD 中自动化安全扫描，在代码合并前拦截漏洞
安全工程师 —— 利用多 AI 代理协作执行大规模渗透测试与漏洞验证
DevOps/平台团队 —— 将安全左移，无需额外基础设施即可接入现有流水线

en.tag: Open-source autonomous AI pentesting agents that find and fix app vulnerabilities
en.what: Strix is an open-source AI-powered penetration testing platform where autonomous agents dynamically run code to discover and validate vulnerabilities like real hackers. It generates working proofs-of-concept rather than static-analysis false positives, and scales through multi-agent orchestration for collaborative security testing.
en.content: The repository ships with a full pentesting toolkit covering reconnaissance, exploitation, and validation out of the box. It also provides GitHub Actions integration and CI/CD pipeline plugins to auto-scan pull requests and block insecure code before it reaches production.
en.stack: Built primarily in Python and distributed via PyPI as strix-agent, it relies on modern AI agent orchestration frameworks for multi-agent collaboration and deep integration with existing DevOps toolchains.
en.hot: With 16,488 new stars this month and a #5 spot on GitHub Trending, it has climbed to 42,318 total stars. Its “AI + dynamic PoC validation” model directly addresses the high false-positive rates of legacy scanners and the cost of manual pentesting, making it a standout in the shift-left security movement.
uses: Development teams — Automate security scanning in CI/CD to intercept vulnerabilities before code merges.
Security engineers — Leverage multi-agent AI collaboration for large-scale pentesting and real exploit validation.
DevOps/platform teams — Shift security left by plugging into existing pipelines with zero additional infrastructure.

zh.tag: 开源私有AI平台，构建智能代理与企业搜索
zh.what: DocsGPT 是一个开源的私有AI平台，用于构建智能代理和助手。它提供代理构建器、深度研究工具、文档分析（PDF、Office、网页、音频）以及多模型支持，并允许通过API连接代理与外部工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的AI平台代码，包括前端界面、后端服务、代理构建器、文档分析引擎、多模型集成以及API接口。支持本地部署或云版本，并提供丰富的预构建集成（如HTML/React聊天小部件）。
zh.stack: 技术栈以Python为主，后端可能使用FastAPI或Flask，前端使用React或Vue。依赖包括LLM推理框架、向量数据库（如Chroma或Pinecone）、以及文档解析库（如PyMuPDF、python-docx）。
zh.hot: 凭借18K+ Stars和日增48星的热度，DocsGPT因提供私有化、可定制的AI代理平台而受到关注，满足企业对数据隐私和灵活部署的需求。
uses: 企业团队 —— 构建内部知识库搜索和智能助手，保护数据隐私
开发者 —— 快速搭建自定义AI代理，集成到现有工作流
研究人员 —— 利用深度研究工具分析大量文档和音频
产品团队 —— 通过API和预构建小部件为应用添加AI功能

en.tag: Open-source private AI platform for building agents, assistants, and enterprise search
en.what: DocsGPT is an open-source private AI platform for building intelligent agents and assistants. It features an Agent Builder, deep research tools, document analysis (PDF, Office, web, audio), multi-model support, and API connectivity for agents with actionable tools.

zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Flutter 用于跨平台 UI，使用 Sciter 或原生 GUI。服务器端基于 Rust 的异步网络框架。
zh.hot: 拥有 119k+ Stars，今日新增 121，因其完全开源、自托管、隐私安全且性能优异，成为 TeamViewer 等商业软件的热门替代。
uses: 个人用户：需要安全远程访问家庭或办公电脑
企业 IT：自建远程支持平台，保障数据隐私
开发者：定制远程桌面功能或集成到自有系统

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop, self-hosted alternative to TeamViewer
en.what: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application written in Rust, working out of the box with no configuration. It gives users full control over their data and supports self-hosted rendezvous/relay servers, serving as a privacy-friendly alternative to TeamViewer.
en.content: The repository contains full client and server code, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and more. It offers binary downloads, Docker build instructions, and multilingual translation files.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with Flutter for cross-platform UI and Sciter or native GUI. The server side uses Rust's async networking framework.
en.hot: With 119k+ stars and 121 new today, it's a hot alternative to commercial software like TeamViewer due to its fully open-source, self-hosted, privacy-focused, and high-performance nature.
uses: Individual users: secure remote access to home or office computers
Enterprise IT: self-hosted remote support platform with data privacy
Developers: customize remote desktop features or integrate into own systems

zh.tag: 生产级 Rust 原生量化交易引擎，确定性事件驱动架构
zh.what: NautilusTrader 是一个高性能、生产级的开源量化交易引擎，采用 Rust 原生开发，提供确定性事件驱动架构。它支持回测、实盘交易和多种数据源集成，旨在为算法交易者提供快速、可靠的基础设施。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的交易引擎核心、适配器（如 Binance、Interactive Brokers）、回测框架、数据加载工具以及 Python 绑定。提供 CLI 工具和 Docker 支持，便于部署。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，利用其零成本抽象和内存安全；提供 Python 绑定（通过 PyO3），支持 Python 策略开发。依赖包括 tokio 异步运行时、arrow 数据格式等。
zh.hot: 凭借 Rust 的高性能和确定性架构，在量化交易社区中迅速走红，Star 数已超 2.5 万，今日新增 49，稳居 Rust 趋势榜。
uses: 量化交易开发者 —— 构建和回测高频交易策略
金融科技公司 —— 部署生产级交易系统
研究人员 —— 分析市场数据和交易算法
加密货币交易者 —— 连接交易所进行自动化交易

en.tag: Production-grade Rust-native algorithmic trading engine with deterministic event-driven architecture
en.what: NautilusTrader is a high-performance, production-grade open-source algorithmic trading engine built in Rust with a deterministic event-driven architecture. It supports backtesting, live trading, and integration with multiple data sources, aiming to provide fast and reliable infrastructure for algorithmic traders.
en.content: The repository includes the core trading engine, adapters (e.g., Binance, Interactive Brokers), backtesting framework, data loading tools, and Python bindings. CLI tools and Docker support are provided for easy deployment.
en.stack: Core written in Rust, leveraging zero-cost abstractions and memory safety; provides Python bindings via PyO3 for strategy development. Dependencies include tokio async runtime, arrow data format, etc.
en.hot: With Rust's high performance and deterministic architecture, it has rapidly gained popularity in the algorithmic trading community, surpassing 25K stars with 49 new stars today, firmly on the Rust trending list.
uses: Quantitative trading developers — build and backtest high-frequency trading strategies
Fintech companies — deploy production-grade trading systems
Researchers — analyze market data and trading algorithms
Cryptocurrency traders — connect to exchanges for automated trading

zh.tag: 基于公钥寻址的 QUIC + NAT 穿透网络库
zh.what: Iroh 是一个网络库，允许应用通过公钥（而非 IP 地址）进行连接。它自动处理 NAT 穿透和连接维护，确保最快路径。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 iroh 库、示例代码以及基于 iroh 构建的协议（如 iroh-blobs、iroh-gossip、iroh-docs）。提供 Rust API 和 CLI 工具。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，基于 QUIC（通过 noq 库）实现，利用 BLAKE3 哈希进行内容寻址。
zh.hot: Iroh 解决了 P2P 连接中的 IP 易变和 NAT 穿透难题，提供简洁的公钥拨号 API，吸引了大量关注。当前 11850 Stars，日增 10。
uses: 去中心化应用开发者 —— 需要可靠 P2P 连接，无需管理 IP 地址
物联网设备 —— 设备间直接通信，绕过 NAT 限制
文件同步与分享 —— 使用 iroh-blobs 进行大规模内容寻址传输

en.tag: A Rust library for QUIC + NAT traversal with public-key addressing
en.what: Iroh is a networking library that lets apps connect via public keys instead of IP addresses. It handles NAT traversal and connection maintenance automatically, ensuring the fastest path.
en.content: The repo contains the core iroh library, examples, and protocols built on iroh (iroh-blobs, iroh-gossip, iroh-docs). It provides Rust API and CLI tools.
en.stack: Written in Rust, built on QUIC (via the noq library), and uses BLAKE3 hashing for content addressing.
en.hot: Iroh solves the pain of changing IPs and NAT traversal in P2P connections with a simple public-key dialing API, gaining significant traction. Currently 11,850 stars, +10 today.
uses: Decentralized app developers — need reliable P2P connections without managing IPs
IoT devices — direct device-to-device communication bypassing NAT
File sync and sharing — use iroh-blobs for large-scale content-addressed transfer

zh.tag: 终端里的 AI 编码代理 Token 追踪与全球排行榜
zh.what: 一个高性能 CLI 工具和可视化仪表盘，用于追踪多个 AI 编码代理的 Token 使用量和成本。支持跨平台，提供原生 Rust TUI 界面。
zh.content: 包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具、TUI 界面以及一个全球排行榜，追踪数万亿 Token 的使用情况。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 构建，提供 npm 包安装方式，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码代理的普及，开发者迫切需要追踪 Token 消耗的工具。Tokscale 以 4659 Stars 迅速走红，日增 29 Stars，登上 Rust 日榜第 19 名。
uses: AI 编码代理用户 —— 监控 Token 消耗和成本
开发者 —— 优化 AI 工具使用效率
团队管理者 —— 追踪团队 AI 使用情况

en.tag: Track AI coding agent token usage from terminal with global leaderboard
en.what: A high-performance CLI tool and visualization dashboard for tracking token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents. Features a native Rust TUI and cross-platform support.
en.content: Includes a Rust CLI tool, TUI interface, and a global leaderboard tracking quadrillions of tokens.
en.stack: Built primarily with Rust, available via npm, cross-platform.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, developers urgently need token tracking tools. Tokscale gained 4659 stars rapidly (+29 daily), ranking #19 on Rust daily trending.
uses: AI coding agent users — monitor token usage and costs
Developers — optimize AI tool efficiency
Team managers — track team AI usage

zh.tag: 一种新型的现代化 Shell，结构化管道与数据驱动
zh.what: Nushell 是一种新型的 Shell，它采用结构化数据管道，将命令输出视为表格或列表，支持类似 SQL 的查询、过滤和操作。它旨在提供比传统 Bash/Zsh 更直观、更强大的命令行体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Nushell 核心引擎、内置命令、插件系统、配置文件示例以及详细的文档和书籍。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 crates.io 生态，支持跨平台（Linux/macOS/Windows），可通过包管理器安装。
zh.hot: Nushell 以 4 万+ Star 成为最受欢迎的现代 Shell 之一，其结构化管道理念吸引了大量寻求替代传统 Shell 的开发者。
uses: 希望提升命令行效率的开发者 —— 利用结构化数据管道替代文本解析
数据工程师/分析师 —— 直接在终端中处理 CSV、JSON 等结构化数据
Rust 爱好者 —— 学习 Rust 构建 CLI 工具的最佳实践

en.tag: A modern shell with structured pipelines and data-driven design
en.what: Nushell is a new type of shell that treats command output as structured data (tables/lists), enabling SQL-like queries, filtering, and manipulation. It aims to provide a more intuitive and powerful command-line experience than traditional Bash/Zsh.
en.content: The repo includes the Nushell core engine, built-in commands, plugin system, sample config files, and comprehensive documentation including a book.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem, cross-platform (Linux/macOS/Windows), installable via package managers.
en.hot: With 40K+ stars, Nushell is one of the most popular modern shells, attracting developers seeking an alternative to traditional shells with its structured pipeline concept.
uses: Developers seeking more efficient command-line workflows — replace text parsing with structured data pipelines
Data engineers/analysts — process CSV, JSON, and other structured data directly in the terminal
Rust enthusiasts — learn best practices for building CLI tools in Rust

zh.tag: 基于AST的代码搜索、lint与重写CLI工具
zh.what: ast-grep 是一个基于抽象语法树（AST）的代码搜索、lint 和重写工具。它允许用户像写普通代码一样编写模式，匹配具有相同语法结构的代码，支持通配符。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 CLI 工具源码、文档和在线 playground。支持多种安装方式（npm、pip、cargo、homebrew 等）。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 tree-sitter 进行 AST 解析，支持多种编程语言。
zh.hot: ast-grep 提供比传统 grep 更精确的代码搜索能力，受到开发者欢迎。当前 15k+ Stars，今日新增 44，在 Rust 日榜排名第 21。
uses: 开发者进行代码库级别的模式搜索和重构
CI/CD 流程中用于代码 lint 和自动化重写
学习 AST 和代码分析的教学工具

en.tag: AST-based CLI tool for code structural search, linting, and rewriting
en.what: ast-grep is an AST-based CLI tool for code structural search, linting, and rewriting. It lets users write patterns as ordinary code, matching code with the same syntactic structure, with support for wildcards.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust CLI tool source code, documentation, and an online playground. It supports multiple installation methods (npm, pip, cargo, homebrew, etc.).
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging tree-sitter for AST parsing, supporting multiple programming languages.
en.hot: ast-grep offers more precise code search than traditional grep, gaining popularity among developers. It has 15k+ Stars, 44 new today, ranking #21 on Rust daily trending.
uses: Developers for codebase-wide pattern search and refactoring
CI/CD pipelines for code linting and automated rewriting
Educational tool for learning AST and code analysis

zh.tag: 云原生微服务电商演示应用
zh.what: 这是一个云优先的微服务演示应用，模拟在线电商平台，用户可浏览商品、加入购物车并购买。Google 用此应用展示如何使用 Google Cloud 产品（如 GKE、Cloud Service Mesh、gRPC 等）实现企业应用现代化。
zh.content: 仓库包含 11 个微服务（Go、C#、Node.js、Python 编写），通过 gRPC 通信，并配有 Kubernetes 部署清单、Istio 配置和持续集成工作流。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 Go、C#、Node.js、Python、gRPC、Kubernetes、Istio、Redis、Google Cloud 产品（GKE、Cloud Service Mesh、Spanner、Memorystore、AlloyDB 等）。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方出品的云原生微服务参考架构，拥有 20733 星，今日新增 64 星，是 Go 语言日榜第 3 名，持续吸引云原生开发者学习与借鉴。
uses: 云原生开发者 —— 学习微服务架构设计与 Kubernetes 部署最佳实践
Google Cloud 用户 —— 了解 GKE、Cloud Service Mesh 等产品集成方式
技术讲师/培训师 —— 作为微服务演示案例用于教学
架构师 —— 评估云原生技术栈和微服务拆分模式

en.tag: Cloud-native microservices demo e-commerce app
en.what: This is a cloud-first microservices demo application simulating an online e-commerce store where users can browse items, add them to cart, and purchase. Google uses it to demonstrate how to modernize enterprise applications using Google Cloud products like GKE, Cloud Service Mesh, gRPC, etc.
en.content: The repository contains 11 microservices (written in Go, C#, Node.js, Python) communicating via gRPC, along with Kubernetes manifests, Istio configuration, and CI workflows.
en.stack: Tech stack includes Go, C#, Node.js, Python, gRPC, Kubernetes, Istio, Redis, and Google Cloud products (GKE, Cloud Service Mesh, Spanner, Memorystore, AlloyDB, etc.).
en.hot: As Google's official cloud-native microservices reference architecture, it has 20,733 stars (64 today), ranking 3rd on Go daily trending. It continuously attracts cloud-native developers for learning and reference.
uses: Cloud-native developers — learn microservice architecture design and Kubernetes deployment best practices
Google Cloud users — understand integration of GKE, Cloud Service Mesh, etc.
Tech instructors/trainers — use as a microservices demo for teaching
Architects — evaluate cloud-native tech stacks and microservice decomposition patterns

zh.tag: AI API 订阅配额中转与拼车共享平台
zh.what: Sub2API 是一款开源中转服务，将 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Grok 等主流 AI 订阅统一接入单一平台。通过配额分发与拼车共享机制，帮助用户高效分摊订阅成本，并支持 Claude Code、Codex 等原生工具无缝调用。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 Go 的 API 网关后端、Vue 3 前端管理界面，以及 Docker 部署配置。项目提供多语言文档、赞助商展示模块，并内置 PostgreSQL 与 Redis 的存储和缓存支持。
zh.stack: 后端基于 Go 1.25+ 构建，前端采用 Vue 3.4+，数据层依赖 PostgreSQL 15+ 与 Redis 7+，并通过 Docker 提供一键部署能力。
zh.hot: 凭借 32.7k Star 和本周新增 1416 Star 的增速，该项目精准切中 AI 开发者对多模型聚合与低成本共享订阅的刚需；其开源中转架构和「拼车」模式大幅降低了个人与团队使用顶级 AI 模型的门槛。
uses: 拥有多平台 AI 订阅但希望统一管理和分发配额的开发者或团队
希望以「拼车」方式分摊 Claude、OpenAI 等高昂订阅成本的个人用户
需要在 Claude Code、Codex 等原生工具中无缝切换多模型 API 的工程师

en.tag: AI API Gateway for Subscription Quota Sharing & Cost Splitting
en.what: Sub2API is an open-source relay gateway that unifies access to Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok and other AI subscriptions under one platform. It distributes subscription quotas and supports ride-sharing-style cost splitting to reduce individual expenses, while allowing native tools like Claude Code and Codex to work seamlessly.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based backend API gateway, a Vue 3 frontend admin panel, and Docker deployment configurations. It ships with multi-language documentation, sponsor modules, and built-in PostgreSQL and Redis support for storage and caching.
en.stack: Backend is built with Go 1.25+, frontend uses Vue 3.4+, with PostgreSQL 15+ and Redis 7+ handling data and caching, and Docker providing one-click deployment.
en.hot: With 32.7k stars and 1,416 new stars this week, it hits a strong demand for multi-model aggregation and low-cost subscription sharing among AI developers; its open-source relay architecture and ride-sharing model significantly lower the barrier to using top-tier AI models.
uses: Developers or teams managing multiple AI subscriptions who need unified quota distribution
Individual users looking to split high subscription costs for Claude, OpenAI, and others via ride-sharing
Engineers who want seamless multi-model API switching within native tools like Claude Code and Codex

zh.tag: 域名爬虫与敏感信息扫描器
zh.what: Cariddi 是一款用 Go 编写的自动化安全扫描工具。它接收域名列表，爬取所有关联 URL，然后扫描其中的端点、密钥、API 密钥、文件扩展名、令牌等敏感信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cariddi 的源代码、安装脚本（Homebrew、Snap、Go、Pacman、NixOS 等）、使用示例和文档。核心是一个命令行工具，支持管道输入和多种输出格式。
zh.stack: Go 语言开发，依赖标准库及少量第三方包（如 goquery 用于 HTML 解析）。支持跨平台编译（Linux、Windows、macOS）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 28 星，总星数 3595，位列 Go 语言日榜第 5。作为一款轻量级但功能强大的安全扫描工具，它吸引了安全研究人员和渗透测试人员的关注。
uses: 安全研究人员 —— 快速发现目标站点的敏感信息泄露
渗透测试人员 —— 在授权测试中自动化信息收集
Bug Bounty 猎人 —— 扫描子域名和端点以寻找漏洞入口
DevOps 工程师 —— 检查内部服务是否暴露了密钥或令牌

en.tag: Crawl domains and scan for endpoints, secrets, API keys, and more
en.what: Cariddi is an automated security scanner written in Go. It takes a list of domains, crawls all associated URLs, and scans for endpoints, secrets, API keys, file extensions, tokens, and other sensitive information.
en.content: The repository contains Cariddi's source code, installation scripts (Homebrew, Snap, Go, Pacman, NixOS, etc.), usage examples, and documentation. The core is a CLI tool that supports piped input and multiple output formats.
en.stack: Developed in Go, relying on the standard library and a few third-party packages (e.g., goquery for HTML parsing). Supports cross-platform compilation (Linux, Windows, macOS).
en.hot: Gained 28 stars today, total 3595, ranking 5th on Go daily trending. As a lightweight yet powerful security scanner, it attracts security researchers and penetration testers.
uses: Security researchers — quickly discover sensitive information leaks on target sites
Penetration testers — automate information gathering in authorized tests
Bug bounty hunters — scan subdomains and endpoints for vulnerability entry points
DevOps engineers — check if internal services expose keys or tokens

zh.tag: 用 Go 和 Web 技术构建桌面应用
zh.what: Wails 允许开发者使用 Go 编写后端逻辑，并结合任意前端技术（如 React、Vue）构建跨平台桌面应用。它将 Go 代码和 Web 前端打包成一个单一二进制文件，无需内嵌 Web 服务器。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Wails CLI 工具、核心运行时库、模板项目以及丰富的文档和示例。提供了项目创建、编译和打包的完整工具链。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go，前端支持任何 Web 技术（React、Vue、Svelte 等），利用系统原生 WebView 渲染。依赖 Go 标准库和系统 WebView 组件。
zh.hot: Wails 提供了一种轻量、高效的桌面应用开发方式，让 Go 开发者无需学习 Electron 即可构建原生界面。今日新增 81 星，总星数超 35.5k，在 Go 生态中持续受到关注。
uses: Go 开发者希望用熟悉的语言构建跨平台桌面应用
需要轻量级替代 Electron 的桌面应用场景
快速原型开发或构建工具类桌面应用

en.tag: Build desktop applications using Go & Web Technologies
en.what: Wails enables developers to write backend logic in Go and combine it with any frontend technology (e.g., React, Vue) to build cross-platform desktop applications. It wraps Go code and a web frontend into a single binary without requiring a built-in web server.
en.content: The repository includes the Wails CLI tool, core runtime library, project templates, and extensive documentation and examples. It provides a complete toolchain for project creation, compilation, and bundling.
en.stack: Backend uses Go, frontend supports any web technology (React, Vue, Svelte, etc.), leveraging the system's native WebView for rendering. Depends on Go standard library and system WebView components.
en.hot: Wails offers a lightweight and efficient way to build desktop apps, allowing Go developers to create native UIs without learning Electron. With 81 new stars today and over 35.5k total stars, it continues to gain traction in the Go ecosystem.
uses: Go developers who want to build cross-platform desktop apps using their familiar language
Scenarios requiring a lightweight alternative to Electron for desktop apps
Rapid prototyping or building tool-type desktop applications

zh.tag: 基于 YAML 模板的快速漏洞扫描器，安全社区驱动
zh.what: Nuclei 是一款高性能的漏洞扫描工具，通过简洁的 YAML 领域特定语言让全球安全社区协作编写检测模板。它能够快速发现应用程序、API、网络、DNS 及云配置中的安全漏洞，并以极低的误报率模拟真实攻击场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心扫描引擎、YAML 模板解析器、丰富的官方模板库以及多协议支持模块（HTTP/DNS/TCP/SSL 等），同时提供完善的 CLI 工具和 SDK 集成接口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言编写，依托 YAML 模板引擎实现漏洞检测逻辑。支持跨平台运行并可与 CI/CD 流程及各类云原生工具链无缝集成。
zh.hot: 凭借 29,811 Stars 和本周新增 228 Stars 的热度，Nuclei 已成为安全社区事实上的漏洞扫描标准。其 YAML 模板生态让全球研究者能够实时响应最新漏洞，实现了「当天漏洞、当天检测」的协作式安全防御。
uses: 企业安全团队 —— 用于资产梳理、漏洞巡检与红蓝对抗演练
渗透测试工程师 —— 快速验证目标环境中已知 CVE 与配置缺陷
DevSecOps 工程师 —— 集成至 CI/CD 流水线实现自动化安全左移
安全研究员 —— 编写并共享 YAML 模板，跟踪分析最新漏洞趋势

en.tag: Fast, community-powered vulnerability scanner using YAML templates
en.what: Nuclei is a high-performance vulnerability scanner that uses a simple YAML-based DSL to enable global security collaboration on detection templates. It rapidly identifies vulnerabilities across applications, APIs, networks, DNS, and cloud configurations while mimicking real-world attack scenarios with minimal false positives.
en.content: The repository houses the core scanning engine, YAML template parser, extensive official template libraries, and multi-protocol support modules (HTTP/DNS/TCP/SSL), along with a comprehensive CLI tool and SDK integration interfaces.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, it relies on a YAML template engine for vulnerability detection logic. It supports cross-platform execution and integrates seamlessly with CI/CD pipelines and various cloud-native toolchains.
en.hot: With 29,811 Stars and 228 new Stars this week, Nuclei has become the de facto standard for community-driven vulnerability scanning. Its YAML template ecosystem allows global researchers to respond to emerging threats in real time, enabling same-day detection of trending vulnerabilities through collaborative security defense.
uses: Enterprise security teams — for asset inventory, vulnerability patrols, and red/blue team exercises

zh.tag: Go 注释自动生成 Swagger 2.0 API 文档

zh.stack: 纯 Go 实现，依赖 Go 标准库及 go/ast 用于解析注释。可选集成 Swagger UI 前端。

en.tag: Automatically generate Swagger 2.0 RESTful API docs from Go annotations

API doc maintainers — keep docs in sync with code via annotations, preventing outdated docs
Team collaboration — integrate with Swagger UI for interactive API testing

zh.tag: 跨平台 C++ 异步网络与底层 I/O 基础设施库
zh.what: Asio 是一个跨平台的 C++ 库，专注于提供异步网络与底层 I/O 编程能力，统一封装了各操作系统的复杂原生 API。开发者可用它高效构建 TCP/UDP 套接字、串口通信及定时器等组件，广泛应用于高并发服务器、实时系统和嵌入式通信场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含头文件-only 与源码编译两种形态的完整实现，以及示例程序、单元测试和离线 HTML 文档。根目录按 src、include、doc、example 组织，便于直接集成或打包构建。

uses: 需要构建高并发网络服务或实时通信系统的后端 C++ 开发者
追求跨平台一致 API、不想直接编写操作系统原生 I/O 代码的嵌入式/工具链团队

en.tag: Cross-platform C++ library for asynchronous networking and low-level I/O
en.what: Asio is a cross-platform C++ library for network and low-level I/O programming, offering a consistent asynchronous model across operating systems. It abstracts complex native APIs into composable components like TCP/UDP sockets, serial ports, and timers, making it ideal for high-concurrency servers and real-time systems.
en.content: The repository ships the library in both header-only and compiled source forms, alongside examples, unit tests, and offline HTML documentation. It is organized under src, include, doc, and example directories for easy integration or packaging.
en.stack: Written in modern C++ (C++11 and up) with zero mandatory dependencies—optionally interoperable with Boost—and supports Linux, Windows, macOS, and embedded targets. Build systems include Autotools, CMake, and plain Makefiles for broad toolchain compatibility.
en.hot: A de-facto standard for C++ asynchronous networking, Asio maintains strong momentum with 6.1k stars and 175 added this week, ranking 8th on the GitHub C++ Trending list. The recent 1.38.1 release underscores continued community demand for robust, high-performance low-level I/O infrastructure.
uses: Backend C++ developers building high-concurrency network services or real-time communication systems
Embedded and tooling teams seeking a cross-platform, consistent API without managing native OS I/O directly
Engineering teams developing game servers, financial market gateways, or IoT hubs on a proven asynchronous model

en.tag: Modular high-performance shading language compiler

It supports automatic differentiation, multi-platform compilation (D3D12, Vulkan, Metal, CUDA, etc.), and flexible interop.
en.content: The repository contains the Slang compiler, standard library, examples, and documentation. The compiler generates target code such as DXIL, SPIR-V, Metal Shading Language, and CUDA from Slang source.
en.stack: Implemented primarily in C++, relies on LLVM for code generation, supports automatic differentiation and a module system.
en.hot: Developed by NVIDIA and other institutions, Slang addresses modularity and cross-platform pain points in shader development. Recently gained attention for automatic differentiation and neural graphics support, reaching 5488 stars.

en.tag: Turn commodity WiFi into real-time spatial intelligence & vital sign monitoring without cameras
en.what: RuView is a WiFi sensing platform that uses Channel State Information (CSI) from commodity routers to detect people, measure breathing and heart rate, and track movement through walls. It integrates with major smart home ecosystems via Matter, HomeKit, and MQTT.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core engine, ESP32 firmware, Home Assistant integration docs, Matter bridge implementation, and 21 entity types (including 10 inferred semantic states like sleeping, distress, fall risk).
en.stack: Primary language Rust, relies on ESP32 hardware for CSI capture, MQTT for communication, and Matter/HomeKit bridging libraries.
en.hot: 82,697 stars (+1,114 today) due to its sci-fi-like through-wall sensing capability seamlessly integrated with major smart home platforms, requiring no cameras or wearables.
uses: Smart home users — camera-free presence detection and vital sign monitoring via Home Assistant/Apple Home
Elderly care — detect fall risk, prolonged inactivity, bed exit anomalies
Office space management — meeting room occupancy, people flow analysis
Developers/researchers — explore WiFi sensing technology, extend custom semantic states

zh.tag: 从零手写AI工程：503课时的全栈开源课程体系
zh.what: 这是一套系统化的开源AI工程课程，包含503节课、20个阶段，总计约320小时学习内容。课程覆盖从线性代数、反向传播到注意力机制、智能体循环和自主集群的完整链路，要求学员从零手写实现每个核心组件。每节课最终产出可复用的工程产物（提示词、技能、智能体或MCP服务器），强调“先懂原理再调框架”。
zh.content: 仓库按20个递进阶段组织，包含503节自包含课程及对应代码，涵盖Python、TypeScript、Rust、Julia四种语言实现；配套有网站、路线图、学习数据追踪及可本地运行的测试与构建脚本。

zh.hot: 仓库已获超3.8万Star且单日新增232星，跻身GitHub Trending日榜第8；其“从零手写”的硬核路径和503节课的系统性填补了“学生普遍使用AI但仅18%感到职业准备充分”的市场空白。
uses: 转码/在校学生 —— 希望从零建立AI工程系统能力，而非仅调用API的初学者
全栈工程师 —— 需要深入理解Transformer、注意力机制和智能体底层原理的开发者
AI产品经理/技术负责人 —— 想要建立端到端技术视野、评估算法可行性的非纯研发角色
自学者/面试者 —— 寻求结构化、可本地运行的长周期课程替代碎片化网课的人群

en.tag: Open-source AI engineering bootcamp: 503 lessons across 20 phases in 4 languages
en.what: It is a comprehensive open-source curriculum for AI engineering with 503 lessons across 20 phases (~320 hours total). The course spans from foundational linear algebra and backpropagation to attention mechanisms, agent loops, and autonomous swarms, requiring learners to implement every core component from scratch before touching high-level frameworks. Each lesson ships a reusable artifact—prompt, skill, agent, or MCP server—bridging theory and production-ready engineering.
en.content: The repository is organized into 20 progressive phases containing 503 self-contained lessons with code implementations in Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia, accompanied by a website, roadmap, local test runners, and build scripts.
en.stack: Python is the primary language, with additional implementations in TypeScript, Rust, and Julia; the curriculum starts from raw math and gradually introduces frameworks like PyTorch, designed to run entirely on a local laptop.
en.hot: With over 38.8k stars and 232 new stars today, hitting #8 on GitHub Trending, its "build from scratch" philosophy and 503-lesson structure directly address the gap where 84% of students use AI tools but only 18% feel professionally prepared.
uses: Career switchers and students seeking to build systematic AI engineering skills from the ground up rather than just calling APIs.
Full-stack developers who need deep, first-principles understanding of transformers, attention, and agent internals.
AI product managers and tech leads who want end-to-end technical literacy to assess algorithm feasibility without pure research backgrounds.
Self-learners and interview candidates looking for a structured, locally runnable long-form curriculum to replace scattered tutorials.

zh.tag: 港大出品的 AI 私人家教：个性化终身学习工作区
zh.what: 香港大学 HKUDS 实验室的「agent 原生」学习平台：聊天辅导、刷题测验、深度研究、可视化、解题、Mastery Path 掌握度练习跑在同一套 agent 循环上。支持多引擎 RAG 知识库（LlamaIndex、PageIndex、GraphRAG、LightRAG，可挂 Obsidian 库），可从任意对话呼叫 Claude Code / Codex 等子 agent；带三层可检查记忆（L1 trace / L2 摘要 / L3 综合）和 Memory Graph 溯源。
zh.content: 完整 Web 应用（Python 后端 + Next.js 16 前端），附 11 种语言 README、Docker 部署、CLI/agent-native 接口、EduHub 社区 skills 生态；发版极勤。
zh.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16，RAG 多引擎 + MCP 工具 + FAISS 向量库，Apache-2.0；2025 年 12 月底创建，有 arXiv 论文背书。
zh.hot: 它把 AI 教育与 Agent 原生工作流结合，并由高校实验室持续维护，概念清晰、可体验性强。
uses: 学生 / 自学者 —— 把教材和论文喂进去，得到 24 小时私人家教
考研 / 考证党 —— 用刷题测验 + 掌握度路径系统备考
知识管理玩家 —— 直接挂 Obsidian 库做 RAG 问答

en.tag: An AI personal tutor from HKU: a lifelong, personalized learning workspace
en.what: An 'agent-native' learning platform from HKU's HKUDS lab: chat tutoring, quizzes, deep research, visualization, problem solving and Mastery-Path practice all run on one agent loop. It supports multi-engine RAG knowledge bases (LlamaIndex, PageIndex, GraphRAG, LightRAG — even your Obsidian vault), lets you call Claude Code / Codex sub-agents from any conversation, and ships three-layer inspectable memory (L1 trace / L2 summary / L3 synthesis) with a Memory Graph for provenance.
en.content: A full web app (Python backend + Next.js 16 frontend) with READMEs in 11 languages, Docker deployment, CLI/agent-native interfaces and the EduHub community skills ecosystem; releases ship very frequently.
en.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16, multi-engine RAG + MCP tools + FAISS; Apache-2.0; created late December 2025 with an arXiv paper behind it.
en.hot: It combines AI education with an agent-native workflow and carries the credibility of a university research lab, making the concept easy to evaluate and share.
uses: Students & self-learners — feed in textbooks and papers, get a 24/7 personal tutor
Exam candidates — prepare systematically with quizzes and the mastery path
PKM enthusiasts — plug your Obsidian vault straight in for RAG Q&A

zh.tag: 终端AI编码代理，开箱即用支持视频输入与子代理
zh.what: Kimi Code CLI 是一个运行在终端中的 AI 编码代理，能够读取和编辑代码、执行 shell 命令、搜索文件、抓取网页，并根据反馈自主决策下一步操作。它默认使用月之暗面的 Kimi 模型，也支持配置其他兼容的模型提供商。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kimi Code CLI 的完整源代码、安装脚本、文档和示例。CLI 采用单二进制分发，无需 Node.js 环境，通过一条命令即可安装。

zh.hot: 本周新增 1400+ Star，GitHub 周榜第 4。作为月之暗面推出的 AI 编码代理，其视频输入、子代理并行工作等创新功能吸引了大量开发者关注。

团队 —— 通过子代理并行处理多个任务，提升开发效率
AI 爱好者 —— 探索视频输入、MCP 配置等前沿 AI 代理功能

en.tag: Terminal AI coding agent with video input and subagents out of the box
en.what: Kimi Code CLI is an AI coding agent that runs in your terminal, capable of reading and editing code, running shell commands, searching files, fetching web pages, and autonomously deciding next steps based on feedback. It works out of the box with Moonshot AI's Kimi models and can be configured to use other compatible providers.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, installation scripts, documentation, and examples for Kimi Code CLI. The CLI is distributed as a single binary, requiring no Node.js setup, and can be installed with a single command.

en.hot: Gained 1400+ stars this week, ranking 4th on GitHub weekly trending. As Moonshot AI's AI coding agent, its innovative features like video input and parallel subagents have attracted significant developer attention.
uses: Developers — use AI to assist coding, debugging, and project understanding in the terminal
Teams — leverage subagents for parallel task processing to boost development efficiency
AI enthusiasts — explore cutting-edge AI agent features like video input and MCP configuration

zh.tag: 跨平台安全文件传输工具，支持端到端加密与断点续传
zh.what: croc 是一款命令行工具，可在任意两台计算机之间简单、安全地传输文件与文件夹。它基于 PAKE 协议实现端到端加密，无需配置本地服务器或端口转发，通过中继即可完成跨平台传输。支持断点续传、多文件传输、IPv6-first 及代理（如 Tor）等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 源码、CLI 主程序、中继服务器实现，以及多平台安装脚本和 CI 配置。README 提供了详细的安装指南（涵盖 Homebrew、Scoop、Nix 等主流包管理器）和动态演示 GIF。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，使用 PAKE 算法实现密钥交换，通过自定义中继协议传输数据，支持 IPv6/IPv4 双栈及 SOCKS5 代理（如 Tor）。
zh.hot: 凭借「开箱即用、安全无痛」的跨设备传输体验，croc 在开发者社区积累了 35.6K Star，本周再增 167 星并冲入 GitHub Go 周榜第 20 名。它填补了传统 scp/rsync 配置繁琐与即时传输工具缺乏加密之间的空白。
uses: 开发运维人员 —— 在不同服务器或本地与远程之间快速安全地传输配置文件与日志
跨平台协作团队 —— 在 Windows、macOS、Linux 同事之间即开即用地分享大文件或项目目录
隐私敏感用户 —— 借助端到端加密和 Tor 代理，在不信任网络中安全收发文件
命令行爱好者 —— 替代 scp/rsync，无需配置 SSH 或端口转发即可点对点传输

en.tag: Secure CLI tool for effortless cross-platform file transfers with encryption
en.what: croc is a CLI tool that lets any two computers simply and securely transfer files and folders. It uses PAKE for end-to-end encryption and works through a relay, eliminating the need for local servers or port forwarding. It supports resumable transfers, multiple files, IPv6-first with IPv4 fallback, and proxies like Tor.
en.content: The repository contains the full Go source code, CLI entry point, relay server implementation, and cross-platform install scripts with CI configs. The README includes detailed installation guides for Homebrew, Scoop, Nix, and more, plus a demo GIF.
en.stack: Written in Go, it uses PAKE for key exchange, a custom relay protocol for data transfer, and supports IPv6/IPv4 dual-stack with SOCKS5 proxy support (e.g., Tor).
en.hot: With an out-of-the-box, pain-free cross-device transfer experience, croc has earned 35.6K stars, gaining 167 this week and hitting #20 on GitHub's Go Trending chart. It fills the gap between tedious scp/rsync setup and instant tools that lack encryption.
uses: DevOps/Developers —— quickly and securely transfer configs and logs between servers or local and remote machines
Cross-platform teams —— instantly share large files or project folders across Windows, macOS, and Linux colleagues
Privacy-conscious users —— send files securely over untrusted networks using end-to-end encryption and Tor proxy support
CLI power users —— replace scp/rsync without needing SSH setup or port forwarding for ad-hoc transfers

zh.tag: 为AI代理打造的CAD与机器人设计技能库
zh.what: Text-to-CAD 是一个为AI代理提供CAD、机器人和硬件设计技能的库。它允许代理通过自然语言或图像生成、编辑CAD模型，并导出为STEP、STL、3MF等格式，同时支持机器人描述文件（URDF、SDF、SRDF）的生成。

硬件工程师：通过自然语言快速生成3D模型
机器人爱好者：自动生成URDF等机器人描述文件
创客与教育：降低CAD学习曲线，快速原型设计

en.tag: A skill library for AI agents to generate CAD, robotics, and hardware designs
en.what: Text-to-CAD is a library of agent skills for CAD, robotics, and hardware design. It enables agents to generate and edit CAD models from plain language or images, export to STEP, STL, 3MF, and produce robot description files (URDF, SDF, SRDF).
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill modules: CAD modeling, CAD viewer, off-the-shelf parts sourcing, slicing, and robot description file generation, each with its own documentation and implementation.
en.stack: Primarily uses Python 3.11+, with CAD kernel (e.g., CadQuery) and robot description libraries; frontend preview is web-based.

uses: AI agent developers: integrate CAD and robotics design skills into agents
Hardware engineers: quickly generate 3D models from natural language
Robotics enthusiasts: auto-generate robot description files like URDF
Makers and educators: lower CAD learning curve for rapid prototyping

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的极简 Web GUI
zh.what: T3 Code 是一个轻量级的 Web 图形界面，用于运行和管理多个编码 AI 代理（如 Codex、Claude、Cursor、OpenCode）。它让开发者无需离开浏览器即可与这些代理交互，简化了编码工作流。

zh.hot: 本周新增 413 星，总星数 14459，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 18。它填补了多代理统一管理界面的空白，吸引了大量对 AI 编码工具感兴趣的开发者。
uses: 希望在一个界面中切换多个 AI 编码助手的开发者
需要远程访问编码代理的团队或个人
探索 AI 辅助编程工作流的早期采用者

en.tag: A minimal web GUI for coding agents
en.what: T3 Code is a lightweight web GUI for running and managing multiple coding AI agents (e.g., Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode). It allows developers to interact with these agents without leaving the browser, streamlining the coding workflow.
en.content: The repo contains the web app source code, desktop app build config, CLI tool, and documentation (getting started, remote access, architecture overview, etc.). It can be run quickly via npx or installed as a desktop app.

Teams or individuals needing remote access to coding agents
Early adopters exploring AI-assisted programming workflows

zh.tag: 极致美观的动态平铺 Wayland 合成器
zh.what: Hyprland 是一个独立、高度可定制、动态平铺的 Wayland 合成器，注重外观而不牺牲功能。它提供最新的 Wayland 特性、丰富的视觉效果（渐变边框、模糊、动画、阴影等）、强大的插件系统、内置插件管理器、撕裂支持（提升游戏性能）等。

zh.hot: 凭借出色的视觉效果和高度可定制性，Hyprland 在 Linux 桌面用户中广受欢迎，Star 数达 36,817，今日新增 24，持续活跃开发。

Wayland 爱好者 —— 希望体验最新 Wayland 特性的用户
开发者 —— 对合成器实现感兴趣，或希望为其开发插件的开发者

en.tag: A highly customizable dynamic tiling Wayland compositor with stunning visuals
en.what: Hyprland is an independent, highly customizable, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks. It offers the latest Wayland features, extensive eye candy (gradient borders, blur, animations, shadows), a powerful plugin system, built-in plugin manager, tearing support for better gaming performance, and more.

en.hot: With its stunning visuals and high customizability, Hyprland has gained immense popularity among Linux desktop users, amassing 36,817 stars (24 new today) and maintaining active development.

Wayland enthusiasts — users wanting to experience the latest Wayland features
Developers — interested in compositor implementation or developing plugins for Hyprland

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。

zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。

uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.

Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
