uses: 团队协作 —— 人类与 AI 代理在同一工作空间中共同管理项目、代码审查和 CI/CD
AI 代理开发 —— 测试和部署具有完整操作权限（如仓库、工作流）的 AI 代理
事件驱动工作流 —— 利用 Nostr 事件日志构建可审计的自动化流程
自托管社区 —— 为需要完全控制数据和身份的组织提供私有协作平台

en.tag: A self-hostable workspace where humans and agents collaborate in shared rooms
en.what: Buzz is a self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents share the same rooms. Built on the Nostr protocol, every message, action, and workflow step is a signed event in a single log, providing a unified identity model and audit trail.
en.content: The repository contains the full Buzz platform source code, including frontend UI, backend services, Nostr relay implementation, and multiple Rust crates. It offers channels, canvases, workflows, voice huddles, and enables agents to perform repo operations, code review, CI/CD, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, based on the Nostr protocol, leveraging multiple Rust crates for event logging, identity management, and relay functionality.
en.hot: Buzz gained 3252 stars in a single day, reaching 4148 total, due to its innovative concept of equal collaboration between humans and agents, self-hosted nature, and Nostr-based architecture.
uses: Team collaboration — humans and AI agents manage projects, code review, and CI/CD in the same workspace
AI agent development — test and deploy agents with full operational capabilities (repos, workflows, etc.)
Event-driven workflows — build auditable automation using Nostr event logs
Self-hosted communities — provide a private collaboration platform for organizations needing full data and identity control

zh.tag: Rust 全栈框架，开箱即用
zh.what: Topcoat 是一个模块化、开箱即用的 Rust 全栈 Web 框架，专注于简洁和生产力。它允许在服务器端渲染所有标记，组件可以异步并直接查询数据库，同时通过将表达式翻译为 JavaScript 实现客户端交互，无需 WebAssembly 或客户端构建步骤。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架核心、路由、视图组件、信号系统等模块，以及示例代码和文档。
zh.stack: 技术栈基于 Rust，依赖 tokio 异步运行时，使用自定义 view! 宏进行模板渲染，支持信号驱动的响应式更新。
zh.hot: 本周新增 2247 星，总星数 3233，位列 Rust 周榜第 6。作为 tokio 官方推出的全栈框架，填补了 Rust 生态中类似 Next.js 的空白，吸引了大量关注。
uses: Rust 全栈开发者 —— 快速构建服务端渲染的 Web 应用，无需前后端分离
希望用 Rust 替代 JavaScript/TypeScript 的前端开发者 —— 利用 Rust 的类型安全和性能
tokio 生态用户 —— 与现有异步基础设施无缝集成

en.tag: Batteries-included full-stack Rust framework
en.what: Topcoat is a modular, batteries-included Rust framework for building full-stack web apps, prioritizing simplicity and productivity. It renders all markup on the server, enabling async components to query databases directly, while translating expressions to JavaScript for client-side interactivity without WebAssembly or a client build step.
en.content: The repository includes the framework core, router, view components, signal system, along with examples and documentation.
en.stack: Built on Rust with the tokio async runtime, uses a custom view! macro for templating, and supports signal-driven reactive updates.
en.hot: Gained 2247 stars this week, total 3233, ranking #6 in Rust weekly. As an official tokio full-stack framework, it fills a Next.js-like gap in the Rust ecosystem, drawing significant attention.
uses: Rust full-stack developers — quickly build server-rendered web apps without front-backend separation
Frontend developers wanting to replace JS/TS with Rust — leverage Rust's type safety and performance
tokio ecosystem users — seamless integration with existing async infrastructure

zh.tag: Rust 全栈跨平台 UI 框架，一套代码覆盖 Web、桌面与移动端
zh.what: Dioxus 是一个基于 Rust 的全栈应用框架，开发者只需维护一套代码库即可构建 Web、桌面和移动应用。它提供了类似 React 的组件化开发体验，并内置基于 Signals 的状态管理、热重载与零配置启动能力。通过 Server Functions 还能直接在同一代码库中编写后端逻辑，实现真正的全栈开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 UI 库、跨平台渲染器（Web/桌面/移动端）、CLI 打包工具以及 Server Functions 全栈运行时。此外还提供了丰富的官方示例、文档站点和多语言 README，方便开发者快速上手。
zh.stack: 完全基于 Rust 生态，核心使用自研的 Virtual DOM 与 Signals 响应式系统，编译目标涵盖 WebAssembly、桌面端（基于 Winit/Tao）及移动端原生渲染。
zh.hot: 凭借 36.8K Star 的热度和本周 Rust 趋势榜第 18 名的成绩，Dioxus 吸引了大量希望用 Rust 替代 JavaScript 技术栈的开发者。其“一套代码、多端运行”的全栈能力，加上对热重载和零配置体验的重视，精准击中了 Rust 社区对高性能跨平台 UI 方案的强烈需求。
uses: Rust 开发者 —— 希望用单一代码库同时覆盖前端页面与桌面/移动原生应用的项目。
全栈工程师 —— 想在前端组件中直接调用 Server Functions，减少前后端语言切换成本的团队。
跨平台应用团队 —— 需要高性能、内存安全且拒绝 Electron 厚重方案的产品组。

en.tag: Rust fullstack cross-platform UI framework for web, desktop, and mobile
en.what: Dioxus is a Rust-based fullstack framework that lets developers build for the web, desktop, and mobile from a single codebase. It offers a React-like component model with zero-config setup, integrated hot-reloading, and signals-based state management. Server Functions enable backend logic to live alongside the UI, streamlining fullstack development in Rust.
en.content: The repo contains the core UI library, cross-platform renderers for web, desktop, and mobile, a CLI bundler, and a fullstack runtime for Server Functions. It also ships with extensive examples, documentation, and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Built entirely on Rust, featuring a custom Virtual DOM and signals-based reactivity, compiling to WebAssembly, desktop (via Winit/Tao), and mobile native targets.
en.hot: With 36.8K stars and ranking 18th on this week's GitHub Rust Trending, Dioxus is drawing developers eager to replace JavaScript stacks with Rust. Its promise of a single codebase spanning web, desktop, and mobile—backed by hot-reload and zero-config DX—directly addresses the Rust community's demand for high-performance cross-platform UI solutions.
uses: Rust developers —— teams wanting a single codebase for web, desktop, and mobile apps without sacrificing performance.
Fullstack engineers —— those looking to colocate Server Functions with UI components to cut language-switching overhead.
Cross-platform product teams —— groups that need memory-safe, high-performance alternatives to heavy Electron-style solutions.

zh.tag: 离线、隐私优先的英语语法检查器，快速开源，Rust 驱动
zh.what: Harper 是一个离线运行的英语语法检查工具，注重隐私和速度。它可以在毫秒级内检查文档，内存占用仅为 LanguageTool 的 1/50，且所有处理都在本地完成，无需联网。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Harper 核心库、语言服务器（harper-ls）、WebAssembly 版本以及多种编辑器集成（VS Code、Obsidian 等）。提供二进制下载和 npm 包。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，通过 WebAssembly 支持浏览器端运行。提供 LSP 协议实现，可集成到各种编辑器中。
zh.hot: Harper 在 GitHub 上获得 12,300+ 星标，今日新增 624 星，排名日榜第 14。其离线、隐私优先的设计解决了 Grammarly 和 LanguageTool 的痛点，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 注重隐私的写作者 —— 无需将文本发送到云端即可获得语法检查
开发者 —— 集成到 VS Code、Neovim 等编辑器中，作为轻量级 LSP 使用
Obsidian 用户 —— 通过插件在笔记中直接使用 Harper
需要离线环境的用户 —— 如飞机上或网络受限场景

en.tag: Offline, privacy-first English grammar checker, fast and open-source, powered by Rust
en.what: Harper is an offline English grammar checker that prioritizes privacy and speed. It can lint documents in milliseconds, uses less than 1/50th of LanguageTool's memory, and processes everything locally without network requests.
en.content: The repository includes the Harper core library, language server (harper-ls), WebAssembly build, and integrations for multiple editors (VS Code, Obsidian, etc.). Binaries and npm packages are available.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with WebAssembly support for browser usage. Implements the LSP protocol for editor integration.
en.hot: Harper has garnered 12,300+ stars on GitHub, with 624 new stars today, ranking 14th on the daily trending list. Its offline, privacy-first approach addresses pain points of Grammarly and LanguageTool, drawing significant attention.
uses: Privacy-conscious writers — get grammar checking without sending text to the cloud
Developers — integrate into editors like VS Code, Neovim as a lightweight LSP
Obsidian users — use Harper directly in notes via plugin
Users needing offline environments — such as on flights or restricted networks

zh.tag: Jellyfin 非官方桌面客户端，基于 CEF 和 mpv
zh.what: Jellium Desktop 是一个非官方的 Jellyfin 桌面客户端，旨在提供比网页版更流畅、更原生的媒体播放体验。它利用 CEF 渲染界面，mpv 作为播放后端，支持跨平台运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的客户端源码、构建脚本（支持 Linux AppImage/Flatpak、macOS DMG、Windows 安装包）以及开发工具链（just 任务运行器）。
zh.stack: 技术栈：Rust 主语言，CEF（Chromium Embedded Framework）用于 UI，mpv 用于视频播放，跨平台构建支持 Linux、macOS、Windows。
zh.hot: Jellyfin 用户对原生桌面客户端需求强烈，Jellium 凭借 CEF+mpv 的流畅体验和跨平台支持，上线即获 1400+ Star，今日新增 155，登顶 Rust 日榜第 4。
uses: Jellyfin 用户：需要比网页版更流畅、功能更丰富的桌面播放器
媒体中心爱好者：在 Linux/macOS/Windows 上统一管理并播放 Jellyfin 媒体库
Rust 开发者：学习如何结合 CEF 和 mpv 构建跨平台桌面应用

en.tag: Unofficial Jellyfin desktop client built on CEF and mpv
en.what: Jellium Desktop is an unofficial Jellyfin desktop client that offers a smoother, more native media playback experience than the web version. It uses CEF for UI rendering and mpv as the playback backend, with cross-platform support.
en.content: The repository includes full client source code, build scripts (Linux AppImage/Flatpak, macOS DMG, Windows packages), and a development toolchain (just command runner).
en.stack: Tech stack: Rust as the main language, CEF (Chromium Embedded Framework) for UI, mpv for video playback, cross-platform builds for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
en.hot: Jellyfin users have a strong demand for native desktop clients. Jellium, with its smooth CEF+mpv experience and cross-platform support, quickly gained 1400+ stars, adding 155 today, ranking 4th on Rust daily trending.
uses: Jellyfin users: need a smoother, more feature-rich desktop player than the web version
Media center enthusiasts: manage and play Jellyfin media library uniformly on Linux/macOS/Windows
Rust developers: learn how to combine CEF and mpv to build cross-platform desktop apps

zh.tag: 一站式媒体下载与学习管理桌面应用
zh.what: OmniGet 是一款开源桌面应用，支持从 1800+ 网站下载视频、音频、课程和电子书，并内置 PDF/EPUB 阅读器、专注模式、带时间戳的笔记和间隔重复功能。无需命令行，无需 Python，开箱即用。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面应用源码，基于 Tauri + Rust + Svelte 构建，提供媒体下载、播放、阅读、笔记和插件系统。
zh.stack: 技术栈：Tauri（桌面框架）、Rust（后端）、Svelte（前端）、yt-dlp（媒体下载）、SQLite（本地存储）。
zh.hot: 今日新增 357 星，总星数 7277，位列 Rust 日榜第 10。其“一站式下载+学习”的定位精准解决了用户在多平台间切换的痛点，且完全免费开源。
uses: 在线课程学习者 —— 一键下载 Udemy、YouTube 等平台的课程视频和资料
媒体收藏爱好者 —— 从 1800+ 站点下载视频、音乐和电子书
高效学习者 —— 利用内置阅读器、笔记和间隔重复功能进行主动学习

en.tag: All-in-one desktop app for downloading, organizing and studying media
en.what: OmniGet is an open-source desktop app that downloads videos, audio, courses, and ebooks from 1,800+ sites, with built-in PDF/EPUB reader, focus mode, timestamped notes, and spaced repetition. No command line, no Python, just download and run.
en.content: The repo contains the full desktop app source code built with Tauri + Rust + Svelte, featuring media downloading, playback, reading, note-taking, and a plugin system.
en.stack: Tech stack: Tauri (desktop framework), Rust (backend), Svelte (frontend), yt-dlp (media downloading), SQLite (local storage).
en.hot: Gained 357 stars today, total 7277, ranked #10 in Rust daily trending. Its 'all-in-one download + study' positioning solves the pain of switching between platforms, and it's completely free and open-source.
uses: Online course learners — one-click download courses from Udemy, YouTube, and more
Media collectors — download videos, music, and ebooks from 1,800+ sites
Active learners — use built-in reader, notes, and spaced repetition for effective study

zh.tag: 开源开发者平台，将脚本转为API、工作流和UI
zh.what: Windmill 是一个开源开发者平台，可将脚本自动转换为可共享的 UI、API、定时任务和工作流。它作为 Retool、Pipedream 和 Temporal 的自托管替代方案，支持 Python、TypeScript、Go 等多种语言。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Windmill 的核心代码、CLI 工具、Docker 部署配置、Helm charts 以及文档。提供脚本编辑器、工作流引擎、低代码应用构建器和自动生成的 UI。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Rust 构建，前端采用 Svelte，数据库支持 PostgreSQL。工作流引擎性能优越，比 Airflow 快 13 倍。
zh.hot: Windmill 凭借其将脚本快速转化为完整内部工具的能力吸引了 17k+ Star，本周新增 140 Star。其高性能工作流引擎和自托管特性深受开发者喜爱。
uses: 开发者 —— 快速构建内部 API、后台任务和工作流
运维团队 —— 自动化基础设施操作和监控
产品团队 —— 使用低代码构建内部应用和仪表盘
企业 —— 自托管替代 Retool 和 Temporal，保障数据安全

en.tag: Open-source developer platform to turn scripts into APIs, workflows, and UIs
en.what: Windmill is an open-source developer platform that automatically turns scripts into shareable UIs, APIs, scheduled jobs, and workflows. It serves as a self-hostable alternative to Retool, Pipedream, and Temporal, supporting Python, TypeScript, Go, and more.
en.content: The repo contains Windmill's core code, CLI tools, Docker deployment configs, Helm charts, and documentation. It includes a script editor, workflow engine, low-code app builder, and auto-generated UIs.
en.stack: Backend built with Rust, frontend with Svelte, database backed by PostgreSQL. The workflow engine is 13x faster than Airflow.
en.hot: Windmill has gained 17k+ stars for its ability to quickly turn scripts into full internal tools, with 140 new stars this week. Its high-performance workflow engine and self-hosted nature are highly appealing to developers.
uses: Developers — quickly build internal APIs, background jobs, and workflows
Ops teams — automate infrastructure operations and monitoring
Product teams — build internal apps and dashboards with low-code
Enterprises — self-hosted alternative to Retool and Temporal for data security

zh.tag: OpenAI 官方轻量级终端 AI 编码代理
zh.what: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的终端原生 AI 编码代理，可在本地计算机上直接运行。它能理解自然语言指令，协助完成代码编写、重构、调试等任务。用户可通过 ChatGPT 账户或 API 密钥接入，无需离开终端即可进行智能开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Codex CLI 的 Rust 源码、跨平台编译构建脚本，以及支持 macOS/Linux/Windows 的预编译二进制发布。除终端版外，项目还指向 IDE 插件和云端 Codex Web 的入口。
zh.stack: 核心采用 Rust 开发，保证高性能与低资源占用；提供 curl、npm、Homebrew 等多种安装方式，支持通过 ChatGPT 账号或 OpenAI API 密钥进行身份验证。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方出品的终端编码工具，凭借 99.2k Stars 的超高人气和单日新增 328 Stars 的强劲势头，成功登顶 Rust 日榜第二。它将 AI 编程能力直接嵌入开发者最熟悉的终端环境，轻量且开源。
uses: 终端重度使用者 —— 希望在命令行中直接调用 AI 辅助编程的开发者
全栈工程师 —— 需要快速完成代码生成、重构与调试的敏捷开发场景
开源贡献者 —— 希望基于 Apache-2.0 协议研究或扩展 AI Agent 能力的工程师
ChatGPT 订阅用户 —— 想将现有 Plus/Pro/Edu 等计划权益延伸至本地开发环境

en.tag: OpenAI's official lightweight coding agent for your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a terminal-native AI coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your machine. It interprets natural language instructions to help write, refactor, and debug code without leaving your terminal. Users can authenticate via their ChatGPT plan or an OpenAI API key.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust source code for Codex CLI, cross-platform build scripts, and precompiled binaries for macOS, Linux, and Windows. It also points to IDE extensions and the cloud-based Codex Web agent.
en.stack: Core is built in Rust for high performance and low resource usage. It supports multiple installation methods including curl, npm, and Homebrew, and authenticates via ChatGPT accounts or OpenAI API keys.
en.hot: As an official OpenAI terminal coding tool, it commands massive attention with 99.2k Stars and 328 new Stars today, ranking second on the Rust daily trending list. It brings AI coding directly into the familiar terminal environment in a lightweight, open-source package.
uses: Terminal power users — developers who want AI assistance directly in their command line
Full-stack engineers — those needing rapid code generation, refactoring, and debugging
Open-source contributors — engineers looking to study or extend an Apache-2.0 AI agent
ChatGPT subscribers — users wanting to extend their Plus/Pro/Edu benefits to local development

zh.tag: 开源可扩展的离线语音转录桌面工具
zh.what: Handy 是一款跨平台的桌面语音转文字应用，主打完全离线、隐私优先的转录体验。用户只需按下可配置的快捷键说话，即可将语音实时转换为文本并自动输入到任意文本框中。所有音频处理均在本地完成，无需联网或上传云端。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面客户端源码、基于 Rust 的本地音频处理管线，以及集成 Whisper 和 Parakeet V3 的离线转录引擎，同时提供了 Raycast 插件等扩展集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，使用 Silero VAD 进行语音活动检测，支持 Whisper（Small/Medium/Turbo/Large）和 Parakeet V3 本地模型，并可在 GPU 加速下运行。
zh.hot: 在隐私焦虑与云服务费高涨的背景下，Handy 以「完全开源、完全离线」的差异化定位迅速获得开发者关注，本月新增近 3,000 Star，累计突破 2.6 万，登榜 GitHub Rust 月榜第 17 名。
uses: 隐私敏感用户 —— 需要在本地完成语音输入、拒绝云端上传的写作者与专业人士。
开发者与极客 —— 希望 Fork 并二次扩展自定义模型或工作流的技术用户。
跨平台办公场景 —— 在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上追求高效语音转文字输入的远程工作者。
可访问性需求者 —— 需要无障碍语音输入工具但不愿付费订阅的辅助功能使用者。

en.tag: Free, open-source & extensible offline speech-to-text desktop app
en.what: Handy is a cross-platform desktop speech-to-text app that transcribes your voice entirely offline with a privacy-first approach. Press a configurable shortcut, speak, and it pastes the transcribed text directly into any text field. All audio processing happens locally on your machine, with no data sent to the cloud.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop client source, a Rust-based local audio pipeline, and an offline transcription engine integrating Whisper and Parakeet V3 models, plus integrations like a Raycast extension.
en.stack: Built in Rust, it uses Silero VAD for voice-activity detection and supports local Whisper (Small/Medium/Turbo/Large) and Parakeet V3 models with optional GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Amid rising privacy concerns and cloud-service costs, Handy's 'fully open-source and fully offline' positioning has resonated strongly with developers, adding nearly 3,000 stars this month to reach 26.7K+ and ranking 17th on GitHub's Rust monthly trending list.
uses: Privacy-conscious users — writers and professionals who need local voice input without cloud uploads.
Developers & tinkers — technical users who want to fork and extend custom models or workflows.
Cross-platform workers — remote workers on Windows, macOS, or Linux seeking efficient offline dictation.
Accessibility seekers — users needing assistive voice-input tools without paid subscriptions.

zh.tag: 开源远程桌面服务端，支持自托管
zh.what: RustDesk Server 是 RustDesk 远程桌面软件的服务器端程序，允许用户自建远程桌面服务。它包含 ID/中继服务器和 CLI 工具，支持完全自托管，免费开源。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个可执行程序：hbbs（ID/中继服务器）、hbbr（中继服务器）和 rustdesk-utils（CLI 工具），以及配置文档和环境变量说明。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 语言开发，依赖 Cargo 构建系统，支持通过命令行、环境变量或配置文件进行配置。
zh.hot: 作为 TeamViewer/AnyDesk 的开源替代，RustDesk 服务器端持续受到关注，本周新增 60 星，总星数突破 1 万，位列 Rust 周榜第 17。
uses: 希望自建远程桌面服务的企业或个人，避免依赖第三方服务
需要低成本远程支持或远程办公解决方案的团队
对数据隐私有高要求的用户，希望完全控制远程连接数据

en.tag: Open-source remote desktop server for self-hosting
en.what: RustDesk Server is the server-side program for the RustDesk remote desktop software, enabling users to self-host their own remote desktop service. It includes ID/rendezvous server, relay server, and CLI utilities, fully open-source and free.

zh.hot: 该仓库已积累约 1.27 万 Star，今日新增 24 颗并登上 C++ 日榜第 11 位。其持续十数年的高频更新、近乎疯狂的自由度与深度生存模拟，使其在开源游戏社区中拥有极为忠实的玩家群体。

开源游戏研究者——学习大型 C++ 游戏项目架构、数据驱动设计与跨平台分发实践
模组开发者——通过 JSON 自定义物品、怪物、地图与玩法规则，扩展末日世界
后末日题材玩家——在僵尸、怪物与人性挣扎中体验高自由度的沙盒叙事

en.tag: Classic open-source post-apocalyptic turn-based survival roguelike
en.what: Cataclysm: DDA is a hardcore turn-based survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Players scavenge a procedurally generated, persistent wasteland for supplies, craft gear, drive vehicles, and fight or flee from zombies, mutants, and killer robots to survive as long as possible.
en.content: The repository contains the full game source code, multiple tilesets and graphical assets, CI/CD pipelines for stable and experimental builds, and compilation/packaging documentation for Linux, Windows, macOS, and BSD.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++ with both ncurses terminal and SDL graphical frontends; game data and modding content are JSON-driven, while cross-platform builds are handled via CMake/Make and GitHub Actions.
en.hot: With roughly 12.7k stars and 24 new stars today placing it at #11 on the C++ daily trending list, the game has maintained a devoted following. Decades of relentless updates, extreme freedom, and deep survival mechanics keep the community highly engaged.
uses: Hardcore roguelike fans seeking brutal permadeath survival in a procedurally generated world
Open-source game researchers studying large-scale C++ architecture and data-driven design
Modders who want to extend the apocalypse via JSON-defined items, monsters, and mechanics
Post-apocalyptic gamers craving sandbox storytelling with zombies, mutants, and moral dilemmas

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 测试与模拟框架
zh.what: GoogleTest 是 Google 开发的 C++ 测试框架，提供单元测试、模拟对象和丰富的断言。它支持自动测试发现、死亡测试、参数化测试等特性，是 C++ 社区最广泛使用的测试工具之一。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GoogleTest 和 GoogleMock 的合并源码、构建系统（CMake/Bazel）、文档和示例。目录结构包括 googletest（核心框架）、googlemock（模拟库）和 docs（文档）。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，依赖 C++17 及以上标准（1.17.x 分支）。构建支持 CMake 和 Bazel，计划引入 Abseil 依赖。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 测试的行业标准，持续稳定更新（本周新增 45 star）。1.17.0 版本要求 C++17，吸引新用户关注。
uses: C++ 开发者 —— 编写单元测试和集成测试
质量保证工程师 —— 自动化测试和持续集成
开源项目维护者 —— 为项目添加测试覆盖
教学场景 —— 学习 C++ 测试最佳实践

en.tag: Google's official C++ testing and mocking framework
en.what: GoogleTest is Google's C++ testing framework providing unit testing, mocking, and a rich set of assertions. It supports automatic test discovery, death tests, parameterized tests, and is one of the most widely used testing tools in the C++ community.
en.content: The repository contains merged source code of GoogleTest and GoogleMock, build systems (CMake/Bazel), documentation, and examples. Directory structure includes googletest (core framework), googlemock (mocking library), and docs.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation, requires C++17 or later (1.17.x branch). Build supports CMake and Bazel, with planned dependency on Abseil.
en.hot: As the industry standard for C++ testing, it maintains steady updates (45 stars this week). The 1.17.0 release requires C++17, attracting new users.
uses: C++ developers — writing unit and integration tests
QA engineers — automated testing and CI
Open-source maintainers — adding test coverage to projects
Educational settings — learning C++ testing best practices

zh.tag: 实时分析型列式数据库管理系统
zh.what: ClickHouse 是一个开源的列式数据库管理系统，专为实时生成分析数据报告而设计。它能够对海量数据进行极速查询，支持 SQL 接口，适用于在线分析处理（OLAP）场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ClickHouse 数据库的完整源代码、构建脚本、测试套件以及文档。提供 Linux、macOS、FreeBSD 等平台的安装方式，并有丰富的社区资源如教程、文档、视频和 Slack 群组。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 LLVM、libcxx、zlib-ng 等底层库，支持多种编译器和平台。
zh.hot: ClickHouse 因其极致的查询性能和实时分析能力而广受欢迎，拥有 48k+ Stars，本周新增 159 Stars，在 C++ 周榜排名第 15。
uses: 数据工程师 —— 构建实时 OLAP 数据管道和仪表盘
DevOps/SRE —— 监控和可观测性数据存储与查询
数据分析师 —— 对海量数据进行交互式探索分析
产品经理 —— 了解用户行为分析场景下的技术选型

en.tag: Real-time analytics column-oriented database management system
en.what: ClickHouse is an open-source column-oriented database management system designed for real-time generation of analytical data reports. It enables blazing-fast queries on massive datasets, supports SQL interface, and is suitable for online analytical processing (OLAP) scenarios.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code, build scripts, test suites, and documentation for the ClickHouse database. It provides installation methods for Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, and offers rich community resources such as tutorials, documentation, videos, and Slack groups.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with dependencies on LLVM, libcxx, zlib-ng, and other low-level libraries, supporting multiple compilers and platforms.
en.hot: ClickHouse is widely popular for its extreme query performance and real-time analytics capabilities, with over 48k Stars and 159 new stars this week, ranking 15th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Data engineers — building real-time OLAP data pipelines and dashboards
DevOps/SRE — storing and querying monitoring and observability data
Data analysts — interactive exploration and analysis of massive datasets
Product managers — understanding technical choices for user behavior analytics

zh.tag: 月之暗面 Kimi 的 LLM 服务引擎，以 KVCache 为中心的分离式架构
zh.what: Mooncake 是月之暗面为其旗舰大模型服务 Kimi 打造的推理服务平台。它采用以 KVCache 为中心的分离式架构，将预填充（prefill）和解码（decoding）阶段解耦，通过高效的 KVCache 传输引擎实现跨节点共享，从而提升吞吐量并降低延迟。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 实现、Python 绑定（mooncake-transfer-engine）、论文、演示幻灯片、追踪数据及完整文档。支持多种硬件后端（CUDA、NPU、MUSA）和网络协议（RDMA、NVLink）。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 C++ 为主，依赖 CUDA、RDMA 等高性能计算与网络库，提供 Python PyPI 包便于集成。
zh.hot: 作为 Kimi 背后的生产级推理引擎，Mooncake 在 FAST '25 发表论文并开源，凭借创新架构和实际落地效果迅速获得 6000+ Star。
uses: 大模型推理服务开发者 —— 参考其分离式架构设计与 KVCache 优化策略
AI 基础设施团队 —— 部署高性能 LLM 推理平台，支持 Kimi 等大规模服务
系统研究者 —— 研究论文与追踪数据，复现或改进分离式推理方案

en.tag: Kimi's LLM serving platform with a KVCache-centric disaggregated architecture
en.what: Mooncake is the serving platform for Kimi, a leading LLM service by Moonshot AI. It features a KVCache-centric disaggregated architecture that separates prefill and decoding stages, enabling efficient KVCache transfer across nodes to boost throughput and reduce latency.
en.content: The repo includes core C++ implementation, Python bindings (mooncake-transfer-engine), research paper, slides, traces, and documentation. Supports multiple hardware backends (CUDA, NPU, MUSA) and network protocols (RDMA, NVLink).
en.stack: Primarily C++, leveraging CUDA, RDMA, and other high-performance computing/networking libraries. Provides Python PyPI packages for easy integration.
en.hot: As the production-grade inference engine behind Kimi, Mooncake published its paper at FAST '25 and open-sourced, quickly gaining 6000+ stars due to its innovative architecture and proven real-world impact.
uses: LLM serving developers — learn from its disaggregated architecture and KVCache optimization
AI infrastructure teams — deploy high-performance LLM inference for services like Kimi
Systems researchers — study the paper and traces to reproduce or improve disaggregated inference

zh.tag: 跨平台高性能 PSP 模拟器
zh.what: PPSSPP 是一款用 C++ 编写的 PSP 模拟器，支持 Android、Windows、Mac、Linux 和 iOS。它采用 HLE（高级模拟）方式，无需 BIOS 文件即可运行游戏，默认设置兼顾兼容性与速度。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源代码、构建脚本、文档和贡献指南。最新版本 1.20.4 带来了多人联机改进、纹理缩放增强、渲染修复和 UI 优化等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 OpenGL/Vulkan/DirectX 等图形 API，支持 GPU 纹理缩放（如 NNEDI3、Spline36）。
zh.hot: 作为最成熟的 PSP 模拟器之一，PPSSPP 持续活跃更新，1.20.4 版本新增多人联机功能和纹理缩放改进，吸引了大量怀旧游戏玩家和模拟器爱好者，本周新增 47 星。
uses: 怀旧游戏玩家：在 PC 或手机上畅玩 PSP 游戏
模拟器开发者：学习 HLE 模拟和跨平台移植技术
测试人员：参与游戏兼容性测试和 bug 反馈

en.tag: A fast and portable PSP emulator for multiple platforms
en.what: PPSSPP is a PSP emulator written in C++, supporting Android, Windows, Mac, Linux, and iOS. It uses HLE (High-Level Emulation) and requires no BIOS file, with default settings balancing compatibility and speed.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, build scripts, documentation, and contribution guidelines. The latest version 1.20.4 includes ad-hoc multiplayer improvements, texture upscaling enhancements, rendering fixes, and UI optimizations.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relying on graphics APIs like OpenGL, Vulkan, and DirectX, with support for GPU texture upscaling (e.g., NNEDI3, Spline36).
en.hot: As one of the most mature PSP emulators, PPSSPP receives continuous active updates. Version 1.20.4 introduces ad-hoc multiplayer and texture upscaling improvements, attracting retro gamers and emulation enthusiasts, with 47 new stars this week.
uses: Retro gamers: Play PSP games on PC or mobile devices
Emulator developers: Learn HLE emulation and cross-platform porting techniques
Testers: Participate in game compatibility testing and bug reporting

zh.tag: 基于 MCP 的语音交互 AI 聊天机器人
zh.what: 小智 AI 聊天机器人是一个基于 MCP 协议的语音交互入口，利用 Qwen / DeepSeek 等大模型实现 AI 对话，并通过 MCP 协议控制多端设备。支持离线语音唤醒、全双工语音交互、摄像头视觉输入、OLED 显示、电池管理等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 ESP-IDF 固件源码，支持 Wi-Fi、以太网、USB RNDIS 和 4G 联网；提供 WebSocket 和 MQTT+UDP 两种通信方式；内置 Opus 音频流处理、AEC 全双工、说话人识别、38 种界面语言；设备端和云端 MCP 扩展能力。
zh.stack: 基于 ESP-IDF v6.0+ 框架，使用 C++ 编写；依赖 ESP-SR 离线语音唤醒库、MCP 协议栈、Opus 编解码器；支持 ESP32 系列多款芯片。
zh.hot: 将大模型能力与嵌入式硬件结合，通过 MCP 协议实现设备控制，创意十足；视频教程和 DIY 指南降低了门槛，吸引了大量硬件爱好者和 AI 开发者，Star 数已达 2.8 万。
uses: 硬件爱好者 —— 用 ESP32 自制 AI 语音助手
AI 开发者 —— 探索 MCP 协议在嵌入式端的应用
智能家居玩家 —— 通过语音控制 LED、舵机等外设
教育场景 —— 学习嵌入式 AI 和语音交互开发

en.tag: An MCP-based voice-interactive AI chatbot
en.what: XiaoZhi AI chatbot is a voice interaction entry that leverages large models like Qwen / DeepSeek for AI conversations and controls multi-terminal devices via the MCP protocol. It supports offline voice wake-up, full-duplex voice interaction, camera vision input, OLED display, and battery management.
en.content: The repository contains complete ESP-IDF firmware source code, supporting Wi-Fi, Ethernet, USB RNDIS, and 4G networking; provides WebSocket and MQTT+UDP communication; includes Opus audio streaming, AEC full-duplex, speaker recognition, 38 interface languages; device-side and cloud-side MCP extensions.
en.stack: Built on ESP-IDF v6.0+ framework, written in C++; depends on ESP-SR offline voice wake-up library, MCP protocol stack, Opus codec; supports multiple ESP32 chip series.
en.hot: Combines large model capabilities with embedded hardware, enabling device control via MCP protocol—highly innovative; video tutorials and DIY guides lower the barrier, attracting many hardware enthusiasts and AI developers, reaching 28k stars.
uses: Hardware enthusiasts — build your own AI voice assistant with ESP32
AI developers — explore MCP protocol on embedded devices
Smart home tinkerers — control LEDs, servos, etc. via voice
Education — learn embedded AI and voice interaction development

zh.tag: 1324个健身动作数据集，含GIF动画与多语言指导
zh.what: 这是一个包含1324个健身动作的全面数据集，每个动作配有动画GIF、180×180缩略图、肌肉群与设备信息，以及10种语言的分步指导。它也是LogPress健身追踪应用的数据层。

zh.hot: 本月新增16896星，排名GitHub月榜第3。健身应用开发者急需高质量动作数据，该数据集直接可用且附带可视化，极大降低了开发门槛。
uses: 健身应用开发者 —— 直接集成到后端，快速构建动作库
机器学习研究者 —— 用于动作识别或推荐系统的训练数据
健康与健身教育者 —— 制作教学材料或演示

en.tag: 1,324-exercise fitness dataset with animation GIFs, thumbnails, and multi-language instructions
en.what: A comprehensive dataset of 1,324 fitness exercises, each with an animation GIF, 180×180 thumbnail, muscle-group & equipment data, and step-by-step instructions in 10 languages. It powers the LogPress workout tracker app.
en.content: The repo contains exercises.json (metadata), videos/ (GIF animations), images/ (thumbnails), index.html (interactive browser), and setup.html (developer guide).
en.stack: Data is stored in JSON format, media files are GIF and PNG, and the interactive browser is built with HTML/JavaScript.
en.hot: Gained 16,896 stars this month, ranking #3 on GitHub monthly trending. Fitness app developers urgently need high-quality exercise data; this dataset is ready-to-use with visualizations, greatly lowering development barriers.
uses: Fitness app developers — drop into backend to build exercise library quickly
Machine learning researchers — training data for exercise recognition or recommendation
Health & fitness educators — create teaching materials or demos

zh.tag: 为设计工程师打造的 AI 技能包，提升 UI 动画品味
zh.what: 这是一套面向设计工程师的 AI 技能集合，旨在帮助构建更好的用户界面。它基于作者在 Vercel 和 Linear 等公司的多年经验，列出了 AI 代理在动画和设计上常犯的细微错误，并给出修复方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能模块，如 emil-design-eng（动画与设计建议）、review-animations（严格审查动画）、improve-animations（审计并优化代码库动画）等，每个模块都是一个独立的 SKILL.md 文件。
zh.stack: 基于 npx 命令行工具安装，依赖 Node.js 环境。技能本身是 Markdown 文件，可被 AI 代理读取执行。
zh.hot: 本月新增 17933 星，总星数超 2.1 万，排名 GitHub Trending 月榜第 8。它精准切中了 AI 代理在 UI 设计上的痛点，提供“品味”解决方案，受到设计工程师和 AI 开发者的追捧。
uses: 设计工程师 —— 提升 UI 动画和设计决策的品味
AI 代理开发者 —— 为代理注入设计专业知识，避免常见错误
前端开发者 —— 学习动画最佳实践和设计原则

en.tag: AI skill pack for design engineers to level up UI animation taste
en.what: A collection of AI skills for design engineers to build better user interfaces. Based on the author's years of experience at Vercel and Linear, it lists common subtle mistakes AI agents make in animation and design, and provides fixes.
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill modules like emil-design-eng (animation & design advice), review-animations (strict animation review), improve-animations (audit and optimize codebase animations), each as a standalone SKILL.md file.
en.stack: Installed via npx CLI tool, requires Node.js. Skills are Markdown files that can be read and executed by AI agents.
en.hot: Gained 17,933 stars this month, total over 21k, ranked #8 on GitHub Trending monthly. It precisely addresses the pain point of AI agents' lack of design taste, offering a 'taste' solution, popular among design engineers and AI developers.
uses: Design engineers — improve taste in UI animation and design decisions
AI agent developers — inject design expertise into agents to avoid common mistakes
Frontend developers — learn animation best practices and design principles

zh.tag: AI驱动的价值投资研究框架，集成四位大师方法论
zh.what: AI Berkshire 是一套基于 Claude Code / Codex 的价值投资研究 Skill 合集，将巴菲特、芒格、段永平、李录四位大师的方法论系统化，通过多 Agent 并行研究实现专业级投资分析。一个人加上 AI 即可组成投研团队。

zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 Claude Code / Codex 作为 AI 引擎，使用命令行工具进行数据校验和报告生成。
zh.hot: 本月新增 13031 星，总星数 13750，因其将 AI Agent 与价值投资实战结合，提供可验证的实盘业绩（两年收益超 69% 和 66%），吸引了大量投资者和 AI 爱好者。

量化研究员 —— 借鉴结构化分析框架和反偏见机制
AI 应用开发者 —— 学习多 Agent 协作和金融数据校验的实现

en.tag: AI-powered value investing research framework integrating 4 masters' methodologies
en.what: AI Berkshire is a collection of value investing research Skills built for Claude Code / Codex, systematizing the methodologies of Buffett, Munger, Duan Yongping, and Li Lu. Quantitative researchers — adopt structured analysis and anti-bias mechanisms
AI application developers — learn multi-agent collaboration and financial data validation

zh.tag: 全球主流AI系统提示词泄露收录与透明度研究
zh.what: 持续抓取并归档 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Grok 等主流 AI 的系统提示词（system prompts），揭示模型在接收用户消息前的隐藏指令与行为规则。项目被《华盛顿邮报》等权威媒体引用，成为 AI 透明度研究的重要信源。
zh.content: 按厂商（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、xAI 等）分目录存放各产品的完整系统提示词文本，涵盖常规对话、编程助手（Claude Code、Copilot）、深度研究（Perplexity）等多场景版本。
zh.stack: 以 Markdown 文档为主，辅以简单的 JavaScript 脚本和 GitHub Actions 自动化更新，无需复杂后端依赖。
zh.hot: 本月新增近 3,000 Star 冲上 Trending 月榜第 3，反映出行业与公众对 AI 黑箱指令的极强好奇心；模型版本快速迭代也让提示词考古成为开发者刚需。
uses: AI 研究者与媒体 —— 分析不同厂商的系统级安全策略与价值观对齐方式
提示词工程师与开发者 —— 逆向学习顶级产品的指令工程技巧以优化自身应用
关注 AI 伦理的公众 —— 了解聊天机器人在对话前的隐藏规则与行为边界

en.tag: Leaked system prompts archive for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more
en.what: This repository systematically collects and archives leaked system prompts from leading AI chatbots like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok, exposing the hidden instructions and behavioral rules they receive before processing user messages. Cited by major outlets like The Washington Post, it serves as a key resource for AI transparency research.
en.content: Organized by vendor (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, etc.), the repo stores verbatim system prompt texts across products and scenarios, including general chat, coding agents (Claude Code, Copilot), and deep research modes (Perplexity).
en.stack: Primarily Markdown documentation with lightweight JavaScript utilities and GitHub Actions for automated updates, requiring no complex backend dependencies.
en.hot: Surging with nearly 3,000 new stars this month to hit #3 on GitHub Trending, it reflects intense curiosity about AI black box instructions; rapid model iteration has also made prompt archaeology essential for developers.
uses: AI researchers and journalists — analyze system-level safety policies and value alignment across vendors
Prompt engineers and developers — reverse-engineer instruction-engineering techniques from top products to optimize their own apps
AI-ethics-minded public — understand the hidden rules and behavioral boundaries chatbots follow before responding

zh.tag: 流式3D重建的几何上下文Transformer基础模型
zh.what: LingBot-Map 是一个前馈式 3D 基础模型，能够从流式数据中实时重建三维场景。它通过几何上下文 Transformer 架构，在单一流式框架内统一了坐标定位、密集几何线索编码与长程漂移校正。
zh.content: 仓库提供交互式演示脚本 demo.py、离线批量渲染管线，以及 KITTI 和 Oxford Spires 评估基准；预训练模型权重已同步发布在 HuggingFace 与 ModelScope。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 与 PyTorch 构建，核心采用 Transformer 架构，支持 SDPA 与 FlashInfer 双后端以加速超长序列的流式推理。
zh.hot: 该模型可在 518×378 分辨率下以约 20 FPS 稳定处理超 10,000 帧的长序列，月增 4,765 Star，总星数突破 12,000，跻身 GitHub Python 月榜第 18 名。
uses: 自动驾驶与机器人感知 —— 需要实时从连续视频流构建大规模 3D 场景地图。
AR/VR 内容生成 —— 为沉浸式应用提供高效的长序列几何重建与离线渲染能力。
计算机视觉研究者 —— 探索流式 3D 基础模型、几何 Transformer 与长程漂移校正的前沿方向。

en.tag: Geometric Context Transformer for real-time streaming 3D reconstruction
en.what: LingBot-Map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model that reconstructs scenes from streaming data in real time. It unifies coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction within a single streaming framework via its Geometric Context Transformer architecture.
en.content: The repo ships an interactive demo script (`demo.py`), an offline rendering pipeline, and evaluation benchmarks for KITTI and Oxford Spires, with pretrained weights hosted on both HuggingFace and ModelScope.
en.stack: Built in Python on PyTorch with a Transformer core, supporting both SDPA and FlashInfer backends to accelerate inference over extremely long sequences.
en.hot: Delivering stable ~20 FPS inference at 518×378 across sequences exceeding 10,000 frames, the project gained 4,765 stars this month, surpassing 12,000 total and hitting #18 on GitHub’s monthly Python Trending list.
uses: Autonomous driving & robotics teams — for real-time large-scale 3D mapping from continuous video streams.
AR/VR content creators — seeking efficient long-sequence geometric reconstruction and offline rendering for immersive experiences.
Computer-vision researchers — exploring streaming 3D foundation models, geometric Transformers, and long-range drift correction.

zh.tag: 让 AI 一键操控 Office 文档的开源命令行套件
zh.what: OfficeCLI 是专为 AI 智能体设计的 Office 办公套件，让 AI 能够通过一行代码读取、编辑和自动化生成 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 文件。它内置高保真 HTML 渲染引擎，可将文档转为 HTML 或 PNG，使 AI 具备可视化审阅与修正的能力。无需安装 Microsoft Office，单个二进制文件即可跨平台运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OfficeCLI 的核心源码、单一可执行二进制发布文件，以及丰富的示例资源（GIF 展示、文档模板等）和多语言 README。其核心是一个内置 HTML 渲染引擎的 C# 命令行工具，支持 .docx/.xlsx/.pptx 的高保真解析与渲染。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C# 开发，以单一二进制文件形式发布，不依赖 Microsoft Office 或任何外部运行时，支持跨平台运行。内置自研 HTML 渲染引擎负责将 Office 文档转换为 HTML/PNG 供 AI 视觉闭环使用。
zh.hot: 作为首个专为 AI 智能体打造的 Office 自动化工具，它精准切中了 Agent 时代 AI 处理办公文档的刚需；凭借「一行代码 + 无需 Office」的极简体验，一周内激增 4,611 Star，总星数逼近 1.9 万，强势登上 GitHub 周榜第 10。
uses: AI 智能体开发者 —— 需要让 Agent 具备读写 Office 文档能力的工程师
自动化办公场景 —— 批量生成报告、幻灯片、数据表格的无代码/低代码工作流
RAG / 企业知识库建设者 —— 需要高精度解析 Word/Excel/PPT 内容并供 AI 理解的团队
跨平台运维人员 —— 在无 Office 环境的 Linux/服务器上处理 Office 文件

en.tag: Open-source CLI suite that gives AI agents full control over Office documents
en.what: OfficeCLI is an open-source Office suite purpose-built for AI agents, enabling them to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files through a single command. It features a built-in high-fidelity HTML rendering engine that converts documents to HTML or PNG, giving AI agents visual 'eyes' for review and correction. It runs as a single binary without requiring any Microsoft Office installation or dependencies.
en.content: The repository contains the core C# source code, single-binary releases, and rich showcase assets including GIF demos and multi-language documentation. Its centerpiece is a CLI tool with a built-in HTML rendering engine that faithfully parses and renders .docx, .xlsx, and .pptx files.
en.stack: Built primarily in C# and distributed as a single, self-contained binary with zero external dependencies and no Microsoft Office installation required. It includes a custom-built HTML rendering engine that converts Office documents into HTML or PNG for AI visual feedback loops.
en.hot: As the world's first Office suite built specifically for AI agents, it directly addresses the urgent need for automated document processing in the Agent era. Its 'one-line command, zero Office install' experience fueled a surge of 4,611 stars this week, bringing the total to nearly 19,000 and landing it at #10 on GitHub Trending.
uses: AI agent developers who need to equip agents with the ability to read and write Office documents
Automation workflows that batch-generate reports, presentations, and spreadsheets with minimal setup
RAG and enterprise knowledge-base builders requiring high-fidelity parsing of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files
Cross-platform DevOps users who need to process Office files on Linux or servers without Microsoft Office installed

zh.tag: 高性能代码智能 MCP 服务器，毫秒级构建代码知识图谱
zh.what: 这是一个专为 AI 编程代理设计的高性能代码智能引擎，通过 Tree-sitter AST 分析将代码库索引为持久化知识图谱。它能在毫秒内完成普通仓库的全量索引，并以亚毫秒级延迟回答结构化查询。作为 MCP 服务器，它提供 15 个工具，支持 43 种客户端接入，可将 Token 消耗降低 99%。
zh.content: 仓库包含纯 C 编写的单静态二进制可执行文件，内置基于 Tree-sitter 的 158 语言解析器与 10 种语言的 Hybrid LSP 语义增强模块。产物为零依赖的跨平台（macOS/Linux/Windows）二进制，附带 15 个 MCP 工具与 5600+ 测试用例。
zh.stack: 核心采用纯 C 语言实现以保证极致性能与零依赖，通过 tree-sitter 生成 AST 并辅以 Hybrid LSP 进行语义类型解析。编译为单静态二进制分发，无需任何运行时依赖。
zh.hot: 本月暴涨 28,151 Star 至 32,528，冲上 GitHub 月榜第 2，反映出 AI Agent 生态对「极速代码理解基础设施」的迫切需求。相比逐文件探索，它实现 10 倍 Token 节省与 2.1 倍工具调用减少，成为开发者提升 AI 编码效率的热门选择。
uses: AI 编程代理开发者 —— 为 Cursor、Claude Code 等客户端提供秒级代码库记忆与结构化查询能力
大型代码库维护者 —— 在毫秒级内索引千万行级项目（如 Linux 内核），降低 AI 辅助理解的成本
追求极致效率的工程师 —— 通过单二进制零依赖部署，快速接入 158 种语言的亚毫秒代码检索
MCP 生态集成者 —— 利用 15 个标准化工具与 43 个客户端表面，构建自动化的代码分析流水线

en.tag: High-performance code-intelligence MCP server building persistent knowledge graphs in milliseconds
en.what: A high-performance code intelligence engine designed for AI coding agents that indexes entire codebases into persistent knowledge graphs via Tree-sitter AST analysis. It full-indexes average repositories in milliseconds and answers structural queries in under 1ms. As an MCP server, it exposes 15 tools across 43 client surfaces while cutting token usage by 99%.
en.content: A pure-C single static binary with built-in Tree-sitter parsers for 158 languages and Hybrid LSP semantic resolution for 10 languages. Ships as a zero-dependency, cross-platform executable (macOS/Linux/Windows) with 15 MCP tools and over 5,600 passing tests.
en.stack: Built entirely in C for extreme performance and zero dependencies, leveraging tree-sitter for AST generation and Hybrid LSP for semantic type resolution. Distributed as a single static binary requiring no runtime dependencies.
en.hot: Skyrocketed by 28,151 stars this month to 32,528, landing at #2 on GitHub's monthly Trending—reflecting soaring demand for lightning-fast code-intelligence infrastructure in the AI Agent era. It delivers 10× fewer tokens and 2.1× fewer tool calls versus file-by-file exploration, making it a go-to choice for AI-assisted coding workflows.
uses: AI agent developers —— Feed Cursor, Claude Code, and other MCP clients with instant codebase memory and sub-ms structural querying
Large-scale codebase maintainers —— Index multi-million-LOC projects like the Linux kernel in minutes, slashing AI comprehension costs
Efficiency-focused engineers —— Deploy a single zero-dependency binary to get sub-millisecond code search across 158 languages
MCP ecosystem integrators —— Leverage 15 standard tools and 43 client surfaces to build automated code-analysis pipelines

zh.tag: 个人 AI 交易代理，一条命令赋予全栈交易能力
zh.what: Vibe-Trading 是一个个人化的 AI 交易代理框架，只需一条命令即可部署具备完整市场分析、策略执行与风险管理能力的交易 Agent。它支持通过 API 和 MCP 协议与外部工具链集成，并配备 Shadow Account 模拟环境用于策略验证。项目由香港大学数据科学研究院（HKUDS）维护，提供从后端到前端的一站式解决方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 FastAPI 的 Python 后端、React 19 构建的可视化前端，以及支持 PyPI 一键安装的 CLI 工具。同时提供示例代码、API/MCP 接口文档和 Shadow Account 模拟交易模块。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+ 开发，后端采用 FastAPI，前端使用 React 19，通过 PyPI 包 `vibe-trading-ai` 分发。支持 API 与 MCP 协议扩展，便于接入外部数据源和交易工具。
zh.hot: 仓库已积累 24.7k Star，本周激增 5,616 并冲上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 4，反映出 AI Agent 与量化金融结合的巨大关注度。其「一键启动个人交易代理」的极低门槛和 HKUDS 的学术背书，持续吸引开发者与交易者涌入。
uses: 量化交易者 —— 希望用 AI Agent 自动化策略执行与风险监控。
AI Agent 开发者 —— 需要基于 MCP 协议扩展金融交易能力的工具链。
金融科技爱好者 —— 想通过 Shadow Account 零成本验证和迭代交易策略。
全栈开发者 —— 寻求基于 FastAPI + React 的开源交易系统参考架构。

en.tag: Personal AI trading agent empowering comprehensive capabilities with one command
en.what: Vibe-Trading is a personal AI trading agent framework that can be deployed with a single command to deliver comprehensive market analysis, strategy execution, and risk management. It supports integration with external toolchains via API and MCP protocols, and includes a Shadow Account simulation environment for strategy backtesting. Maintained by HKUDS, it provides an end-to-end solution from FastAPI backend to React frontend.
en.content: The repository includes a FastAPI-based Python backend, a React 19 visualization frontend, and a CLI tool installable via PyPI. It also ships with example code, API/MCP interface documentation, and a Shadow Account simulation module.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.11+ with a FastAPI backend and React 19 frontend, distributed via the PyPI package `vibe-trading-ai`. Supports API and MCP protocol extensions for easy integration with external data sources and trading tools.
en.hot: With 24.7k stars and a weekly surge of 5,616 to rank #4 on GitHub Trending, it reflects massive interest in the intersection of AI agents and quantitative finance. Its extremely low barrier to entry via "one command" deployment, backed by HKUDS's academic credibility, continues to attract developers and traders.
uses: Quantitative traders — looking to automate strategy execution and risk monitoring via AI agents.
AI agent developers — who need a toolchain for extending financial trading capabilities through MCP protocols.
Fintech enthusiasts — wanting to validate and iterate trading strategies at zero cost using the Shadow Account.
Full-stack developers — seeking an open-source trading system reference architecture based on FastAPI and React.

zh.tag: 为 Claude 等 AI 提供终端控制、文件搜索与 diff 编辑的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: DesktopCommanderMCP 是一个基于 Model Context Protocol（MCP）的服务器，它让 Claude 等 AI 客户端能够直接控制用户终端、搜索文件系统并执行基于 diff 的代码编辑。它超越了传统 AI 编辑器的局限，允许 AI 在获得授权后运行长时间命令、管理进程和自动化本地开发任务，且无需额外 API Token 成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器源码、基于 TypeScript 的终端与文件系统工具集，以及一个独立的 Desktop Commander App（Beta），后者提供可视化文件预览、Markdown 编辑器和对多模型（Claude/GPT-4.5/Gemini 等）的支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，基于 MCP Filesystem Server 构建，通过 Model Context Protocol 与 Claude Desktop 等客户端通信，并支持 npm 分发安装。
zh.hot: 在 AI 编程助手爆发式增长的背景下，该仓库凭借 8,467 Star（本周新增 1,657，冲至周榜第 5）的势头，精准解决了 AI 无法直接操作本地终端和文件系统的痛点，让开发者能用自然语言驱动完整的本地开发工作流。
uses: 开发者 —— 想通过自然语言让 AI 直接执行终端命令、批量修改代码文件
AI 工具链集成者 —— 需要在 Claude Desktop 或其他 MCP 客户端中扩展本地文件与命令行能力
追求效率的自动化用户 —— 希望在一个聊天界面中完成代码检索、编辑和进程管理的全流程

en.tag: MCP server granting Claude terminal control, file search & diff editing
en.what: DesktopCommanderMCP is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that grants Claude and other AI clients terminal control, filesystem search, and diff-based file editing capabilities. It goes beyond conventional AI editors by letting AI execute long-running commands, manage processes, and automate local development tasks using the host client's subscription instead of extra API tokens.
en.content: The repository contains the MCP server source code, a TypeScript-based toolkit for terminal and filesystem operations, and a standalone Desktop Commander App (Beta) with visual file previews, a Markdown editor, and support for multiple AI models.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript on top of the MCP Filesystem Server, it communicates with clients like Claude Desktop via the Model Context Protocol and is distributed via npm.
en.hot: Amid the AI coding assistant boom, it has surged to 8,467 stars with 1,657 added this week (ranking 5th on GitHub Trending), precisely solving the pain point of AI being unable to directly operate local terminals and filesystems, enabling developers to drive entire local workflows via natural language.
uses: Developers who want to execute terminal commands and batch-edit code via natural language instructions
AI toolchain integrators looking to extend Claude Desktop or other MCP clients with local filesystem and shell capabilities
Automation-minded users seeking a unified chat interface for code search, editing, and process management

zh.tag: 网页内嵌式 AI GUI Agent，纯文本操控无需截图
zh.what: Page Agent 是一个运行在浏览器页面内的 JavaScript GUI Agent，只需嵌入一段脚本即可让任何网页拥有自然语言操控能力。它通过纯文本 DOM 解析而非截图视觉感知来理解页面结构，使用户能用对话方式完成点击、输入、导航等操作。支持接入主流大模型（包括本地部署），并可选配 Chrome 扩展实现跨页面任务。
zh.content: 仓库核心是一个可嵌入任意网页的 JavaScript/TypeScript SDK，提供基于文本的 DOM 感知、LLM 调用编排和动作执行引擎；另包含可选的 Chrome 浏览器扩展、MCP 服务及官方文档站点。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，以 npm 包形式分发，无 Python 或无头浏览器依赖，仅通过浏览器原生 JavaScript 运行，可对接任意 OpenAI 兼容接口的主流或本地大模型。
zh.hot: 月增 8,521 Star 冲上 Trending 月榜第 10，它用纯前端方案解决了传统 AI Agent 依赖截图/多模态/浏览器扩展的痛点，实现了“一行脚本即可 AI 化任意网页”的极低接入成本。
uses: 前端开发者——无需改动后端即可为现有 Web 应用快速添加自然语言交互能力
自动化测试/运维人员——用文本指令替代传统脚本进行网页自动化操作
AI 产品团队——快速构建浏览器内的智能助手或 Copilot 体验
隐私敏感用户——支持纯本地模型，无需上传页面截图至云端

en.tag: In-page AI GUI agent using text-based DOM manipulation without screenshots
en.what: Page Agent is a JavaScript GUI agent that lives inside the browser page, giving any website natural language control with a single script embed. It understands page structure through text-based DOM parsing rather than screenshot vision, enabling conversational interaction for clicks, inputs, and navigation. It supports mainstream LLMs including local deployments, with an optional Chrome extension for multi-page workflows.
en.content: The repository centers on an embeddable JavaScript/TypeScript SDK that provides text-based DOM perception, LLM orchestration, and action execution; plus an optional Chrome extension, MCP server, and documentation site.
en.stack: Built in TypeScript and distributed as an npm package, it runs purely in-browser via native JavaScript without Python or headless browser dependencies, connecting to any OpenAI-compatible mainstream or local LLM.
en.hot: Surging 8,521 stars this month to hit Trending #10, it solves the pain points of traditional agents that require screenshots, multimodal LLMs, or browser extensions by offering a purely frontend, “one-script” AI integration for any webpage.
uses: Frontend developers — add natural language interaction to existing web apps without backend changes
Automation/test engineers — replace traditional scripts with text commands for web automation
AI product teams — rapidly build in-browser assistants or copilot experiences
Privacy-conscious users — run local LLMs without uploading page screenshots to the cloud

zh.tag: Claude Code 的 OpenAI Codex 插件，实现代码审查与任务委托
zh.what: 这是 OpenAI 官方为 Claude Code 开发的插件，让开发者无需离开终端环境即可调用 Codex 进行代码审查或任务委托。用户可通过斜杠命令执行只读评审、对抗性压力测试，或将编码任务后台交给 Codex 代理处理。
zh.content: 仓库包含插件源码、Claude Code 市场清单配置，以及内置的 /codex:* 斜杠命令和 codex-rescue 子代理。同时提供完整安装文档与演示视频，支持通过 npm 安装 Codex CLI 并自动处理登录与会话交接。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 18.18+ 构建，作为 Claude Code 插件运行，需 OpenAI Codex CLI 及 ChatGPT 订阅或 OpenAI API Key。通过 Claude Code 插件市场分发，并使用 npm 管理 Codex 全局安装。
zh.hot: 凭借 OpenAI 官方背书与 Claude Code 的庞大用户基础，该插件本周新增 1801 Star，以近 3 万总星标数冲入 GitHub 周榜第 12 名。它精准击中了开发者希望在同一终端内无缝切换 Claude 与 Codex 两大 AI 工作流的痛点。
uses: Claude Code 忠实用户 —— 希望在熟悉的终端工作流中直接复用 Codex 的审查与代理能力。
追求代码质量的团队 —— 需要对多文件变更进行常规审查或对抗性压力测试，发现潜在设计缺陷。
高频使用 AI 辅助编程的开发者 —— 想将耗时任务后台委托给 Codex，通过异步状态查询和结果拉取保持专注。
多 AI 工具链整合者 —— 试图打通 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 生态，构建统一的命令行 AI 开发环境。

en.tag: Claude Code plugin integrating OpenAI Codex for code review and task delegation
en.what: An official OpenAI plugin that embeds Codex capabilities directly into Claude Code, letting developers review and delegate coding tasks without leaving their terminal. It exposes slash commands for read-only reviews, adversarial pressure-testing, and background task delegation to Codex agents.
en.content: The repo hosts the plugin source, Claude Code marketplace manifest, and built-in slash commands such as /codex:review plus the codex-rescue subagent. It also includes comprehensive installation docs and a demo video, supporting npm-based Codex CLI setup and automated session hand-off.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript for Node.js 18.18+, it runs as a Claude Code plugin and requires the OpenAI Codex CLI along with a ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key. It is distributed via the Claude Code plugin marketplace and uses npm for global Codex CLI installation.
en.hot: Backed by OpenAI and Claude Code's large user base, the plugin gained 1,801 stars this week and reached #12 on GitHub Trending with nearly 29k total stars. It directly addresses developer demand for seamlessly switching between Claude and Codex within a single terminal workflow.
uses: Claude Code power users who want to leverage Codex review and agent capabilities inside their existing terminal workflow.
Teams focused on code quality looking to run standard or adversarial reviews on multi-file changes to uncover design flaws.
Developers heavily using AI-assisted coding who want to delegate long-running tasks to Codex in the background and check results asynchronously.
Multi-AI toolchain integrators aiming to bridge Anthropic and OpenAI ecosystems within a unified CLI environment.

zh.tag: 100+ 个能直接跑起来的 AI Agent 和 RAG 应用合集
zh.what: 超大号 LLM 应用模板库：收录 100 多个亲手构建并端到端测试过的 AI agent、agent skill 和 RAG 应用，全部 Apache-2.0 可商用。兼容 Claude、Gemini、GPT、DeepSeek、Llama、Qwen 等主流模型，克隆下来装依赖就能跑，口号「clone, customize, ship」。
zh.content: 按难度和形态分目录：agent_skills/（npx 一键装技能）、starter_ai_agents/（单文件入门）、advanced_ai_agents/（多智能体团队）、voice_ai_agents/、always_on_agents/、RAG 教程等；每个模板配 README 和依赖清单，场景覆盖旅行规划、金融分析、播客生成、房屋装修等。
zh.stack: Python 为主，常见 Streamlit 前端 + 各家模型 SDK，部分用 CrewAI/AG2 等多智能体框架。
zh.hot: 它用大量可运行示例降低 LLM 应用试验成本，并通过 Agent Skill 模板与教程保持对实践者的持续价值。
uses: AI 入门开发者 —— 克隆单文件模板，一天跑通第一个 LLM 应用
创业团队 —— 基于成熟模板二开（旅行规划 / 金融分析 / 播客生成）快速验证 idea
企业技术选型 —— 横向对比 CrewAI / AG2 等框架的真实代码

en.tag: 100+ AI Agent & RAG apps you can actually run
en.what: A giant library of LLM app templates: 100+ hand-built, end-to-end-tested AI agents, agent skills and RAG apps, all Apache-2.0 (commercial use OK). Works with Claude, Gemini, GPT, DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen and more — clone, install deps, run. The motto: 'clone, customize, ship'.
en.content: Organized by difficulty and form: agent_skills/ (one-line npx installs), starter_ai_agents/ (single-file starters), advanced_ai_agents/ (multi-agent teams), voice_ai_agents/, always_on_agents/, RAG tutorials and more; each template ships a README and requirements, covering travel planning, financial analysis, podcast generation, home renovation…
en.stack: Mostly Python, usually a Streamlit frontend over OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic SDKs, some CrewAI/AG2 multi-agent frameworks.
en.hot: Its broad, example-led catalog lowers the cost of trying LLM applications, while agent-skill templates and tutorials keep the collection useful to practitioners.
uses: AI beginners — clone a single-file template and ship your first LLM app in a day
Startup teams — fork mature templates (travel planning, finance analysis, podcast generation) to validate ideas fast
Enterprise evaluators — compare CrewAI / AG2 and other frameworks on real code

zh.tag: 开源低延迟语音代理框架，支持全本地模块化VAD-STT-LLM-TTS流水线
zh.what: Hugging Face 推出的开源语音代理框架，通过一条 VAD → STT → LLM → TTS 的模块化流水线，让用户能在本地或混合环境中搭建低延迟语音对话系统。它对外暴露兼容 OpenAI Realtime API 的 WebSocket 接口，任何兼容客户端都能直接接入，且每个环节均可替换为自托管或开源模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含可插拔的流水线引擎、OpenAI Realtime 兼容的 WebSocket 服务端、开箱即用的 CLI，以及支持多语言和 Pocket TTS 的脚本与文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，默认集成 Parakeet TDT（STT）与 Qwen3-TTS（语音合成），LLM 端支持 OpenAI API、HF Inference Providers、vLLM 及 llama.cpp 等任意兼容后端。
zh.hot: 在语音 Agent 爆发期，它以「全模块可替换 + 全本地可运行」直击开发者对隐私与可控性的痛点；本月新增 1,334 Star，总星数 6,149，冲上 Python 月榜第 10，并已实际部署在数千台 Reachy Mini 机器人上。
uses: 希望搭建本地语音助手、避免数据外泄的开发者与初创团队
需要将 LLM 快速接入语音交互、并要求兼容 OpenAI Realtime 协议的硬件/机器人厂商
关注低延迟对话系统、想自定义 VAD/STT/TTS 模块的研究者与工程师

en.tag: Low-latency modular voice-agent pipeline with fully local VAD-STT-LLM-TTS stack
en.what: An open-source voice-agent framework from Hugging Face that chains VAD → STT → LLM → TTS into a low-latency, fully modular pipeline for local or hybrid deployments. It exposes an OpenAI Realtime-compatible WebSocket API so any compatible client can connect, with every component swappable for self-hosted or open-source models.
en.content: The repo includes a pluggable pipeline engine, an OpenAI Realtime-compatible WebSocket server, a ready-to-use CLI, plus scripts and docs supporting multi-language and Pocket TTS.
en.stack: Built in Python, defaulting to Parakeet TDT for STT and Qwen3-TTS for synthesis, with the LLM slot supporting any OpenAI-compatible backend including hosted APIs, HF Inference Providers, vLLM, and llama.cpp.
en.hot: It hits the sweet spot for privacy and control with a fully swappable, fully local stack amid the voice-agent boom; it gained 1,334 stars this month for a total of 6,149, hitting #10 on the Python monthly trending list, and already powers thousands of Reachy Mini robots in production.
uses: Developers and startups building local voice assistants who need to keep data on-premise
Hardware/robotics vendors looking to add LLM-powered voice interfaces via an OpenAI Realtime-compatible protocol
Researchers and engineers experimenting with low-latency dialog systems who want to swap VAD, STT, or TTS components

zh.tag: AI简历评估代理：PDF解析、GitHub信号增强与可解释评分
zh.what: Hiring Agent 解析 PDF 简历并提取结构化数据，结合候选人的 GitHub 档案与项目信号进行 enrichment，再通过本地或托管 LLM 生成带有证据、加分项与扣分的客观评估报告。
zh.content: 仓库包含 PDF 转 Markdown 的解析模块、基于 Jinja 模板的 LLM 提取与评估流水线、GitHub 数据抓取及分类器，以及 Pydantic 模型、提示词模板和 CLI 入口。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，可选 Ollama 本地模型或 Google Gemini API；依赖 PyMuPDF、Pydantic、Jinja2，以 Black 规范代码风格。
zh.hot: 该项目位列 GitHub 月榜第 12，一个月内新增 4955 Star 至 6030，反映出市场对可解释、隐私可控的 AI 招聘自动化工具的强烈需求。
uses: 需要批量初筛技术简历的 HR 与招聘团队
希望结合 GitHub 代码贡献进行技术面试初评的工程师主管
想在本地安全环境评估简历、避免数据泄露的合规型企业
寻求标准化、可解释评分以减少招聘偏见的组织

en.tag: AI agent that parses PDFs, enriches GitHub data, and outputs explainable scores
en.what: Hiring Agent parses PDF resumes into structured JSON data. It augments candidate profiles with GitHub signals, then leverages a local or hosted LLM to generate fair, explainable evaluations complete with category scores and evidence.
en.content: The repo includes PDF-to-Markdown parsing, LLM extraction and evaluation pipelines driven by Jinja templates, GitHub data fetching and classification, plus Pydantic schemas, prompt templates and a CLI entry point.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.11+, supporting either Ollama local models or Google Gemini API; uses PyMuPDF, Pydantic, and Jinja2 with Black code formatting.
en.hot: Ranking #12 on GitHub's monthly Trending, it gained 4,955 stars in one month to reach 6,030, reflecting strong demand for explainable, privacy-controlled AI hiring automation. Full local support via Ollama lets companies keep sensitive resume data on-premise, a key driver of its rapid adoption.
uses: HR and recruiting teams batch-screening technical resumes
Engineering leads factoring GitHub contributions into candidate reviews
Compliance-focused enterprises needing on-premise, local-LLM evaluation
Organizations aiming to reduce hiring bias through standardized, explainable scoring

zh.tag: 开源智能体视频制作系统，将AI编程助手升级为视频工作室
zh.what: OpenMontage 是全球首个开源的智能体驱动视频制作系统，通过 12 条流水线、52 款工具和 500 余项智能体技能，将用户的 AI 编程助手转化为完整的视频生产工作室。用户只需提供灵感或参考视频，即可由多智能体协作完成从脚本、素材到成片的自动化视频创作。
zh.content: 仓库内置了 12 条可编排的视频生产流水线、52 个专用工具模块以及超过 500 项智能体技能配置，涵盖从脚本生成、素材处理到后期合成的完整链路。项目以 Python 为主语言，提供快速启动指南、提示词模板及多模型提供商接入文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，采用智能体编排架构，支持接入 Claude、ChatGPT、DeepSeek 等主流大模型 API，并依赖 Bloome 等多智能体协作平台与 Atlas Cloud 等全模态推理服务完成视频生成与图像合成。
zh.hot: 项目上线短期内狂揽 39.6K Star，其中本月新增 34.7K，登顶 GitHub Trending 月榜第 1，反映出社区对「智能体驱动视频自动化」的强烈需求。其首创的「将 AI 编程助手转化为视频工作室」理念，填补了开源领域端到端智能视频生产的空白。
uses: AI 开发者与智能体研究者——希望基于开源架构快速搭建自动化视频工作流
内容创作者与自媒体团队——需要批量生成短视频、广告或解说视频
编程爱好者与 AI 辅助用户——想将已有的 AI Coding Assistant 升级为视频生产工具
开源社区与技术布道者——寻找可扩展、可定制的多智能体协作视频方案

en.tag: Open-source agentic video production: turn AI coding assistant into studio
en.what: OpenMontage is the world's first open-source, agentic video production system. It transforms your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio through 12 pipelines, 52 tools, and 500+ agent skills. Users can paste a reference video or provide prompts to automate end-to-end video creation via multi-agent collaboration.
en.content: The repository contains 12 orchestrated video production pipelines, 52 dedicated tool modules, and 500+ agent skill configurations covering scripting, asset processing, and post-production. Written primarily in Python, it includes quick-start guides, prompt templates, and provider integration docs for multi-model backends.
en.stack: Built on Python with an agent orchestration architecture, it supports mainstream LLM APIs such as Claude, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek. It leverages multi-agent collaboration platforms like Bloome and full-modal inference services like Atlas Cloud for video generation and image synthesis.
en.hot: The project has skyrocketed to 39.6K stars with 34.7K added this month, claiming the #1 spot on GitHub Trending monthly rankings. This reflects massive community demand for agentic video automation, as its pioneering concept of turning AI coding assistants into video studios fills a gap in open-source end-to-end intelligent video production.
uses: AI developers and agent researchers seeking to build automated video workflows on open-source architecture.
Content creators and social media teams needing batch production of short videos, ads, or explainer clips.
Coding enthusiasts and AI-assisted users who want to upgrade their existing AI coding assistant into a video production tool.
Open-source communities and tech evangelists looking for scalable, customizable multi-agent collaborative video solutions.

zh.tag: 开源 AI 记忆平台，为 Agent 提供持久化长期记忆与自托管知识图谱
zh.what: Cognee 是专为 AI Agent 打造的开源记忆平台，解决跨会话失忆问题。它通过自托管的知识图谱引擎，让 Agent 能够保存、检索和关联长期记忆，确保每次交互都基于完整上下文。平台支持多格式数据摄入，使 Agent 可以像人类一样积累经验并持续进化。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 核心 SDK、知识图谱引擎、多模态数据接入管道、记忆存储与检索模块，以及详尽的文档和示例代码。此外还设有独立的社区插件仓库 cognee-community，便于开发者扩展功能和对接外部系统。
zh.stack: 主要基于 Python 构建，以知识图谱作为记忆存储与关联的核心，支持自托管部署。可灵活对接各类大语言模型（LLM）与向量数据库，形成完整的记忆基础设施。
zh.hot: 本月新增 10,292 Star，总星数突破 2.8 万并登上 GitHub Python 月榜第 5 名，反映出 AI Agent 浪潮下业界对记忆基础设施的迫切需求。其开源、自托管与知识图谱方案精准切中了开发者对数据主权和 Agent 长期记忆能力的双重痛点。
uses: AI Agent 开发者 —— 为 Chatbot 或自主 Agent 添加跨会话的长期记忆能力
企业知识管理 —— 自托管构建私有知识图谱，打造安全可控的 AI 记忆中枢
LLM 应用架构师 —— 需要可解释、可溯源的记忆层来替代简单的向量检索
隐私敏感型团队 —— 希望在本地或私有云部署，确保业务数据不出域

en.tag: Open-source AI memory platform giving agents persistent long-term memory via self-hosted knowledge graphs
en.what: Cognee is an open-source AI memory platform built for agents to solve cross-session amnesia. It enables agents to retain, retrieve, and connect long-term memories through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine, grounding every interaction in full context. The platform supports multi-format data ingestion so agents can accumulate experience and evolve continuously.
en.content: The repository houses a Python core SDK, a knowledge graph engine, multi-modal data ingestion pipelines, memory storage and retrieval modules, along with comprehensive docs and examples. It also links to a separate community plugins repo (cognee-community) for add-ons and external system integrations.
en.stack: Built primarily in Python with a knowledge graph as the core for memory storage and relationship mapping, it supports self-hosted deployment and flexibly integrates with various LLMs and vector databases to form a complete memory infrastructure.
en.hot: With 10,292 new stars this month and over 28K total to hit #5 on GitHub's Python monthly trending list, it reflects the industry's urgent demand for memory infrastructure amid the AI agent boom. Its open-source, self-hosted knowledge graph approach precisely addresses developer pain points around data sovereignty and persistent agent memory.
uses: AI agent developers —— adding cross-session long-term memory to chatbots or autonomous agents
Enterprise knowledge teams —— self-hosting private knowledge graphs for a secure, controllable AI memory hub
LLM application architects —— needing an interpretable and traceable memory layer beyond simple vector search
Privacy-conscious teams —— requiring on-premise or private-cloud deployment to keep data within their own infrastructure

zh.tag: 用代码智能体编辑视频，自然语言驱动
zh.what: video-use 让你通过 Claude Code 等代码智能体，用自然语言指令编辑视频。只需将原始素材放入文件夹，与智能体对话，即可获得最终成品 final.mp4，无需手动操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含安装脚本、技能定义文件（SKILL.md）、编辑脚本（helpers/）以及依赖管理。支持自动剪辑、调色、字幕、动画叠加等功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 ffmpeg、ElevenLabs API，并集成 HyperFrames、Remotion、Manim 等动画生成工具。
zh.hot: 17k+ Stars，今日新增 110，因其将 AI 智能体与视频编辑结合，极大降低了视频创作门槛，吸引开发者和内容创作者。
uses: 内容创作者 — 快速剪辑口播、教程、旅行视频，无需打开专业编辑软件
开发者 — 集成到自动化工作流，用代码控制视频编辑流程
团队协作 — 通过项目文件持久化会话，多轮编辑无缝衔接

en.tag: Edit videos with coding agents via natural language
en.what: video-use lets you edit videos by chatting with coding agents like Claude Code. Drop raw footage in a folder, describe your edits in natural language, and get final.mp4 back—no manual editing required.
en.content: The repo includes installation scripts, skill definition (SKILL.md), editing scripts (helpers/), and dependency management. It supports auto-cutting, color grading, subtitles, animation overlays, and more.
en.stack: Built with Python, relies on ffmpeg, ElevenLabs API, and integrates with HyperFrames, Remotion, Manim for animation generation.
en.hot: 17k+ stars, +110 today, because it combines AI agents with video editing, dramatically lowering the barrier for video creation, attracting both developers and content creators.
uses: Content creators — quickly edit talking heads, tutorials, travel videos without opening professional editing software
Developers — integrate into automated workflows, control video editing with code
Team collaboration — persist sessions via project files for seamless multi-round editing

zh.tag: 后训练微调框架，提供SDK与实用食谱
zh.what: Tinker Cookbook 是一个用于语言模型后训练（post-training）的框架，包含训练 SDK 和丰富的微调示例。它通过 Tinker API 简化分布式训练，并提供 Inkling 模型支持，可进行推理、工具调用、多模态处理等。

zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 Tinker API，可选集成 torch 和 tml-renderers 以支持 Inkling 模型。
zh.hot: 提供开箱即用的后训练工具，结合 Inkling 模型的多模态能力，吸引了近 4000 星，本月新增 417 星。
uses: 研究人员和开发者 —— 快速微调语言模型，无需管理分布式训练基础设施
企业用户 —— 使用 Inkling 模型进行推理、工具调用和多模态处理
AI 教育者 —— 学习后训练技术，参考微调食谱

en.tag: Post-training fine-tuning framework with SDK and cookbook recipes
en.what: Tinker Cookbook is a framework for post-training language models, featuring a training SDK and a collection of fine-tuning examples. It simplifies distributed training via the Tinker API and supports the Inkling model for reasoning, tool calling, and multimodal processing.
en.content: The repo contains the tinker SDK for sending training requests, tinker-cookbook with fine-tuning recipes, and support for sampling and post-training the Inkling model.
en.stack: Built with Python, depends on Tinker API, optionally integrates torch and tml-renderers for Inkling model support.
en.hot: Offers ready-to-use post-training tools combined with Inkling's multimodal capabilities, attracting nearly 4000 stars with 417 added this month.
uses: Researchers and developers — quickly fine-tune language models without managing distributed training infrastructure
Enterprise users — leverage Inkling for reasoning, tool calling, and multimodal processing
AI educators — learn post-training techniques via cookbook recipes

zh.tag: 给 AI Agent 一键接入全网内容的免费开源工具箱
zh.what: Agent Reach 是一款专为 AI Agent 设计的开源互联网接入工具，通过一条命令行即可让 Agent 读取 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、Bilibili、小红书等主流平台内容。它采用零 API 费用的设计，通过多后端路由自动绕过平台封锁和登录限制，让 Agent 真正拥有“看”互联网的能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台内容读取模块（网页、视频、社交媒体、RSS）、多后端智能路由系统、一键诊断工具 agent-reach doctor，以及面向 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf 等 Agent 的即装即用 CLI 安装脚本。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+ 构建，核心依赖包括 yt-dlp/bili-cli 等视频解析后端、MCP 语义搜索接入、Playwright 或浏览器 Cookie 方案，以及模块化 CLI 架构支持各平台热插拔。
zh.hot: 该仓库在一个月内新增 25,126 Star，总量突破 57,000，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜第 11。其爆火源于精准切中了 AI Agent“能思考却无法上网”的痛点，以零成本和一键安装方案替代了繁琐的 API 配置与反爬对抗。
uses: AI Agent 开发者 —— 无需为每个平台单独写爬虫或购买 API，一行命令即可扩展 Agent 的感知边界
自动化研究员/分析师 —— 让 Agent 自动监控 Reddit、Twitter、小红书等多平台舆情与竞品动态
个人效率用户 —— 在 Claude Code、Cursor 等对话式工具中直接要求“搜索 B站教程”或“总结 GitHub Issue”
开源维护者 —— 通过诊断命令快速排查平台接口失效问题，社区自动维护多后端路由

en.tag: Open-source CLI toolbox that gives AI agents free eyes across the entire internet
en.what: Agent Reach is an open-source internet access toolkit designed for AI agents, enabling them to read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu via a single CLI command. It adopts a zero-API-fee design with multi-backend routing to automatically bypass platform blocks and login restrictions, giving agents true eyes to browse the web.
en.content: The repo packs cross-platform content readers for webpages, videos, social media and RSS, a smart multi-backend routing system, a one-click diagnostic tool (`agent-reach doctor`), and ready-to-use CLI install scripts for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf and other agents.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+ with core dependencies including video parsers like yt-dlp/bili-cli, MCP-based semantic search, Playwright or browser cookie solutions, and a modular CLI architecture for hot-swappable platform adapters.
en.hot: It gained 25,126 stars in just one month, hitting 57,000+ total and ranking #11 on GitHub's monthly Trending. It exploded because it precisely solves the pain point of AI agents that can think but can't browse, replacing tedious API setups and anti-bot battles with a zero-cost, one-command install.
uses: AI Agent developers —— Expand agent perception boundaries with one command instead of writing scrapers or buying APIs for each platform
Automation researchers & analysts —— Let agents monitor multi-platform sentiment and competitor trends across Reddit, Twitter, and XiaoHongShu
Personal productivity users —— Directly ask Claude Code or Cursor to search Bilibili tutorials or summarize GitHub issues within chat
Open-source maintainers —— Quickly diagnose platform outages via doctor commands while the community maintains multi-backend routes

zh.tag: 基于个人信息的密码字典生成器，用于渗透测试与取证
zh.what: CUPP 通过交互式问卷收集目标用户的生日、昵称、宠物名等个人信息，生成高度定制化的弱密码字典，用于针对性破解。它专为合法渗透测试和取证调查设计，帮助安全人员快速评估密码强度。
zh.content: 仓库核心为单文件 Python 脚本 cupp.py，附带配置文件 cupp.cfg，支持交互式画像、外部词库下载、Alecto 数据库解析及现有字典增强。
zh.stack: 完全基于 Python 3 标准库开发，零第三方依赖，跨平台开箱即用。
zh.hot: 总星数 6413，本月激增 468 星并跻身 Python 月榜第 17，反映出网络安全与隐私测试领域持续升温，轻量级社会工程学工具再度受到白帽与安全研究者热捧。
uses: 渗透测试人员 —— 在授权测试中利用社会工程学信息生成定向爆破字典
安全取证专家 —— 在调查现场根据已知用户画像快速缩小密码范围
网络安全学习者 —— 在 CTF 或实验环境中理解弱密码与社会工程学的关系
企业安全团队 —— 评估内部员工密码习惯并制定针对性加固策略

en.tag: Personal-info-based password profiler and dictionary generator for pentesting
en.what: CUPP collects target personal information—such as birthdays, nicknames, and pet names—through interactive questionnaires to generate highly customized weak-password dictionaries for targeted cracking. It is designed for legal penetration tests and forensic investigations to help security professionals quickly assess password strength.
en.content: The repo centers on a single Python script cupp.py with a configuration file cupp.cfg, supporting interactive profiling, external wordlist downloads, Alecto DB parsing, and enhancing existing dictionaries.
en.stack: Built entirely on Python 3 standard libraries with zero third-party dependencies; works cross-platform out of the box.
en.hot: With 6413 total stars and 468 new stars this month, ranking 17th on the Python monthly trending list, CUPP reflects rising interest in cybersecurity and privacy testing, as lightweight social-engineering tools regain popularity among white-hat researchers.
uses: Penetration testers — generate targeted brute-force dictionaries from OSINT during authorized engagements
Forensic investigators — quickly narrow down password ranges using known user profiles at investigation sites
Cybersecurity learners — study the relationship between weak passwords and social engineering in CTF or lab environments
Enterprise security teams — assess internal password habits and formulate targeted hardening strategies

zh.tag: 把整个项目文件夹变成可查询知识图谱的 AI 技能
zh.what: 给 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手用的 skill：输入 /graphify，它就把整个项目（代码、SQL schema、文档、PDF、图片、视频）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱，代替 grep 翻文件。代码解析走 tree-sitter AST —— 确定性、不用 LLM、完全本地；文档类内容才走模型做语义处理。不是向量索引，是真图谱，每条边标注 EXTRACTED（直接读到）还是 INFERRED（推断出来）。
zh.content: 以 CLI 形式分发（PyPI 包 graphifyy，uv tool install 或 pipx 安装），仓库含 docs/（30 多种语言 README 翻译）和交互式 graph.html 可视化产物；默认分支 v8，迭代很快。
zh.stack: Python + tree-sitter 代码解析，产出力导向 HTML 图；挂到各家 CLI 助手上当 skill 用。
zh.hot: 它用知识图谱补足纯向量检索的局限，直接回应团队构建上下文型 AI 助手时遇到的 RAG 难题。
uses: 接手中大型老项目的开发者 —— 一条命令生成知识图谱，快速搞清代码结构
AI 重度用户 —— 给 agent 换图谱上下文，替代检索不准的向量 RAG
技术文档团队 —— 把文档 / PDF / 图纸一起纳入可查询图谱

en.tag: An AI skill that turns a whole project folder into a queryable knowledge graph
en.what: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more: type /graphify and your entire project — code, SQL schemas, docs, PDFs, images, videos — is mapped into a queryable knowledge graph, replacing grep-and-scroll. Code parsing uses tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, fully local; only document content goes through a model. Not a vector index — a real graph, with every edge labeled EXTRACTED (read directly) or INFERRED.
en.content: Distributed as a CLI (PyPI package graphifyy, install via uv tool install or pipx); the repo holds docs/ (README translations in 30+ languages) and interactive graph.html visualizations; default branch v8, iterating fast.
en.stack: Python + tree-sitter, outputting force-directed HTML graphs; hooks into each CLI assistant as a skill.
en.hot: Its knowledge-graph alternative to vector-only retrieval speaks directly to limitations teams encounter when building contextual AI assistants.
uses: Developers inheriting large legacy projects — one command maps the codebase into a knowledge graph
Heavy AI users — swap vector RAG for graph context that retrieves the right thing
Docs teams — fold docs, PDFs and diagrams into one queryable graph

zh.tag: 将书籍、长视频与播客蒸馏为可执行 AI Agent Skill 的方法论流水线
zh.what: cangjie-skill 通过 RIA-TV++ 七阶段流水线，将书籍、长视频、播客等高价值长内容中可迁移的方法论抽取并结构化为可独立调用的 AI Skill。不同于简单摘要，它面向 Agent 执行产出包含技能地图、术语词典、压力测试用例及可直接安装到 Claude Code / Cursor 的 Skill 工具包，解决“看过却用不起来”的痛点。
zh.content: 仓库核心是 RIA-TV++ 的实现脚本与规范，涵盖 Adler 分析、五路并行提取、三重验证筛选、RIA++ 结构化、Zettelkasten 索引、压力测试等七个阶段的工具链。交付物模板包括 BOOK_OVERVIEW.md、INDEX.md、DIGEST.md、GLOSSARY.md、各 SKILL.md 模块及 test-prompts.json，形成完整的多 Skill 仓库结构。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，基于 Mortimer Adler 分析阅读法与赵周 RIA 拆书法设计，依赖大语言模型进行并行提取与验证，最终输出适配 Claude Code 与 Cursor 的 Skill 格式；视频处理需配合独立的 video-downloader skill 进行字幕/音频转写。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub Trending 周榜位列第 15，一周内新增 1,158 Star，总星数达 3,558，反映出开发者对“从被动阅读到可执行 Agent 技能”这一范式的高度关注。其精准切中了知识工作者“收藏即落灰”的痛点，将长内容蒸馏为 Agent 可调用的工具包，契合当前 AI 代理工程化落地的热潮。
uses: 希望把书籍、课程、长视频里的方法论转化为 AI 可调用工具的知识工作者
使用 Claude Code / Cursor 开发，需要为项目团队沉淀可复用 Skill 的工程师
追求结构化学习、拒绝“收藏即落灰”的高效阅读者与内容创作者
需要批量处理播客、访谈、演讲并生成可验证技能库的 AI 应用开发者

en.tag: A methodology pipeline to distill books, videos and podcasts into executable AI agent skills
en.what: cangjie-skill is a RIA-TV++ pipeline that extracts actionable methodologies from long-form content—books, videos, podcasts—and structures them into reusable AI agent skills. Instead of generating simple summaries, it produces executable skill kits including skill maps, glossaries, stress tests, and installable modules for Claude Code and Cursor, bridging the gap between passive consumption and active execution.
en.content: The repo provides the RIA-TV++ implementation scripts and specifications across seven stages: Adler analysis, parallel extraction, triple verification, RIA++ structuring, Zettelkasten indexing, and stress testing. It ships with deliverable templates including BOOK_OVERVIEW.md, INDEX.md, DIGEST.md, GLOSSARY.md, individual SKILL.md modules, and test-prompts.json, forming a complete multi-skill repository.
en.stack: Built primarily in Python, it combines Mortimer Adler's analytical reading and the RIA note-taking method, relying on LLMs for parallel extraction and verification to produce skills compatible with Claude Code and Cursor; video workflows require the companion video-downloader skill for subtitle and audio transcription.
en.hot: Ranked #15 on GitHub Trending with 1,158 new stars this week and 3,558 total, it signals strong developer interest in moving from passive reading to executable agent skills. It directly addresses the "read-later graveyard" pain point by turning long-form content into callable agent toolkits, aligning with the current wave of AI agent engineering.
uses: Knowledge workers who want to convert methodologies from books, courses, and videos into callable AI tools
Engineers using Claude Code or Cursor who need to build reusable skill libraries for their teams
Active learners and content creators seeking structured knowledge instead of endless "read-later" lists
AI application developers looking to batch-process podcasts, interviews, and speeches into verified skill repositories

en.tag: 360+ production-ready skills & plugins for 13 AI coding agents
en.what: An open-source library providing 362 production-ready skills and plugins for 13 AI coding agents including Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, and Cursor. Covers engineering, DevOps, marketing, security, compliance, C-level advisory, academic research, and enterprise operations.

zh.tag: 自托管 ROM 管理与在线模拟器
zh.what: RomM 是一款自托管的 ROM 管理器与在线播放器，支持扫描、元数据增强、浏览和游玩游戏合集。它兼容多种平台、命名方案和自定义标签，是模拟器玩家的必备工具。

zh.tag: 开源版 CapCut（剪映），免费跨平台视频编辑器
zh.what: 免费开源视频编辑器，对标 CapCut，目标覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端。项目正在从零重写：Editor API、插件优先架构、Rust 核心（一套代码跑桌面/移动/浏览器）、供 AI agent 调用的 MCP server、无头批量渲染模式和编辑器内置脚本页。旧版代码已迁至 opencut-classic 继续维护。

uses: 自媒体创作者 —— 免费替代剪映专业版，无水印跨平台剪片
开发者 / 自动化团队 —— 通过 MCP server 让 AI agent 批量剪视频

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing
en.what: A free, open-source video editor rivaling CapCut, targeting web, desktop and mobile. The project is being rewritten from scratch: an Editor API, plugin-first architecture, a Rust core (one codebase for desktop/mobile/browser), an MCP server so AI agents can edit video, a headless mode for automated batch rendering, and built-in editor scripting. Legacy code lives on in opencut-classic.
en.content: A monorepo: apps/web, apps/desktop and apps/api, with a root Cargo.toml for the Rust core; toolchain managed by moonrepo + proto — `moon run web:dev` starts local dev.
en.stack: TypeScript (web frontend) + Rust core, Bun for packages, MIT; external code contributions are paused during the rewrite.
en.hot: The open-source alternative to CapCut addresses broad latent demand, while the Rust rewrite and MCP-based AI editing story give the project a distinct technical direction.
uses: Content creators — a free, watermark-free CapCut Pro alternative across platforms
Dev & automation teams — batch-edit video via AI agents over the MCP server
Companies — build internal video pipelines on the Editor API and plugin architecture

zh.tag: 给设计工程师准备的一套 UI 类 Agent Skills

en.what: shadcn/ui is a collection of beautifully designed components that you can customize, extend, and build upon. It also serves as a code distribution platform, allowing you to copy component code directly into your project instead of installing it as a dependency.
en.content: The repository includes component source code, documentation site, example apps, and a CLI tool. Components are provided as source code, allowing full customization.
en.stack: Built on React (with adapters for Vue, Svelte, etc.), Tailwind CSS, and Radix UI primitives. Written in TypeScript.
en.hot: It gained massive popularity due to its innovative 'copy instead of install' approach and high-quality design, with nearly 3,000 new stars this month and a total of almost 120,000 stars.
uses: Frontend developers — quickly build beautiful and accessible UIs
Design system teams — use as a foundation for a custom component library with easy branding
Full-stack developers — integrate with frameworks like Next.js, Vite, etc.

zh.tag: 夜间自主运行 AI 编码代理的 CLI 编排器
zh.what: gnhf 是一个自主代理编排器，让你在睡眠期间保持 AI 编码代理持续运行。它会自动执行迭代任务，每次只做一个小的、已提交的、有文档记录的变更，朝目标推进。
zh.content: 提供单一 CLI 入口，支持自动循环迭代、Git 提交与回滚、失败重试、worktree 多代理并发，以及运行摘要和日志记录。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows，兼容主流编码 Agent CLI 及 ACP 目标，通过 npm 分发。
zh.hot: 以「晚安，玩得开心」的趣味概念精准击中开发者痛点——让 AI 在夜间自动打工；本月新增 1,152 Star，冲至 TypeScript 月榜第 10，反映了社区对「无人值守式」Agent 工作流的高度需求。
uses: 需要夜间或后台自动完成编码任务的开发者
希望同时运行多个 AI Agent 处理不同模块的工程师
追求干净 Git 历史与自动提交/回滚机制的自动化爱好者

en.tag: CLI orchestrator for running AI coding agents autonomously overnight
en.what: gnhf is an autonomous agent orchestrator that keeps AI coding agents running while you sleep. It automates iterative tasks, making one small, committed, documented change at a time toward an objective.
en.content: A single CLI entrypoint featuring an autonomous loop, Git commit/rollback, failure retries, worktree-based multi-agent concurrency, and run summaries with logging.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, supporting macOS/Linux/Windows, compatible with popular coding agent CLIs and ACP targets, distributed via npm.
en.hot: Its playful 'good night, have fun' concept perfectly addresses the developer pain point of letting AI work overnight autonomously; gaining 1,152 stars this month and hitting #10 on the TypeScript monthly trending list reflects strong community demand for unattended agent workflows.
uses: Developers who need coding tasks completed automatically overnight or in the background
Engineers wanting to run multiple AI agents on different modules simultaneously
Automation enthusiasts who value clean Git history with auto-commit and rollback

zh.tag: 面向AI创作的开源无限画布工作台
zh.what: 无限画布是一款集成AI生图、参考图编辑、视频生成、Agent智能助手、画布编排、对话创作、提示词库与素材管理等能力的开源工作台。它支持可视化创作流程与多Agent协同工作，兼容OpenAI接口生态。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端应用（基于Vite+React Router）、本地Canvas Agent（连接Codex/Claude Code）、Codex App插件、以及TypeScript SDK用于开发画布节点插件。提供Docker和Render部署方式。
zh.stack: 前端使用TypeScript、Vite、React Router；后端Agent基于Node.js；插件系统支持动态加载远程节点插件。
zh.hot: 本月新增1701星，总星数3553，位列GitHub Trending月榜TypeScript第14名。因其将无限画布与AI创作深度结合，提供一站式视觉方案探索工具，受到AI创作者和开发者追捧。
