uses: Remote work and homelab ops — securely expose internal SSH, NAS, and web services to the internet
Local development and debugging — make frontend, backend, and webhook endpoints publicly accessible
Cloud-native and IoT scenarios — provide stable ingress for containers and edge devices without public IPs
Hobbyists and geeks — quickly tunnel personal blogs, image hosting, and game servers from behind NAT

zh.tag: Go 语言 AI Agent 运行时与服务框架
zh.what: Go Micro 是一个 AI Agent 的运行时框架（harness），为 Agent 提供模型、记忆、工具、规划、委托、护栏和服务发现等能力。它同时也是一个服务框架，让每个服务端点都能变成 AI 可调用的工具，并支持通过 MCP 和 A2A 协议与其他 Agent 通信。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go Micro 核心库、CLI 工具、示例代码以及完整的文档。核心库实现了 Agent 运行时、服务注册、消息通信、插件系统等模块，CLI 提供快速初始化、运行和管理 Agent 的能力。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言，依赖 gRPC、Protobuf 进行服务间通信，支持多种 AI 提供商（如 OpenAI、Anthropic），集成 MCP 和 A2A 协议。
zh.hot: 本月新增 179 星，总星数 22970，位列 Go 语言月榜第 16。作为 Go 生态中少有的 Agent 框架，它填补了 Go 在 AI Agent 领域的空白，吸引了大量 Go 开发者关注。
uses: Go 开发者 —— 构建自定义 AI Agent 或集成 AI 功能的微服务
AI 工程师 —— 需要将现有 Go 服务暴露为 AI 可调用工具
平台团队 —— 搭建多 Agent 协作系统，统一管理 Agent 运行时

en.tag: Go agent harness and service framework for building AI agents
en.what: Go Micro is an agent harness and service framework for Go. It provides agents with model, memory, tools, planning, delegation, guardrails, and service discovery, while also enabling every service endpoint to become an AI-callable tool. It supports MCP and A2A protocols for inter-agent communication.
en.content: The repository includes the Go Micro core library, CLI tool, examples, and documentation. The core library implements agent runtime, service registry, messaging, and plugin system; the CLI provides quick initialization, running, and management of agents.
en.stack: Built with Go, uses gRPC and Protobuf for inter-service communication, supports multiple AI providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and integrates MCP and A2A protocols.
en.hot: With 179 new stars this month and 22,970 total, it ranks 16th on the Go monthly trending list. As a rare agent framework in the Go ecosystem, it fills a gap in AI agent development for Go developers, attracting significant attention.
uses: Go developers — building custom AI agents or microservices with AI capabilities
AI engineers — exposing existing Go services as AI-callable tools
Platform teams — setting up multi-agent collaboration systems with unified agent runtime

zh.tag: 基础设施即代码的行业标准工具
zh.what: Terraform 是一个基础设施即代码工具，允许用户通过声明式配置文件安全、可预测地创建、更改和改进基础设施。它支持众多云服务商和内部解决方案，将 API 编码为可共享、版本控制的配置。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Terraform 核心引擎，提供 CLI 工具、配置语言（HCL）解析器、状态管理、资源图构建和执行计划生成等核心功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 HashiCorp 的配置语言 HCL 和插件系统。
zh.hot: Terraform 是基础设施即代码领域的标杆项目，拥有近 5 万星标，长期稳定在 GitHub 热门榜。其强大的多云管理能力和活跃的社区生态持续吸引开发者。
uses: 云基础设施工程师 —— 使用 Terraform 管理多云环境，实现基础设施自动化部署与变更
DevOps 团队 —— 将基础设施配置纳入版本控制，实现 CI/CD 集成与协作
平台工程师 —— 构建内部开发者平台，提供自助式基础设施服务
初学者 —— 通过 Terraform 学习基础设施即代码概念和实践

en.tag: Industry-standard Infrastructure as Code tool
en.what: Terraform is an Infrastructure as Code tool that enables users to safely and predictably create, change, and improve infrastructure using declarative configuration files. It supports numerous cloud providers and in-house solutions, codifying APIs into version-controlled, shareable configurations.
en.content: The repository contains the Terraform core engine, including CLI tools, HCL parser, state management, resource graph construction, and execution plan generation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL) and a plugin system.
en.hot: Terraform is the benchmark in IaC with nearly 50k stars, consistently appearing on GitHub trending. Its multi-cloud management capabilities and vibrant community keep attracting developers.
uses: Cloud infrastructure engineers — manage multi-cloud environments with automated deployment and changes
DevOps teams — version control infrastructure configs for CI/CD integration and collaboration
Platform engineers — build internal developer platforms with self-service infrastructure
Beginners — learn Infrastructure as Code concepts and practices via Terraform

zh.tag: 极速 C++ 日志库，支持头文件-only与编译双模式
zh.what: spdlog 是一款高性能 C++ 日志库，支持头文件-only和编译两种集成方式。它提供丰富的日志输出目标、异步/同步模式、运行时与编译时日志级别过滤，以及基于 fmt 的现代化格式化语法。
zh.content: 仓库包含头文件目录、CMake 构建脚本、多平台 CI 配置、示例代码及基准测试；用户可直接拷贝 include 文件夹以头文件方式使用，或通过 CMake 编译为静态/动态库。
zh.stack: 核心为现代 C++11/14 实现，格式化层依赖 fmt 库；支持通过 CMake 构建，并覆盖 Linux、Windows、macOS、Android 等主流平台。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 生态最广泛采用的日志方案之一，spdlog 凭借极致性能与零成本抽象累积近 3 万 Star；本月新增 141 Star 并登 Trending 月榜第 16，足见其在高性能后端与嵌入式场景的持续热度。
uses: 高性能 C++ 后端服务开发者 —— 需要纳秒级延迟的同步或异步日志记录
跨平台桌面与嵌入式应用团队 —— 寻求覆盖 Windows、Linux、macOS 及 Android 的统一日志方案
游戏引擎与中间件开发者 —— 追求头文件-only快速集成或编译库以缩短构建时间
DevOps 与系统工具开发者 —— 需要日志轮转、syslog、环境变量级别控制等生产级特性

en.tag: Blazing-fast C++ logging library with header-only & compiled modes
en.what: spdlog is a high-performance C++ logging library offering both header-only and compiled integration modes. It supports multiple sinks, asynchronous/sync logging, runtime and compile-time level filtering, and modern formatting powered by the fmt library.
en.content: The repo provides header-only sources, CMake build scripts, cross-platform CI configs, usage examples, and benchmarks. Users can either copy the include folder for header-only use or build a static/shared library via CMake.
en.stack: Built on modern C++11/14, it relies on the fmt library for formatting and uses CMake for building, supporting Linux, Windows, macOS, Android, and more.
en.hot: As one of the most widely adopted C++ logging solutions, spdlog has amassed nearly 30k stars thanks to its extreme performance and zero-cost abstractions; gaining 141 stars this month and ranking 16th on the Trending monthly chart reflects its enduring popularity in high-performance backends and embedded systems.
uses: High-performance C++ backend engineers — needing nanosecond-scale sync or async logging
Cross-platform desktop and embedded teams — seeking a unified logging solution across Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android
Game engine and middleware developers — pursuing header-only quick integration or compiled libraries for faster build times
DevOps and systems tool builders — requiring production-grade features like log rotation, syslog, and environment-level controls

zh.tag: 实时纳秒级帧分析器，支持CPU/GPU/内存全链路性能剖析
zh.what: Tracy 是一款面向游戏及其他高性能应用的实时遥测分析器，提供纳秒级精度的 CPU、GPU、内存与锁性能剖析。它采用混合帧分析与采样分析模式，支持远程性能数据捕获与可视化，并可自动将截图关联到对应帧。
zh.content: 仓库包含探针客户端库（多语言绑定）、跨平台图形化分析器 GUI、服务器端捕获工具，以及编译好的 Windows x64 二进制文件和完整 PDF 文档。配套提供交互式在线 Demo、各版本功能介绍视频与详细构建说明。
zh.stack: 核心以 C++ 编写，客户端提供 C/C++、Lua、Python、Fortran 等原生支持，并扩展至 Rust、Zig、C# 等第三方绑定；图形后端覆盖 OpenGL、Vulkan、Direct3D 11/12、Metal、CUDA、WebGPU 等主流 GPU API。
zh.hot: 凭借纳秒级精度和对 CPU/GPU/内存的全方位覆盖，Tracy 已成为游戏与实时应用性能调优的利器；目前收获 16.4K Star，本月新增 341 颗并跻身 GitHub C++ 月榜第 10，持续攀升的热度反映了开发者对极致性能剖析工具的强烈需求。
uses: 游戏引擎开发者 —— 需要精确到纳秒的帧时间与 GPU 负载分析
高性能应用工程师 —— 对 C++/Rust 等服务端程序进行 CPU 与内存热点剖析
图形/Compute 程序员 —— 调优 Vulkan、Direct3D 12、CUDA 等渲染与计算管线
跨平台团队 —— 统一在 Windows、Linux 等系统上进行远程遥测与性能监控

en.tag: Real-time nanosecond-resolution frame profiler for CPU/GPU/memory
en.what: Tracy is a real-time, nanosecond-resolution telemetry profiler for games and high-performance applications, offering hybrid frame and sampling profiling. It captures and visualizes CPU, GPU, memory, lock, and context-switch data remotely, with automatic screenshot attribution to specific frames.
en.content: The repository contains instrumentation client libraries with multi-language bindings, a cross-platform profiler GUI, server-side capture tools, pre-built Windows x64 binaries, and comprehensive PDF documentation. It also includes an interactive online demo, versioned feature videos, and detailed build instructions.
en.stack: The core is written in C++, with native client instrumentation for C, C++, Lua, Python, and Fortran plus third-party bindings for Rust, Zig, C#, and others. It supports all major graphics/compute APIs including OpenGL, Vulkan, Direct3D 11/12, Metal, CUDA, and WebGPU.
en.hot: With nanosecond precision and comprehensive CPU/GPU/memory coverage, Tracy has become essential for game and real-time app optimization. It has amassed 16.4K stars, gaining 341 this month and ranking 10th on GitHub's C++ monthly trending list, reflecting strong demand for extreme-performance profiling tools.
uses: Game engine developers — profiling frame times and GPU loads down to the nanosecond
High-performance application engineers — analyzing CPU and memory hotspots in C++/Rust services
Graphics/Compute programmers — optimizing rendering and compute pipelines across Vulkan, Direct3D 12, and CUDA
Cross-platform teams — conducting remote telemetry and performance monitoring on Windows, Linux, and beyond

zh.tag: Google 开源 C++ 通用库，生产级标准库扩展
zh.what: Abseil 是 Google 开源的 C++ 通用库集合，旨在补充和扩展 C++ 标准库。它从 Google 内部代码库提取，经过大规模生产环境验证，提供 C++17 兼容的高可靠基础组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 base、algorithm、cleanup、container、debugging、flags、hash、log、numeric、strings、synchronization、time 等模块代码，覆盖初始化、算法扩展、容器、日志与并发工具等基础能力，支持 Bazel 和 CMake 构建。
zh.stack: 基于 C++17 标准开发，官方支持 Bazel 与 CMake 构建，兼容主流编译器与平台，无外部运行时依赖，仅依赖 C++ 标准库。
zh.hot: 本周新增 608 Star 冲上 GitHub 周榜第 2，反映出 C++ 开发者对经过 Google 生产环境验证、能填补标准库空白的高质量基础组件的强劲需求。17964 Star 的积累也证明了其作为现代 C++ 基础设施的核心地位。
uses: C++ 后端/基础架构开发者 —— 需要可靠的基础工具库替代或补充标准库
追求代码稳定性与工程规范的大型项目 —— 使用 Google 内部验证过的高质量保证库
跨平台 C++ 应用开发团队 —— 借助其良好的编译器与平台支持降低移植成本

en.tag: Google's open-source C++ common libraries extending the standard library
en.what: Abseil is an open-source collection of C++ libraries from Google designed to augment the standard library. Extracted from Google's internal codebase and battle-tested in production, it provides C++17-compliant foundational utilities.
en.content: The repository includes modular components such as base, algorithm, cleanup, container, debugging, flags, hash, log, strings, synchronization, and time, supporting both Bazel and CMake build systems.
en.stack: Built on C++17 with official Bazel and CMake support, compatible with major compilers and platforms, with zero external runtime dependencies beyond the C++ standard library.
en.hot: Surging to #2 on GitHub Trending with 608 new stars this week, it reflects strong demand from C++ developers for battle-tested, production-grade utilities that fill gaps in the standard library. Its 17,964 total stars cement its role as essential modern C++ infrastructure.
uses: C++ backend and infrastructure developers who need reliable foundational utilities to complement or replace the standard library
Large-scale projects prioritizing code stability and engineering rigor, leveraging Google's internally battle-tested libraries
Cross-platform C++ teams looking to reduce porting costs through broad compiler and platform support

zh.tag: OpenAI Whisper 的 C/C++ 高性能移植，支持端侧与多硬件加速
zh.what: whisper.cpp 是 OpenAI Whisper 自动语音识别（ASR）模型的纯 C/C++ 实现，专注于高性能推理与零依赖部署。它支持从移动端到服务器的全场景运行，可在本地完成语音转文字而无需联网。
zh.content: 仓库核心仅包含 whisper.h 与 whisper.cpp，其余依赖 ggml 机器学习库；提供面向 iOS、Android、WebAssembly、Java 等平台的示例与绑定，以及 Docker 镜像和 C 风格 API。
zh.stack: 基于纯 C/C++ 与 ggml 张量库，无外部依赖；通过 ARM NEON、Metal、Core ML、Vulkan、CUDA、ROCm 等后端实现跨平台硬件加速，并支持 INT8/INT4 量化。
zh.hot: 凭借 51.8k Stars 和本周 238 新增热度，whisper.cpp 以极致轻量化和「苹果芯片优先」策略成为端侧 AI 语音标杆，几乎覆盖了从手机到 NPU 的所有推理场景。
uses: 移动端开发者 —— 需在 iOS/Android 实现离线语音输入与实时字幕
嵌入式与 IoT 工程师 —— 在树莓派等低功耗设备上部署无网 ASR
跨平台桌面应用开发者 —— 通过 C API 或 WebAssembly 集成转写功能
AI 基础设施团队 —— 构建支持多硬件（NVIDIA/AMD/昇腾）的后端推理服务

en.tag: C/C++ Whisper port optimized for edge & multi-hardware inference
en.what: whisper.cpp is a pure C/C++ implementation of OpenAI's Whisper ASR model, optimized for high-performance inference and zero-dependency deployment. It enables on-device speech-to-text across the full spectrum from mobile to server, all without requiring a network connection.
en.content: The repo centers on whisper.h and whisper.cpp, leveraging the ggml library for ML primitives; it ships with platform examples and bindings for iOS, Android, WebAssembly, Java, plus Docker images and a C-style API.
en.stack: Built on pure C/C++ and the ggml tensor library with zero external dependencies; it accelerates inference across hardware via ARM NEON, Metal, Core ML, Vulkan, CUDA, and ROCm, with support for INT8/INT4 quantization.
en.hot: With 51.8k stars and 238 new stars this week, whisper.cpp has become the go-to edge-AI voice benchmark by pairing extreme lightweight design with an Apple Silicon-first strategy, covering nearly every inference scenario from phones to NPUs.
uses: Mobile developers needing offline speech input and real-time captions on iOS/Android.
Embedded and IoT engineers deploying network-free ASR on Raspberry Pi and low-power devices.
Cross-platform desktop developers integrating transcription via C API or WebAssembly.
AI infrastructure teams building backend inference services across NVIDIA, AMD, and Ascend hardware.

zh.tag: 跨语言高性能开源 RPC 框架与通信基础设施
zh.what: gRPC 是由 Google 开源的现代高性能远程过程调用（RPC）框架，旨在让客户端与服务端应用透明通信。它基于 HTTP/2 和 Protocol Buffers 构建，支持多种编程语言，简化了分布式连接系统的构建。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 C++ 的核心运行时、多语言绑定（Python、Ruby、PHP、C#、Go、Java 等）以及丰富的示例代码。同时提供构建脚本、测试套件和每日更新的预编译包。
zh.stack: 核心基于 C++ 实现，依赖 Protocol Buffers 作为接口定义与序列化格式，通过 HTTP/2 传输。提供各语言原生 SDK，涵盖 Node.js、Go、Java、Dart、Kotlin 等主流生态。
zh.hot: 凭借 45.1K+ Star 的社区认可度与本周新增 158 Star 的持续热度，gRPC 已成为云原生时代服务间通信的事实标准。其多语言支持与卓越性能使其在微服务架构中广受欢迎，稳居 C++ 周榜第 4。
uses: 后端开发者构建跨语言微服务与分布式系统
云原生架构师设计服务网格与容器化通信方案
基础平台团队打造高性能内部 API 与基础设施
多语言技术栈团队统一服务调用协议与接口规范

en.tag: Cross-language, high-performance open-source RPC framework
en.what: gRPC is a modern, high-performance open-source RPC framework by Google that enables transparent communication between client and server applications. Built on HTTP/2 and Protocol Buffers, it supports multiple languages and simplifies building distributed connected systems.
en.content: The repository contains the C++-based core runtime, multi-language bindings (Python, Ruby, PHP, C#, Go, Java, etc.), and extensive examples. It also includes build scripts, test suites, and daily precompiled packages.
en.stack: The core is implemented in C++, relying on Protocol Buffers for IDL and serialization over HTTP/2. It offers native SDKs for major ecosystems including Node.js, Go, Java, Dart, and Kotlin.
en.hot: With 45.1K+ stars and 158 new stars this week, gRPC has become the de facto standard for service-to-service communication in the cloud-native era. Its multi-language support and outstanding performance make it widely adopted in microservices, ranking 4th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Backend developers building cross-language microservices and distributed systems
Cloud-native architects designing service mesh and containerized communication
Platform teams building high-performance internal APIs and infrastructure
Polyglot teams standardizing service call protocols and interface specifications

zh.tag: Facebook开源的高性能C++20基础组件库
zh.what: Folly 是 Facebook 开发并广泛使用的开源 C++20 组件库，专注于提供实用且高效的基础工具。它承载了 Meta 内部大量 C++ 项目的共享代码，并针对大规模场景下的极致性能进行了深度优化。
zh.content: 仓库采用扁平的 folly/ 目录结构，存放各类相对独立的头文件与实现模块；同时包含 experimental、test 与 docs 子目录，分别存放内部实验性组件、单元测试及项目文档。
zh.stack: 基于 C++20 标准构建，与 Boost 及标准库互补而非竞争，仅在既有方案无法满足性能或功能需求时才提供替代实现。
zh.hot: 作为 Facebook C++ 生态的基石项目，Folly 已累计获得 30.4k+ Stars，本月新增 87 Stars 并跻身 GitHub C++ 月榜第 21 位，是高性能系统开发领域广泛认可的基础设施库。
uses: 大规模后端 C++ 开发者 —— 需要高性能基础组件来替代标准库或 Boost 的不足之处
基础设施/中间件团队 —— 构建高并发、低延迟系统时可复用其锁、字符串与内存工具
开源 C++ 项目维护者 —— 希望引入经过 Meta 生产环境长期验证的工业级基础库

en.tag: Facebook's open-source high-performance C++20 core components library
en.what: Folly is an open-source C++20 components library developed and widely used at Meta, designed for practicality and efficiency. It serves as foundational shared code for many of Facebook's C++ projects, with deep performance optimizations targeting large-scale infrastructure.
en.content: The repository follows a flat folly/ directory layout containing relatively independent headers and implementation modules, alongside experimental, test, and docs subdirectories for internal prototypes, unit tests, and project documentation.
en.stack: Built on C++20, it complements rather than competes with Boost and the standard library, providing alternative implementations only when existing solutions fail to meet required performance or functionality profiles.
en.hot: As a cornerstone of Facebook's C++ ecosystem, Folly has accumulated over 30.4k stars, gaining 87 this month and ranking 21st on GitHub's C++ monthly trending list, making it a widely recognized infrastructure library for high-performance systems.
uses: Large-scale backend C++ developers who need high-performance primitives to fill gaps left by the standard library or Boost
Infrastructure and middleware teams building high-concurrency, low-latency systems and reusing its locks, strings, and memory utilities
Open-source C++ maintainers seeking to adopt production-hardened, industrial-grade foundational libraries validated at Meta

zh.tag: 阿里开源轻量级进程内向量数据库，支持混合检索与全文搜索
zh.what: Zvec 是一款可直接嵌入应用程序的进程内向量数据库，由阿里巴巴开源并内部实战验证，主打低延迟、高可扩展的相似性搜索。最新 v0.5.0 原生支持全文搜索与混合检索，可在单一查询中融合稠密向量、稀疏向量与标量过滤。
zh.content: 仓库以 C++ 实现高性能核心引擎，同时提供 Python、Node.js、Go 与 Rust 多语言 SDK；包含完整文档、基准测试数据及 CI 流水线配置。
zh.stack: 核心引擎采用 C++ 构建以保证极致性能，通过 PyPI 和 npm 等包管理器发布多语言绑定，并依赖 DiskANN 等算法实现磁盘级向量索引。
zh.hot: 凭借 15.1K Star 与月增 4.3K 的增速，Zvec 跃居 GitHub C++ 月榜第 3 名；其“嵌入即开即用”的轻量架构与阿里云实战背书，精准命中了 AI 应用对低门槛、高性能向量检索的需求。
uses: AI 应用开发者 —— 需要在本地或边缘端快速嵌入高性能向量检索，无需部署独立数据库服务。
RAG/搜索工程师 —— 需要在一套系统中同时完成稠密向量、稀疏向量与全文搜索的混合召回。
资源敏感型场景 —— 利用 DiskANN 磁盘索引在内存受限环境下支撑大规模向量数据集。

en.tag: Alibaba's open-source, lightning-fast in-process vector DB with hybrid retrieval
en.what: Zvec is an open-source, in-process vector database developed by Alibaba that embeds directly into applications for production-grade, low-latency similarity search. Its latest v0.5.0 introduces native full-text search and hybrid retrieval, enabling a single query to combine dense vectors, sparse vectors, and scalar filtering.
en.content: The repository contains a high-performance C++ core engine alongside official Python, Node.js, Go, and Rust SDKs, plus comprehensive docs, benchmarks, and CI pipelines.
en.stack: The core engine is written in C++ for maximum performance, distributed via PyPI and npm bindings, and leverages algorithms like DiskANN for on-disk vector indexing.
en.hot: With 15.1K stars and 4.3K added this month alone, Zvec ranks 3rd on GitHub's C++ monthly trending list; its zero-dependency, in-process architecture and Alibaba production pedigree directly address the AI industry's demand for high-performance, low-latency vector retrieval.
uses: AI application developers who need to embed high-performance vector search directly into apps without standalone database deployments.
RAG and search engineers requiring unified hybrid retrieval of dense, sparse, and full-text results in a single query.
Resource-constrained environments that benefit from DiskANN on-disk indexing to run large-scale vector datasets with limited RAM.

zh.tag: vLLM 昇腾 NPU 社区插件，让大模型推理原生支持国产算力
zh.what: 这是 vLLM 推理引擎的社区维护硬件插件，旨在让主流大模型能够高效运行在华为昇腾（Ascend）NPU 上；它为国产 AI 算力提供了与 CUDA 生态对标的高性能推理方案，降低异构迁移成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含昇腾定制的算子实现、Attention 与采样后端加速模块、vLLM 版本兼容层，以及完整的构建脚本与中文/英文文档。
zh.stack: 核心模块以 C++ 编写并绑定 Python，底层调用华为 CANN 计算架构与 PyTorch 昇腾后端，通过 vLLM 的硬件插件接口完成对接。
zh.hot: 在国产算力替代与自主可控需求推动下，该插件补全了 vLLM 在昇腾生态的关键一环；仓库已获 2,431 Star，本周新增 52 星并跻身 GitHub C++ Trending 第 13 位，关注度持续走高。
uses: 昇腾 NPU 集群用户 —— 希望在华为 910B/310P 等硬件上无缝运行 vLLM 推理服务的工程团队。
国产算力平台构建者 —— 需要基于自主可控芯片搭建大模型推理底座的云厂商与科研机构。
异构适配开发者 —— 从事 AI 推理引擎后端移植、算子优化与硬件插件集成的系统工程师。

en.tag: Community plugin for running vLLM inference natively on Huawei Ascend NPUs
en.what: This community-maintained hardware plugin enables the vLLM inference engine to run efficiently on Huawei Ascend NPUs. It provides a high-performance serving solution for domestic AI hardware, reducing the migration cost from CUDA-centric ecosystems.
en.content: The repository houses Ascend-customized operators, attention and sampling acceleration backends, vLLM compatibility layers, plus build scripts and bilingual documentation.
en.stack: Core modules are written in C++ with Python bindings, calling Huawei's CANN stack and PyTorch Ascend backend underneath, and interfacing with vLLM through its hardware plugin API.
en.hot: Driven by demand for domestic hardware independence, the plugin fills a critical gap for vLLM on Ascend; having earned 2,431 stars with 52 added this week and a spot at #13 on GitHub's C++ Trending, it is gaining significant traction.
uses: Ascend NPU cluster users — Engineering teams seeking to run vLLM inference natively on Huawei 910B/310P hardware.
Domestic AI platform builders — Cloud providers and research institutes building LLM serving stacks on homegrown chips.
Heterogeneous adaptation developers — Systems engineers working on backend porting, operator optimization, and hardware plugin integration for inference engines.

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 的 JSON 解析与序列化库
zh.what: 这是一个广受欢迎的头文件优先 JSON 库，为 C++ 开发者提供直观、STL 风格的 API 来解析、生成和操作 JSON 数据。它支持将 JSON 与 C++ 数据结构无缝互转，大幅降低了现代 C++ 项目中处理 JSON 的复杂度。
zh.content: 仓库以单头文件（json.hpp）为核心分发形态，同时包含完整的测试套件、基准测试、文档网站源码及多包管理器（Conan、vcpkg 等）支持配置。
zh.stack: 基于 C++11/14/17 标准库实现，无需外部依赖，仅依赖 STL 容器和模板元编程，支持通过 CMake 构建测试与示例。
zh.hot: 凭借超 5 万 Star 和今日新增 17 Star 登上 C++ 日榜第 10，它已成为 C++ 生态的事实标准 JSON 库。其“像 STL 一样直观”的 API 设计和单头文件即用的便捷性持续吸引开发者。
uses: C++ 后端/客户端开发者需要轻量、高性能 JSON 解析与序列化
嵌入式与游戏项目团队希望以单头文件引入依赖，简化构建流程
基础设施开发者在微服务、配置系统或协议网关中进行结构化数据交换

en.tag: Modern C++ JSON parsing and serialization library
en.what: A widely-adopted, header-only JSON library for C++ offering an intuitive, STL-like API to parse, generate, and manipulate JSON. It enables seamless mapping between JSON and C++ data structures, dramatically simplifying JSON handling in modern C++ projects.
en.content: The repository centers around a single-header distribution (json.hpp), complemented by comprehensive tests, benchmarks, documentation site sources, and package manager integrations like Conan and vcpkg.
en.stack: Built on C++11/14/17 with zero external dependencies, relying solely on STL containers and template metaprogramming; tests and examples are built via CMake.
en.hot: With over 50k stars and 17 new stars today, ranking 10th on the C++ daily trending list, it has become the de facto standard JSON library in the C++ ecosystem. Its STL-intuitive API design and single-header convenience continue to attract developers.
uses: C++ backend and client developers needing lightweight, high-performance JSON parsing and serialization
Embedded and game teams looking to simplify builds with a single-header dependency
Infrastructure developers performing structured data exchange in microservices, config systems, or protocol gateways

zh.tag: UE4/5 游戏 Lua 脚本系统与模组开发工具
zh.what: UE4SS 是一个针对虚幻引擎 4/5 游戏的 Lua 脚本注入系统、SDK 生成器、实时属性编辑器和转储工具。它允许用户编写 Lua 或 C++ 模组，加载蓝图模组，并实时查看和编辑游戏对象属性。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Lua 脚本 API、蓝图模组加载器、C++ 模组 API、实时属性查看器/编辑器、UHT 转储器、C++ 头文件生成器、通用 UE 模组、文件解析转储器及 UMAP 重建转储器等组件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖虚幻引擎 4.12 至 5.7，支持 Lua 脚本。
zh.hot: 本月新增 114 颗星，总星数 2711，位列 C++ 月榜第 25 名。作为 UE 游戏模组开发的强大工具，它简化了 Lua 脚本注入和属性编辑流程，受到模组社区欢迎。
uses: UE4/5 游戏模组开发者 —— 使用 Lua 或 C++ 编写模组
游戏逆向工程师 —— 实时查看和编辑游戏对象属性
模组玩家 —— 加载蓝图模组或使用通用模组解锁控制台

en.tag: Lua scripting system and modding toolkit for UE4/5 games
en.what: UE4SS is an injectable Lua scripting system, SDK generator, live property editor, and dumping utilities for UE4/5 games. It enables users to write Lua or C++ mods, load blueprint mods, and view/edit object properties in real time.
en.content: The repo includes Lua scripting API, blueprint modloader, C++ modding API, live property viewer/editor, UHT dumper, C++ header generator, universal UE mods, file parsing dumpers, and UMAP recreation dumper.
en.stack: Developed primarily in C++, targeting Unreal Engine 4.12 to 5.7, with Lua scripting support.
en.hot: Gained 114 stars this month, total 2711, ranking 25th in C++ monthly trending. As a powerful tool for UE game modding, it simplifies Lua script injection and property editing, gaining popularity in the modding community.
uses: UE4/5 game modders — write mods in Lua or C++
Game reverse engineers — view and edit object properties live
Mod users — load blueprint mods or use universal mods to unlock console

zh.tag: Google 边缘端 ML/GenAI 高性能推理运行时
zh.what: LiteRT 是 TensorFlow Lite 的继任者，提供在边缘设备上部署机器学习与生成式 AI 的高性能运行时。它支持 GPU/NPU 加速，并集成了 LLM 推理、Web 推理、C++ 张量操作和 CLI 工具链。
zh.content: 仓库包含 LiteRT 运行时核心、构建状态徽章、文档链接以及多个子项目（LiteRT-LM、LiteRT.js、Tensor API、LiteRT CLI）的入口。
zh.stack: 主语言 C++，依赖 Python 3.13 构建环境，支持 Linux/macOS/Windows 多平台，集成 GPU/NPU 加速与 WebGPU/WASM。
zh.hot: 作为 TensorFlow Lite 的官方继任者，LiteRT 在边缘 AI 领域具有重大影响力，本月新增 586 星，总星数 3157，位列 C++ 月榜第 24 名。
uses: 移动端和嵌入式设备上的 ML/GenAI 推理部署
浏览器中通过 WebGPU/WASM 运行客户端 AI
AI 编码代理工作流加速（通过 LiteRT CLI）
边缘端 LLM 部署（通过 LiteRT-LM）

en.tag: Google's on-device runtime for high-performance ML & GenAI deployment on edge platforms
en.what: LiteRT, the successor to TensorFlow Lite, is Google's on-device runtime for deploying ML and GenAI on edge platforms with high performance. It features GPU/NPU acceleration, LLM inference, Web inference via WebGPU/WASM, C++ tensor API, and a CLI toolkit.
en.content: The repo contains the LiteRT runtime core, build status badges, documentation links, and entry points to subprojects like LiteRT-LM, LiteRT.js, Tensor API, and LiteRT CLI.
en.stack: Primary language is C++, with Python 3.13 build environment, multi-platform support (Linux/macOS/Windows), GPU/NPU acceleration, and WebGPU/WASM integration.
en.hot: As the official successor to TensorFlow Lite, LiteRT has significant impact in edge AI, gaining 586 stars this month (total 3157) and ranking #24 on the C++ monthly trending list.
uses: ML/GenAI inference deployment on mobile and embedded devices
Running client-side AI in browsers via WebGPU/WASM
Accelerating AI coding agent workflows via LiteRT CLI
On-device LLM deployment via LiteRT-LM

zh.tag: C++ 应用级日志库，Google 出品
zh.what: glog 是 Google 开源的 C++ 日志库，提供基于 C++ 流式风格的日志 API 和辅助宏。它支持分级日志、条件日志、日志文件滚动等功能，广泛应用于 C++ 项目中。
zh.content: 仓库包含 glog 的完整源代码、CMake 构建配置、文档和示例。核心是 C++14 实现的日志模块，提供 LOG、CHECK 等宏。
zh.stack: 纯 C++14 实现，依赖标准库和 POSIX 线程；可选 gflags 用于命令行参数。
zh.hot: 尽管已弃用（2025-06-30 归档），但作为经典日志库仍有大量存量用户，本月新增 141 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 19。
uses: C++ 开发者 —— 在遗留项目或新项目中使用 glog 进行日志记录
迁移用户 —— 需要从 glog 迁移到 ng-log 或 Abseil Logging 的开发者
学习参考 —— 研究 Google 日志库设计与 C++ 日志最佳实践

en.tag: C++ application-level logging library from Google
en.what: glog is Google's open-source C++ logging library, offering stream-style logging APIs and helper macros. It supports severity levels, conditional logging, log file rotation, and is widely used in C++ projects.
en.content: The repo contains full source code, CMake build configuration, documentation, and examples. The core is a C++14 logging module providing macros like LOG and CHECK.
en.stack: Pure C++14 implementation, depends on standard library and POSIX threads; optionally gflags for command-line flags.
en.hot: Despite deprecation (archived on 2025-06-30), it remains a classic with many existing users, gaining 141 stars this month, ranking 19th in C++ monthly.
uses: C++ developers — using glog for logging in legacy or new projects
Migration users — developers needing to migrate from glog to ng-log or Abseil Logging
Learning reference — studying Google's logging library design and C++ logging best practices

zh.tag: 跨平台 PlayStation 4 模拟器，已可运行 Bloodborne 等独占大作
zh.what: shadPS4 是一款使用 C++ 编写的早期 PlayStation 4 模拟器，支持在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上运行 PS4 游戏。目前它已能成功启动并运行《血源诅咒》《如龙0》等热门独占作品，尽管仍处于开发初期，尚未达到完美体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器核心源码、图形/音频后端、指令翻译模块及系统服务实现，同时提供文档、兼容性列表与截图。用户可搭配独立的 QtLauncher 获得完整的图形界面体验。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，利用 Vulkan 等图形 API 实现 GPU 指令转译与渲染，跨平台兼容 Windows、Linux 与 macOS。
zh.hot: 凭借已能运行《血源诅咒》等 PS4 独占 3A 大作的突破性进展，该项目吸引了大量玩家与开发者关注，本周新增 332 Star 并累积至 32K+，跻身 GitHub C++ 周榜第 16 名。
uses: 硬核主机玩家 —— 想在 PC 或 Mac 上体验 PS4 独占大作。
模拟器开发者 —— 研究 PS4 系统架构、图形渲染与指令转译技术。
开源贡献者 —— 参与兼容性测试、漏洞修复与性能优化。
游戏研究者 —— 分析 PS4 游戏运行原理与系统调用实现。

en.tag: Cross-platform PS4 emulator already running exclusives like Bloodborne
en.what: shadPS4 is an early-stage PlayStation 4 emulator written in C++, enabling users to run PS4 titles on Windows, Linux, and macOS. It can already boot and play popular exclusives such as Bloodborne and Yakuza 0, though it remains a work in progress with known issues.
en.content: The repository houses the emulator core, graphics/audio backends, instruction translation modules, and system service implementations, along with documentation, compatibility lists, and screenshots. Users can pair it with the separate QtLauncher for a full GUI experience.
en.stack: Built primarily in C++, it leverages Vulkan and other graphics APIs to translate and render GPU instructions, with cross-platform support for Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: Its breakthrough ability to run PS4 exclusives like Bloodborne has drawn massive attention from gamers and developers, earning 332 new stars this week for a total of 32K+ and placing it 16th on GitHub's C++ Trending chart.
uses: Hardcore console gamers who want to play PS4 exclusives on PC or Mac.
Emulator developers studying PS4 system architecture, graphics rendering, and instruction translation.
Open-source contributors helping with compatibility testing, bug fixes, and performance optimization.
Game researchers analyzing PS4 game execution principles and system call implementations.

zh.tag: 跨平台 Android 投屏与实时控制工具
zh.what: QtScrcpy 是一款通过 USB 或网络显示和控制 Android 设备的桌面软件，无需 root 权限。它支持 GNU/Linux、Windows 和 macOS 三大平台，注重轻量、高性能、低延迟和非侵入性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Qt 桌面应用源码，支持设备屏幕实时显示、鼠标键盘控制、文件传输、APK 安装、按键映射脚本等功能。还提供了默认的 PUBG Mobile 等游戏键位映射。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 和 Qt 框架开发，依赖 scrcpy 核心库实现 ADB 通信与屏幕投屏。
zh.hot: 拥有 3 万+ Star，本月新增 802，长期受安卓开发者和游戏玩家欢迎。其免费、跨平台、低延迟的特性使其成为投屏控制的首选工具之一。
uses: 安卓开发者 —— 实时调试和展示设备屏幕
游戏玩家 —— 在电脑上键鼠操作手游（如 PUBG Mobile）
演示与培训 —— 将手机画面投屏到大屏幕进行教学或展示
多设备管理 —— 批量投屏和控制多台 Android 设备

en.tag: Cross-platform Android screen mirroring and real-time control tool
en.what: QtScrcpy is a desktop software that displays and controls Android devices via USB or network without root. It supports GNU/Linux, Windows, and macOS, focusing on lightness, performance, low latency, and non-intrusiveness.
en.content: The repo contains full Qt desktop application source code, featuring real-time screen display, mouse/keyboard control, file transfer, APK installation, and key mapping scripts. Default key mappings for PUBG Mobile and other games are provided.
en.stack: Built with C++ and Qt framework, relying on the scrcpy core library for ADB communication and screen mirroring.
en.hot: With 30k+ stars and 802 new this month, it's a long-time favorite among Android developers and gamers. Its free, cross-platform, low-latency features make it a top choice for screen mirroring and control.
uses: Android developers — real-time debugging and screen demonstration
Gamers — play mobile games (e.g., PUBG Mobile) with keyboard and mouse on PC
Presentations & training — mirror phone screen to big screen for teaching or demos
Multi-device management — batch mirror and control multiple Android devices

zh.tag: GTA 5 增强版的开源作弊菜单 DLL
zh.what: 《GTA 5: Enhanced》的实验性修改菜单（mod menu）：编译成 DLL 后用 Xenos 等注入器在游戏主菜单注入，按 INSERT 或 Ctrl+\ 呼出菜单。建议配合 FSL 把存档数据重定向到本地磁盘以保号，且需要关闭 BattlEye 反作弊（目前没有 BE 绕过，公共战局会被心跳检测踢出）。
zh.content: C++ 源码 + 一份简短 README，讲清使用步骤（FSL → 下载 nightly release → 注入器 → 关 BattlEye → 注入）和常见问题修复（掉线、存档消失、游戏起不来）。
zh.stack: C++，DLL 注入式单机/联机修改器，依赖外部注入器和 FSL，GPL-2.0；默认分支 enhanced。
zh.hot: 它面向 GTA5 增强版 Mod 社区的具体需求，并延续 YimMenu 项目路线，为需要开源菜单的用户提供选择。
uses: GTA5 单机玩家 —— 刷车刷钱体验全部游戏内容
mod 开发者 —— 基于源码学习或二次开发游戏菜单
离线娱乐 —— 关 BattlEye 后在私人战局整活

en.tag: The open-source mod menu DLL for GTA 5: Enhanced
en.what: An experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced: compile to a DLL, inject at the main menu with an injector like Xenos, then press INSERT or Ctrl+\ to open. Pairing with FSL (redirecting save data to local disk) is recommended to protect your account, and BattlEye anti-cheat must be disabled (there's no BE bypass — public sessions will kick you via heartbeat checks).
en.content: C++ source plus a short README covering the workflow (FSL → nightly release → injector → disable BattlEye → inject) and fixes for common issues (disconnects, missing saves, game won't launch).
en.stack: C++, a DLL-injection single/multiplayer mod menu relying on external injectors and FSL; GPL-2.0; default branch enhanced.
en.hot: It targets a concrete need in the GTA5 Enhanced modding community and continues the familiar YimMenu project line for users seeking an open menu.
uses: GTA5 single-player fans — unlock vehicles and cash to experience all content
mod developers — learn from or fork the source for custom game menus
Offline fun — mess around in private sessions with BattlEye off

zh.tag: 跨平台 2D/3D 开源游戏引擎
zh.what: Godot 是一款功能丰富的跨平台游戏引擎，支持从统一界面创建 2D 和 3D 游戏。它提供了一套全面的常用工具，让用户专注于游戏开发，无需重复造轮子。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Godot 引擎的完整源代码、编辑器、导出模板以及官方文档和演示示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 OpenGL/Vulkan 等图形 API，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 及 Web 平台。
zh.hot: 作为完全免费开源、无版税的游戏引擎，Godot 社区活跃，本月新增近 2000 星，持续吸引独立开发者和小型团队。
uses: 独立游戏开发者 —— 快速制作 2D/3D 游戏并一键导出到多平台
游戏教育 —— 学习游戏开发原理，无需付费或授权
小型工作室 —— 低成本开发商业游戏，保留全部知识产权

en.tag: Cross-platform 2D and 3D open-source game engine
en.what: Godot Engine is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine for creating 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. It provides a comprehensive set of common tools, allowing users to focus on making games without reinventing the wheel.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, editor, export templates, official documentation, and demo projects for the Godot Engine.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on graphics APIs like OpenGL/Vulkan, and supports Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and Web platforms.
en.hot: As a completely free and open-source game engine with no royalties, Godot has an active community, gaining nearly 2000 stars this month, continuously attracting indie developers and small teams.
uses: Indie game developers — quickly create 2D/3D games and export to multiple platforms with one click
Game education — learn game development principles without licensing fees
Small studios — develop commercial games at low cost while retaining full IP

zh.tag: 开源一体化产品数据平台：分析、回放、实验、LLM 观测全包
zh.what: 知名开源产品数据平台：产品分析、Web 分析、session 回放、feature flag、A/B 实验、错误追踪、日志、问卷、数据仓库、CDP、LLM 可观测性全部集成在一个系统。最新定位「构建自驱动产品（self-driving products）」：把错误、rage click 等产品信号自动转成分析报告和 PR 供你 review 合并，可从 Slack、Web、桌面端或 MCP 操作，支持 Docker 自托管。
zh.content: 超大型 monorepo：posthog/（Django 后端）、frontend/、products/（各产品线）、rust/、services/、ee/（企业版，单独授权），大量 docker-compose 部署文件与全平台 SDK。
zh.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust 服务，底层 ClickHouse；MIT（ee/ 目录除外）。
zh.hot: 它把完整的产品分析套件与面向 Agent 的自动化能力结合，既有成熟开发者用户，也有清晰的新使用场景。
uses: 产品团队 —— 一个平台替代 GA + 回放 + 实验工具的组合订阅
注重数据合规的公司 —— 自托管部署，用户数据不出机房
AI 产品团队 —— 用 LLM 可观测性追踪自家 agent 的成本与质量

en.tag: The open-source all-in-one product data platform
en.what: The well-known open-source product data platform: product analytics, web analytics, session replay, feature flags, A/B experiments, error tracking, logs, surveys, a data warehouse, CDP pipelines and LLM observability in one system. Its latest positioning is 'self-driving products': product signals like errors and rage clicks are automatically turned into analysis reports and PRs for you to review and merge — operable from Slack, web, desktop or MCP, and self-hostable via Docker.
en.content: A huge monorepo: posthog/ (Django backend), frontend/, products/ (each product line), rust/, services/, ee/ (enterprise code, separately licensed), lots of docker-compose files and SDKs for every platform.
en.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust services over ClickHouse; MIT (except ee/).
en.hot: The project combines a broad product-analytics suite with an agent-facing automation narrative, giving an established developer audience a clear reason to revisit it.
uses: Product teams — replace the GA + replay + experimentation stack with one platform
Compliance-sensitive companies — self-host so user data never leaves your infra
AI product teams — track your agents' cost and quality with LLM observability

zh.tag: 1-bit/三值超压缩大模型 Bonsai 的本地运行 demo
zh.what: PrismML 的 Bonsai 系列语言模型官方演示仓库，主打极致量化：1-bit 版每权重约 1.125 bit，27B 模型能塞进现代 iPhone；三值（Ternary）版约 1.7 bit，是质量更高的默认选项。最新 27B 是视觉语言模型，支持看图、tool calling、MCP、256k+ 长上下文和推理努力度调节。
zh.content: 纯 Shell 脚本工程：setup.sh / setup.ps1 一键装依赖下模型，scripts/ 放运行和下载脚本，另有三份白皮书 PDF、AGENTS.md（写给 AI agent 看的配置指南）、VISION/TOOLS 等专题文档与社区 benchmark。
zh.stack: Shell + llama.cpp 服务端，模型托管在 HuggingFace；支持 Mac Metal、CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm 和纯 CPU，Apache-2.0。
zh.hot: 视觉语言模型与 iPhone 端侧演示把技术卖点变得直观，配套脚本也降低了上手与复现实验的门槛。
uses: 手机 / 边缘设备开发者 —— 在 iPhone 上离线跑 27B 视觉语言模型
隐私敏感场景 —— 医疗、法律等数据不出本地的本地 AI 助手
硬件玩家 —— 在树莓派等低功耗设备上体验大模型

en.tag: Local-run demo of Bonsai, the 1-bit / ternary ultra-compressed LLMs
en.what: The official demo repo for PrismML's Bonsai model family, built around extreme quantization: the 1-bit version uses ~1.125 bits per weight so a 27B model fits a modern iPhone; the ternary version (~1.7 bits) is the higher-quality default. The newest 27B is a vision-language model with image input, tool calling, MCP, 256k+ context and adjustable reasoning effort.
en.content: A pure Shell project: setup.sh / setup.ps1 one-liners install dependencies and pull models, scripts/ holds run/download scripts, plus three whitepaper PDFs, an AGENTS.md (a config guide written for AI agents), topical docs (VISION/TOOLS/…) and community benchmarks.
en.stack: Shell + a llama.cpp server, models hosted on HuggingFace; runs on Mac Metal, CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm or plain CPU; Apache-2.0.
en.hot: The vision-language model and on-device iPhone demo make a technically ambitious claim concrete, while the included scripts reduce trial friction.
uses: Mobile / edge developers — run a 27B vision-language model offline on an iPhone
Privacy-sensitive settings — local AI assistants for medical or legal data that can't leave the device
Hardware tinkerers — run LLMs on low-power boards like a Raspberry Pi

zh.tag: 教你从零重写各种技术的教程大合集
zh.what: CodeCrafters 维护的著名教程索引仓库，理念是费曼那句「我不能创造的东西，我就不理解」。收录大量「从零重写某技术」的 step-by-step 教程链接，覆盖数据库、操作系统、Git、Docker、编程语言、神经网络、Web 浏览器等约 30 个类别。
zh.content: 主体是一个巨大的 README 列表，按「Build your own X」分类组织，每条标注所用编程语言和链接（如用 Python 写 LLM、用 C++ 写光线追踪）；无代码本体。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 文档；收录的教程本身横跨 C/C++/Python/Go/Rust 等各种语言。
zh.hot: 它用「亲手实现一遍」把抽象的计算机科学原理变成具体项目，学习路径清晰，因此长期具有传播力。
uses: 在校生 / 转行者 —— 按「造一遍」路线真正理解数据库、操作系统原理
资深工程师 —— 面试前用手写 Git / Docker 项目补底层功底
技术布道者 —— 按分类找写作和分享素材

en.tag: The giant collection of 'rebuild your favorite tech from scratch' tutorials
en.what: CodeCrafters' famous tutorial index, founded on Feynman's 'What I cannot create, I do not understand'. It collects step-by-step 'build your own X' tutorial links across ~30 categories: databases, operating systems, Git, Docker, programming languages, neural networks, web browsers and more.
en.content: Essentially one huge README list organized by 'Build your own X' categories, each entry tagged with its language and link (e.g. write an LLM in Python, a raytracer in C++); no code of its own.
en.stack: Pure Markdown; the tutorials themselves span C/C++/Python/Go/Rust and more.
en.hot: Its learn-by-building catalog remains useful because it turns abstract computer-science concepts into concrete implementation projects.
uses: Students & career switchers — truly understand databases and OS internals by building them
Senior engineers — shore up fundamentals before interviews by hand-rolling Git / Docker
Tech writers — find writing and talk material by category

zh.tag: 把 GitHub Copilot 智能体嵌进你自己应用的官方 SDK
zh.what: GitHub 官方出的多语言 SDK：在自己的应用或服务里直接调用 Copilot Agent 的能力。它暴露的是 Copilot CLI 背后同一套经过生产验证的 agent 运行时 —— 你不用自己搭编排层，定义好 agent 行为，规划、工具调用、文件编辑都交给 Copilot 处理。
zh.content: 单仓库 6 套 SDK，按目录分：nodejs/、python/、go/、dotnet/、java/、rust/，另有 docs/、test/ 和 cookbook 示例；各语言经 npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io 分发。
zh.stack: 多语言 monorepo（TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust 六个 SDK），MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，推送非常活跃。
zh.hot: 「Copilot agent 能力开放给第三方应用」的定位自带关注度，GitHub 官方背书。
uses: SaaS 厂商 —— 在产品里内嵌 Copilot 级 AI 助手（IDE、低代码平台等）
企业内部工具 —— 快速给内部系统加 agent 能力，不用自研编排
多语言团队 —— JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust 任选

en.tag: GitHub's official SDK for embedding the Copilot agent in your own apps
en.what: GitHub's official multi-language SDK: call the Copilot Agent's capabilities directly from your own apps and services. It exposes the same production-proven agent runtime behind the Copilot CLI — no need to build your own orchestration layer: define the agent's behavior and let Copilot handle planning, tool calls and file edits.
en.content: Six SDKs in one repo, by directory: nodejs/, python/, go/, dotnet/, java/, rust/, plus docs/, test/ and cookbook examples; distributed via npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io.
en.stack: A multi-language monorepo (TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust), MIT; created January 2026, committing very actively.
en.hot: 'Copilot agent capabilities opened to third-party apps' draws attention by itself — with GitHub's official stamp on it.
uses: SaaS vendors — embed Copilot-grade AI assistance into products (IDEs, low-code platforms)
Internal tooling — add agent capabilities to internal systems without building orchestration
Polyglot teams — pick from JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust

zh.tag: 你的「AI 团队总管」：把一堆 agent 组织起来 7×24 干活
zh.what: 定位「Chief Agent Operator」：把多个 AI agent 当工作单元统一招聘、调度和汇报。核心功能包括 Agent Builder（描述需求即可自动配置出可用 agent）、Agent Groups（多 agent 并行协作）、Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace 协作面板，以及白盒可编辑的 Personal Memory；支持接入任意模型和模态，号称 10000+ skills 和 MCP 插件生态。
zh.content: 可自部署的 Web 应用（Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos 一键部署），仓库含完整中英文档、Changelog、插件体系和本地开发指南；默认分支 canary，今天仍在高频 push。
zh.stack: TypeScript + Next.js 系 Web 应用，Docker 自托管，插件走 MCP 协议；许可证为自定义（非标准）。
zh.hot: 多 Agent 调度与即时通信网关的组合，让这一成熟 AI 应用平台形成了明确的协作化方向。
uses: 一人公司 / 自由职业者 —— 组建 7×24 自动干活的 agent 团队处理重复工作
运营团队 —— 定时调度 agent 做日报、巡检、内容分发
进阶玩家 —— 用 Personal Memory 和 10000+ skills 定制专属助手

en.tag: Your 'Chief Agent Operator' — an AI team working 7×24
en.what: Positioned as a 'Chief Agent Operator': hire, schedule and hear reports from multiple AI agents as work units. Key features: Agent Builder (describe the need, get a configured agent), Agent Groups (parallel multi-agent collaboration), Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace panels, and a white-box editable Personal Memory; any model and modality, with a claimed 10,000+ skills and MCP plugin ecosystem.
en.content: A self-deployable web app (one-click Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos), with full bilingual docs, a changelog, the plugin system and local dev guides; default branch canary, still pushing frequently today.
en.stack: TypeScript + Next.js, self-hosted via Docker, plugins over MCP; custom (non-standard) license.
en.hot: Its combination of multi-agent orchestration and messaging gateways gives an established AI application platform a clear collaboration-focused direction.
uses: Solo founders & freelancers — run a 7×24 agent team for repetitive work
Ops teams — schedule agents for daily reports, patrols and content distribution
Power users — craft custom assistants with Personal Memory and 10,000+ skills
